16.219.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tasmādāgneyakoṇe tu mārkaṃḍeyasamīpagam ..
guhāliṃgaṃ mahādevi nīlakaṇṭheti viśrutam .. 1 ..
16.219.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
तस्मादाग्नेयकोणे तु मार्कंडेयसमीपगम् ..
गुहालिंगं महादेवि नीलकण्ठेति विश्रुतम् .. 1 ..
16.219.m:
Īśvara said:
In the southeast corner from that, near Mārkaṇḍeya,
is a secret liṅga, O great goddess, renowned as Nīlakaṇṭha.

16.219.s: viṣṇunā pūjitaṃ pūrvaṃ sarva pātakanāśanam .. 2 ..
16.219.d: विष्णुना पूजितं पूर्वं सर्व पातकनाशनम् .. 2 ..
16.219.m: [It was] formerly worshipped by Viṣṇu, destroying all sins.

16.219.s:
tatra yaḥ pūjayedbhaktyā talliṃgaṃ pāpamocanam..
sa putrapaśumāndhīmānmodate pṛthivītale .. 3 ..
16.219.d:
तत्र यः पूजयेद्भक्त्या तल्लिंगं पापमोचनम्..
स पुत्रपशुमान्धीमान्मोदते पृथिवीतले .. 3 ..
16.219.m: Whoever worships with devotion there that liṅga which releases from sin, / having sons, cattle, and wisdom, rejoices on the earth.

16.219.s:
evaṃ tatra mahādevi mārkaṇḍeyeśa sannidhau ..
ṛṣīṇāmāśramā ye'tra dṛśyante'dyāpi bhāmini .. 4 ..
16.219.d:
एवं तत्र महादेवि मार्कण्डेयेश सन्निधौ ..
ऋषीणामाश्रमा येऽत्र दृश्यन्तेऽद्यापि भामिनि .. 4 ..
16.219.m: Thus, O great goddess, in the vicinity of Mārkaṇḍeyeśa, / the hermitages of the seers are seen here even today, O spirited woman.

16.219.s:
aṣṭāśītisahasrāṇi ṛṣīṇāmūrdhvaretasām ..
tatra sthitāni deveśi mārkaṇḍeyāśramāṃtike .. 5 ..
16.219.d:
अष्टाशीतिसहस्राणि ऋषीणामूर्ध्वरेतसाम् ..
तत्र स्थितानि देवेशि मार्कण्डेयाश्रमांतिके .. 5 ..
16.219.m: Eighty-eight thousand seers of chaste conduct / dwell there near Mārkaṇḍeya's hermitage, O queen of gods.

16.219.s:
ṛṣīṇāṃ ca guhāstatra sarvā liṃgasamanvitāḥ ..
dṛśyante puṇyatapasāṃ tadāśramanivāsinām .. 6 ..
16.219.d:
ऋषीणां च गुहास्तत्र सर्वा लिंगसमन्विताः ..
दृश्यन्ते पुण्यतपसां तदाश्रमनिवासिनाम् .. 6 ..
16.219.m: And the caves of the seers endowed with holy austerities / dwelling in that hermitage are seen there, all furnished with liṅgas.

16.219.s:
tatra yaḥ sthāpayelliṃgaṃ mārkaṃḍeśasamīpagam..
kulānāṃ śatamuddhṛtya modate divi devavat .. 7 ..
16.219.d:
तत्र यः स्थापयेल्लिंगं मार्कंडेशसमीपगम्..
कुलानां शतमुद्धृत्य मोदते दिवि देववत् .. 7 ..
16.219.m: Whoever installs a liṅga there near Mārkaṇḍeśa, / having rescued a hundred ancestral lines, rejoices in heaven like a god.

16.219.s:
sarve śivamayā lokāḥ śive sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam ..
tasmācchivaṃ yajedvidvānya icchecchriyamātmanaḥ .. 8 ..
16.219.d:
सर्वे शिवमया लोकाः शिवे सर्वं प्रतिष्ठितम् ..
तस्माच्छिवं यजेद्विद्वान्य इच्छेच्छ्रियमात्मनः .. 8 ..
16.219.m: All the worlds consist of Śiva; everything is established in Śiva. / Therefore, the wise person who desires his own prosperity should sacrifice to Śiva.

16.219.s:
śivabhakto na yo rājā bhakto'nyeṣu sureṣu ca ..
svapatiṃ yuvatī tyaktvā ramate'nyeṣu vai yathā .. 9 ..
16.219.d:
शिवभक्तो न यो राजा भक्तोऽन्येषु सुरेषु च ..
स्वपतिं युवती त्यक्त्वा रमतेऽन्येषु वै यथा .. 9 ..
16.219.m: A king who is not a devotee of Śiva, but a devotee of other gods, / is just like a young woman who, abandoning her own husband, takes pleasure with others.

16.219.s:
brahmādayaḥ surāḥ sarve rājānaśca maharddhikāḥ ..
mānavā munayaścaiva sarve liṃgaṃ yajaṃti ca .. 7.1.219.10 ..
16.219.d:
ब्रह्मादयः सुराः सर्वे राजानश्च महर्द्धिकाः ..
मानवा मुनयश्चैव सर्वे लिंगं यजंति च .. 7.1.219.10 ..
16.219.m: All the gods headed by Brahmā, the kings of great power, / men, and sages—all worship the liṅga.

16.219.s:
svanāmakṛtacihnāni liṃgānīṃdrādibhiḥ kramāt ..
sthāpitāni yathā sthāne mānavairapi bhūriśaḥ .. 11 ..
16.219.d:
स्वनामकृतचिह्नानि लिंगानींद्रादिभिः क्रमात् ..
स्थापितानि यथा स्थाने मानवैरपि भूरिशः .. 11 ..
16.219.m: Liṅgas marked with their own names were installed in their proper places / in turn by Indra and others, and by men in great numbers.

16.219.s:
sthāpanādbrahmahatyāṃ ca bhrūṇahatyāṃ tathaiva ca ..
mahāpāpāni cānyāni nistīrṇāḥ śivatejasā .. 12 ..
16.219.d:
स्थापनाद्ब्रह्महत्यां च भ्रूणहत्यां तथैव च ..
महापापानि चान्यानि निस्तीर्णाः शिवतेजसा .. 12 ..
16.219.m: By the installation [of a liṅga], [such persons] were carried across the killing of a brahmin, the killing of an embryo, / and other great sins by the fiery power of Śiva.

16.219.s:
vṛtraṃ hatvā purā śakro māhendraṃ sthāpya śaṃkaram ..
liṃgaṃ ca muktapāpaughastato'sau tridivaṃ gataḥ .. 13 ..
16.219.d:
वृत्रं हत्वा पुरा शक्रो माहेन्द्रं स्थाप्य शंकरम् ..
लिंगं च मुक्तपापौघस्ततोऽसौ त्रिदिवं गतः .. 13 ..
16.219.m: In ancient times, Śakra, having slain Vṛtra, installed Śaṃkara as Māhendra, / and, freed from the mass of sins by the liṅga, went to heaven.

16.219.s:
sthāpayitvā śivaṃ sūryo gaṃgāsāgarasaṃgame ..
nirāmayo'bhūtsomaśca prabhāse paścimodadheḥ .. 14 ..
16.219.d:
स्थापयित्वा शिवं सूर्यो गंगासागरसंगमे ..
निरामयोऽभूत्सोमश्च प्रभासे पश्चिमोदधेः .. 14 ..
16.219.m: The Sun, having installed Śiva at the confluence of the Gaṅgā and the ocean, / became free from disease, as did Soma in Prabhāsa by the western sea.

16.219.s:
kāśyāṃ caiva tathādityaḥ sahye garuḍakāśyapau ..
pratiṣṭhāṃ paramāṃ prāptau pratiṣṭhāpya jagatpatim .. 15 ..
16.219.d:
काश्यां चैव तथादित्यः सह्ये गरुडकाश्यपौ ..
प्रतिष्ठां परमां प्राप्तौ प्रतिष्ठाप्य जगत्पतिम् .. 15 ..
16.219.m: And so too the Sun in Kāśī, and Garuḍa and Kaśyapa on the Sahya [mountain], / attained the highest status after installing the Lord of the universe.

16.219.s:
khyātadoṣā hyahilyā'pi bhartṛśaptā'bhavattadā ..
sthāpyeśānaṃ punaḥ strītvaṃ lebhe putrāṃstathottamān .. 16 ..
16.219.d:
ख्यातदोषा ह्यहिल्याऽपि भर्तृशप्ताऽभवत्तदा ..
स्थाप्येशानं पुनः स्त्रीत्वं लेभे पुत्रांस्तथोत्तमान् .. 16 ..
16.219.m: Even Ahilyā, who had incurred famous reproach, was then cursed by her husband; / having installed Īśāna, she regained her womanhood and [obtained] excellent sons.

16.219.s:
paśyaṃtyadyāpi yāḥ snātvā tatrāhilyeśvaraṃ striyaḥ ..
puruṣāścāpi taddoṣairmucyante nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 17 ..
16.219.d:
पश्यंत्यद्यापि याः स्नात्वा तत्राहिल्येश्वरं स्त्रियः ..
पुरुषाश्चापि तद्दोषैर्मुच्यन्ते नात्र संशयः .. 17 ..
16.219.m: The women who bathe and behold Ahilyeśvara there even today, / and men as well, are freed from those sins; there is no doubt in this.

16.219.s:
sthāpayitveśvaraṃ śvetaśaile balivirocanau ..
ubhāvapi hi saṃjātāvamarau balināṃ varau .. .. 18 ..
16.219.d:
स्थापयित्वेश्वरं श्वेतशैले बलिविरोचनौ ..
उभावपि हि संजातावमरौ बलिनां वरौ .. .. 18 ..
16.219.m: Having installed Īśvara on Śvetaśaila, Bali and Virocana / both became immortal, best among the strong.

16.219.s:
rāmeṇa rāvaṇaṃ hatvā sasainyaṃ tridaśeśvaram ..
sthāpito vidhivadbhaktyā tīre nadanadīpateḥ .. 19 ..
16.219.d:
रामेण रावणं हत्वा ससैन्यं त्रिदशेश्वरम् ..
स्थापितो विधिवद्भक्त्या तीरे नदनदीपतेः .. 19 ..
16.219.m: [A liṅga] was installed according to the rules with devotion by Rāma on the shore of the ocean, the lord of rivers, / after slaying Rāvaṇa along with his army, that king of the thirty [demons].

16.219.s:
svāyaṃbhuvarṣidaivādiliṃgahīnā na bhūḥ kvacita .. vyā
pārānsakalāṃstyaktvā pūjayadhvaṃ śivaṃ sadā ..
nikaṭā iva dṛśyaṃte kṛtāṃtanagaropagāḥ .. 7.1.219.20 ..
16.219.d:
स्वायंभुवर्षिदैवादिलिंगहीना न भूः क्वचित .. व्या
पारान्सकलांस्त्यक्त्वा पूजयध्वं शिवं सदा ..
निकटा इव दृश्यंते कृतांतनगरोपगाः .. 7.1.219.20 ..
16.219.m: Nowhere is the earth devoid of liṅgas—self-manifest, installed by seers, gods, and others. / Abandon all [mundane] pursuits and always worship Śiva; / [those who do not] seem near to arriving in the city of the God of Death.

16.219.s:
devi kiṃ bahunoktena varṇitena punaḥ punaḥ ..
prabhāsakṣetrasāraṃ tu mārkaṇḍeyāśramaṃ prati .. 21 ..
16.219.d:
देवि किं बहुनोक्तेन वर्णितेन पुनः पुनः ..
प्रभासक्षेत्रसारं तु मार्कण्डेयाश्रमं प्रति .. 21 ..
16.219.m: O goddess, what is the use of speaking much and praising again and again? / The hermitage of Mārkaṇḍeya is indeed the essence of the sacred field of Prabhāsa.

16.219.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsa kṣetramāhātmye mārkaṇḍeyeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikonaviṃśatyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 219 ..
16.219.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे प्रथमे प्रभास क्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये मार्कण्डेयेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामैकोनविंशत्युत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 219 ..
16.219.m: Thus ends the two hundred and nineteenth chapter, entitled 'Description of the Māhātmya of Mārkaṇḍeyeśvara', in the first [part], 'Māhātmya of Prabhāsakṣetra', in the seventh [book], 'Prabhāsakhaṇḍa', in the Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.220.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi devaṃ trailokyapūjitam ..
vṛṣadhvajeśvaraṃ nāma sthitaṃ dakṣiṇatastathā .. 1 ..
16.220.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि देवं त्रैलोक्यपूजितम् ..
वृषध्वजेश्वरं नाम स्थितं दक्षिणतस्तथा .. 1 ..
16.220.m: Īśvara said: / Then, O great goddess, one should go to the god worshipped by the three worlds, / known as Vṛṣadhvajeśvara, situated likewise to the south.

16.220.s:
yattadakṣaramavyaktaṃ paraṃ yasmānna vidyate ..
yogagamyamanādyaṃtaṃ vṛṣabhadhvaja saṃmitam .. 2 ..
16.220.d:
यत्तदक्षरमव्यक्तं परं यस्मान्न विद्यते ..
योगगम्यमनाद्यंतं वृषभध्वज संमितम् .. 2 ..
16.220.m: That which is imperishable, unmanifest, than which nothing is higher, / accessible by yoga, without beginning or end, equal to the bull-bannered [Lord],

16.220.s:
sarvāścaryamayaṃ devi buddhigrāhyaṃ nirāmayam..
viśvataḥ pāṇipādaṃ ca viśvato'kṣiśiromukham .. 3 ..
16.220.d:
सर्वाश्चर्यमयं देवि बुद्धिग्राह्यं निरामयम्..
विश्वतः पाणिपादं च विश्वतोऽक्षिशिरोमुखम् .. 3 ..
16.220.m: consisting of all wonders, O goddess, graspable by the intellect, free from disease, / having hands and feet everywhere, eyes, heads, and faces everywhere—

16.220.s:
taṃ ca devaṃ ciraṃ sthāṇuṃ vṛṣabhadhvajasaṃjñitam ..
pṛthurmarucca bharataḥ śaśabindurgayaḥ śibiḥ .. 4 ..
16.220.d:
तं च देवं चिरं स्थाणुं वृषभध्वजसंज्ञितम् ..
पृथुर्मरुच्च भरतः शशबिन्दुर्गयः शिबिः .. 4 ..
16.220.m: that eternal god, the pillar, known as Vṛṣabhadhvaja: / Pṛthu, Marutta, Bharata, Śaśabindu, Gaya, Śibi,

16.220.s:
rāmoṃ'barīṣo māṃdhātā dilīpo'tha bhagīrathaḥ ..
suhotro raṃtidevaśca yayātiḥ sagarastathā .. 5 ..
16.220.d:
रामोंऽबरीषो मांधाता दिलीपोऽथ भगीरथः ..
सुहोत्रो रंतिदेवश्च ययातिः सगरस्तथा .. 5 ..
16.220.m: Rāma, Ambarīṣa, Māndhātṛ, Dilīpa, and Bhagīratha, / Suhotra, Rantideva, Yayāti, and Sagara—

16.220.s:
ṣoḍaśaite nṛpā dhanyāḥ prabhāsaṃ kṣetramāśritāḥ ..
vṛṣadhvajeśamārādhya yajñairiṣṭvā divaṃ gatāḥ .. 6 ..
16.220.d:
षोडशैते नृपा धन्याः प्रभासं क्षेत्रमाश्रिताः ..
वृषध्वजेशमाराध्य यज्ञैरिष्ट्वा दिवं गताः .. 6 ..
16.220.m: these sixteen blessed kings, having taken resort in the sacred field of Prabhāsa / and worshipped Vṛṣadhvajeśa, having offered sacrifices, went to heaven.

16.220.s:
satyaṃ vacmi hitaṃ vacmi sāraṃ vacmi punaḥpunaḥ ..
asāre dagdhasaṃsāre sāraṃ tatra śivārcanam .. 7 ..
16.220.d:
सत्यं वच्मि हितं वच्मि सारं वच्मि पुनःपुनः ..
असारे दग्धसंसारे सारं तत्र शिवार्चनम् .. 7 ..
16.220.m: I speak what is true, I speak what is beneficial, I speak what is essential again and again: / In this worthless, burnt worldly cycle, the worship of Śiva is the essence there.

16.220.s:
punarjanma punarmṛtyuḥ punaḥ kleśaḥ punarjarā ..
aharaharghaṭīnyāyo na kadācidapīdṛśaḥ .. .. 8 ..
16.220.d:
पुनर्जन्म पुनर्मृत्युः पुनः क्लेशः पुनर्जरा ..
अहरहर्घटीन्यायो न कदाचिदपीदृशः .. .. 8 ..
16.220.m: Rebirth, redeath, re-affliction, re-decay; / day by day the analogy of the water-wheel goes on, never otherwise.

16.220.s:
tadā śvetasya saṃsāragrantheratyantadurbhidaḥ ..
paraṃ nirmūlavicchedi kriyatāṃ tadbhavārcanam .. 9 ..
16.220.d:
तदा श्वेतस्य संसारग्रन्थेरत्यन्तदुर्भिदः ..
परं निर्मूलविच्छेदि क्रियतां तद्भवार्चनम् .. 9 ..
16.220.m: Therefore, let that worship of Bhava be performed, which cuts entirely at the root, / for [severing] the knot of transmigration of Śveta, which is exceedingly hard to untie.

16.220.s:
tasya cintāmaṇirgehe tasya kalpadrumaḥ kule ..
kuberaḥ kiṃkarastasya bhaktiryasya śive sthitā .. 7.1.220.10 ..
16.220.d:
तस्य चिन्तामणिर्गेहे तस्य कल्पद्रुमः कुले ..
कुबेरः किंकरस्तस्य भक्तिर्यस्य शिवे स्थिता .. 7.1.220.10 ..
16.220.m: In his home is the wish-fulfilling jewel; in his family is the wish-granting tree; / Kubera is his servant—he in whom devotion to Śiva is established.

16.220.s:
seyaṃ lakṣmīḥ purā puṃsāṃ seyaṃ bhaktiḥ samīhitā ..
seyaṃ śreyaskarī mūrtirbhaktiryā vṛṣabhadhvaje .. 11 ..
16.220.d:
सेयं लक्ष्मीः पुरा पुंसां सेयं भक्तिः समीहिता ..
सेयं श्रेयस्करी मूर्तिर्भक्तिर्या वृषभध्वजे .. 11 ..
16.220.m: This is that fortune of men of old, this is that devotion desired; / this is the form conferring well-being: the devotion directed toward the Bull-bannered Lord.

16.220.s:
puṣpaiḥ paṃcabhirapyatra pūjayitvā maheśvaram ..
daśānāmaśvamedhānāṃ phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ .. 12 ..
16.220.d:
पुष्पैः पंचभिरप्यत्र पूजयित्वा महेश्वरम् ..
दशानामश्वमेधानां फलं प्राप्नोति मानवः .. 12 ..
16.220.m: Having worshipped the great Lord here even with five flowers, / a person attains the fruit of ten horse sacrifices.

16.220.s:
vṛṣabhastatra dātavyo vṛṣabhadhvaja saṃnidhau ..
sarvapātakanāśārthaṃ samyagyātrāphalepsubhiḥ .. 13 ..
16.220.d:
वृषभस्तत्र दातव्यो वृषभध्वज संनिधौ ..
सर्वपातकनाशार्थं सम्यग्यात्राफलेप्सुभिः .. 13 ..
16.220.m: A bull should be given as a gift there in the presence of the Bull-bannered Lord, / for the destruction of all sins, by those who desire the full fruit of pilgrimage.

16.220.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye vṛṣabhadhvajeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma viṃśatyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 220 ..
16.220.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये वृषभध्वजेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम विंशत्युत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 220 ..
16.220.m: Thus ends the two hundred and twentieth chapter, entitled 'Description of the Māhātmya of Vṛṣabhadhvajeśvara', in the first [part], 'Māhātmya of Prabhāsakṣetra', in the seventh [book], 'Prabhāsakhaṇḍa', in the Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.221.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi devaṃ ca ṛṇamocanam ..
tasmindṛṣṭe ṛṇaṃ na syānmātāpitṛsamudbhavam .. 1 ..
16.221.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि देवं च ऋणमोचनम् ..
तस्मिन्दृष्टे ऋणं न स्यान्मातापितृसमुद्भवम् .. 1 ..
16.221.m: Īśvara said: / Then, O great goddess, one should go to the god Ṛṇamocana; / when he is seen, there would be no debt originating from mother or father.

16.221.s:
pitarastu purā sarve divyakṣetraṃ samāgatāḥ ..
prabhāse tapasā yuktāḥ sthitā varṣagaṇānbahūn .. 2 ..
16.221.d:
पितरस्तु पुरा सर्वे दिव्यक्षेत्रं समागताः ..
प्रभासे तपसा युक्ताः स्थिता वर्षगणान्बहून् .. 2 ..
16.221.m: Formerly all the ancestors came to the divine sacred field; / engaged in austerity in Prabhāsa, they remained for many groups of years.

16.221.s:
agniṣvāttā barhiṣadaḥ somapā ājyapāstathā ..
liṃgaṃ saṃsthāpayāmāsuḥ sarve bhaktiparāyaṇāḥ .. 3 ..
16.221.d:
अग्निष्वात्ता बर्हिषदः सोमपा आज्यपास्तथा ..
लिंगं संस्थापयामासुः सर्वे भक्तिपरायणाः .. 3 ..
16.221.m: The Agniṣvāttas, the Barhiṣads, the Somapas, and the Ājyapas, / all dedicated to devotion, established a liṅga.

16.221.s:
tataḥ kālena mahatā tuṣṭasteṣāṃ maheśvaraḥ ..
tataḥ pratyakṣatāṃ gatvā vākyametaduvāca ha .. 4 ..
16.221.d:
ततः कालेन महता तुष्टस्तेषां महेश्वरः ..
ततः प्रत्यक्षतां गत्वा वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह .. 4 ..
16.221.m: Then, after a great length of time, the Great Lord was pleased with them; / then, having become visible, he spoke these words:
'I am well pleased; hail to you! State what is desired by your mind.'

16.221.s:
.. pitara ūcuḥ .. ..
asmākaṃ dīyatāṃ vṛttirjagatyasminsvayaṃ kṛte ..
devānāṃ ca ṛṣīṇāṃ ca mānuṣāṇāṃ mahītale .. 6 ..
16.221.d:
.. पितर ऊचुः .. ..
अस्माकं दीयतां वृत्तिर्जगत्यस्मिन्स्वयं कृते ..
देवानां च ऋषीणां च मानुषाणां महीतले .. 6 ..
16.221.m: The ancestors said: / 'Let livelihood be given to us in this world created by you yourself, / and [livelihood] of the gods, the seers, and mortals on the earth.

16.221.s:
bhavāneva paro loke sarveṣāṃ padmasaṃbhava..
āgatya varṇāścatvāra iha ye śraddhayānvitāḥ .. 7 ..
16.221.d:
भवानेव परो लोके सर्वेषां पद्मसंभव..
आगत्य वर्णाश्चत्वार इह ये श्रद्धयान्विताः .. 7 ..
16.221.m: You alone are supreme in the world of all, O lotus-born one. / Whosoever among the four classes coming here endowed with faith—

16.221.s:
paitṛkāttu ṛṇānmuktā bhavaṃtu gatakalmaṣāḥ ..
vyantaratvaṃ suraśreṣṭha yeṣāṃ vai pitaro gatāḥ .. 8 ..
16.221.d:
पैतृकात्तु ऋणान्मुक्ता भवंतु गतकल्मषाः ..
व्यन्तरत्वं सुरश्रेष्ठ येषां वै पितरो गताः .. 8 ..
16.221.m:
may they be freed from the ancestral debt, their blemishes gone!
O best of gods, [for those] whose ancestors have become ghosts,

16.221.s:
sarppe vahni viṣairvā ye nāśaṃ nītāḥ pitāmahāḥ ..
aputrā vā saputrā vā sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ vinā .. 9 ..
16.221.d:
सर्प्पे वह्नि विषैर्वा ये नाशं नीताः पितामहाः ..
अपुत्रा वा सपुत्रा वा सपिण्डीकरणं विना .. 9 ..
16.221.m:
or whose grandfathers met destruction by snakes, fire, or poisons,
whether childless or having sons, without the sapiṇḍīkaraṇa ritual,

16.221.s:
na kṛtāni purā yeṣāmekoddiṣṭāni ṣoḍaśa ..
tathā naiva vṛṣotsargo gohatāścātha cāntyajaiḥ .. 7.1.221.10 ..
16.221.d:
न कृतानि पुरा येषामेकोद्दिष्टानि षोडश ..
तथा नैव वृषोत्सर्गो गोहताश्चाथ चान्त्यजैः .. 7.1.221.10 ..
16.221.m:
for whom the sixteen single-purpose śrāddhas were not performed before,
nor likewise the release of a bull, or who were killed by cows or by outcasts,

16.221.s:
athāpare ye ca mṛtāḥ śaucena tu vinā kṛtāḥ ..
te cātra tarpitāḥ sarve prayāntu paramāṃ gatim .. 11 .. ..
16.221.d:
अथापरे ये च मृताः शौचेन तु विना कृताः ..
ते चात्र तर्पिताः सर्वे प्रयान्तु परमां गतिम् .. 11 .. ..
16.221.m:
or others who died deprived of purification—
may all of them, propitiated here with water offerings, attain the highest state!"

16.221.s:
.. śrībhagavānuvāca .. ..
snātvā tu salile puṇye pitṛṇāṃ caiva tarpaṇam ..
ye kariṣyaṃti manujāḥ pitṛbhaktiparāyaṇāḥ .. 12 ..
16.221.d:
.. श्रीभगवानुवाच .. ..
स्नात्वा तु सलिले पुण्ये पितृणां चैव तर्पणम् ..
ये करिष्यंति मनुजाः पितृभक्तिपरायणाः .. 12 ..
16.221.m:
The Blessed Lord said:
"Having bathed in the holy water and offered water to the ancestors,
those men devoted to piety toward their ancestors

16.221.s:
ahaṃ varapradasteṣāṃ tārayiṣyāmi tatkṣaṇāt ..
pitṛnsarvānna saṃdeho yadi pāpaśatairvṛtāḥ .. 13 ..
16.221.d:
अहं वरप्रदस्तेषां तारयिष्यामि तत्क्षणात् ..
पितृन्सर्वान्न संदेहो यदि पापशतैर्वृताः .. 13 ..
16.221.m:
shall have me granting them a boon: I will deliver at that very instant
all their ancestors without doubt, even if shrouded by hundreds of sins.

16.221.s:
asmiṃstīrthe naraḥ snātvā yo liṃgaṃ pūjayiṣyati ..
yuṣmābhiḥ sthāpitaṃ liṃgaṃ sa muktaḥ paitṛkādṛṇāt .. 14..
16.221.d:
अस्मिंस्तीर्थे नरः स्नात्वा यो लिंगं पूजयिष्यति ..
युष्माभिः स्थापितं लिंगं स मुक्तः पैतृकादृणात् .. 14..
16.221.m:
A man who bathes in this sacred ford and worships the liṅga,
the liṅga installed by you, is freed from the ancestral debt.

16.221.s:
yasmādṛṇātpramucyeta asya liṃgasya darśanāt ..
tasmānmayā kṛtaṃ nāma hyetasya ṛṇamocanam .. . 15 ..
16.221.d:
यस्मादृणात्प्रमुच्येत अस्य लिंगस्य दर्शनात् ..
तस्मान्मया कृतं नाम ह्येतस्य ऋणमोचनम् .. . 15 ..
16.221.m:
Because one is released from debt by the darśana of this liṅga,
therefore it has been named Ṛṇamocana by me."

16.221.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
hiraṇyaṃ mastake dattvā yaḥ snāti ṛṇamocane ..
ātmā vai tāritastena dattaṃ bhavati gośatam .. 16 ..
16.221.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
हिरण्यं मस्तके दत्त्वा यः स्नाति ऋणमोचने ..
आत्मा वै तारितस्तेन दत्तं भवति गोशतम् .. 16 ..
16.221.m:
Īśvara said:
"He who places gold upon his head and bathes at Ṛṇamocana
has truly delivered himself, and the gift of a hundred cows is accomplished [by him].

16.221.s:
evamuktvā sa bhagavāṃstatraivāntaradhīyata ..
tasmātsarvaprayatnena tatra śrāddhaṃ samācaret ..
pūjayettanmahādevi pitṛliṃgaṃ surapriyam .. 17 ..
16.221.d:
एवमुक्त्वा स भगवांस्तत्रैवान्तरधीयत ..
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन तत्र श्राद्धं समाचरेत् ..
पूजयेत्तन्महादेवि पितृलिंगं सुरप्रियम् .. 17 ..
16.221.m:
Having spoken thus, the Blessed Lord vanished right there.
Therefore, with every effort one should perform a śrāddha there,
and worship that liṅga dear to the gods, the pitṛliṅga, O great goddess."

16.221.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya ṛṇamocanamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikaviṃśatyuttaradviśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ .. 221 ..
16.221.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्य ऋणमोचनमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामैकविंशत्युत्तरद्विशततमो ऽध्यायः .. 221 ..
16.221.m: Thus ends the two hundred and twenty-first chapter, entitled 'Description of the Glory of Ṛṇamocana,' in the First [sub-section], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the Seventh Prabhāsakhaṇḍa in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

16.222.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tatraiva saṃsthitaṃ liṃgaṃ rukmavatyā pratiṣṭhitam..
sarvapāpopaśamanaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam.. 1 ..
16.222.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
तत्रैव संस्थितं लिंगं रुक्मवत्या प्रतिष्ठितम्..
सर्वपापोपशमनं सर्वकामफलप्रदम्.. 1 ..
16.222.m:
Īśvara said:
"Stationed right there is the liṅga installed by Rukmavatī,
quelling all sins and granting the fruit of all desires.

16.222.s:
tatra snātvā mahātīrthe liṃgaṃ saṃplāvya yatnataḥ ..
viprebhyo dāpayedvittaṃ mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ .. 2 ..
16.222.d:
तत्र स्नात्वा महातीर्थे लिंगं संप्लाव्य यत्नतः ..
विप्रेभ्यो दापयेद्वित्तं मुच्यते सर्वपातकैः .. 2 ..
16.222.m:
Having bathed there in that great sacred ford and carefully poured water over the liṅga,
one should give wealth to brahmins; one is freed from all sins."

16.222.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye rukmavatīśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvāviṃśatyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 222 ..
16.222.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये रुक्मवतीश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम द्वाविंशत्युत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 222 ..
16.222.m: Thus ends the two hundred and twenty-second chapter, entitled 'Description of the Glory of Rukmavatīśvara,' in the First [sub-section], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the Seventh Prabhāsakhaṇḍa in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

16.223.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi liṃgaṃ trailokyapūjitam ..
gātrotsargamiti khyātaṃ tasya dakṣiṇataḥ sthitam.. 1 ..
16.223.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि लिंगं त्रैलोक्यपूजितम् ..
गात्रोत्सर्गमिति ख्यातं तस्य दक्षिणतः स्थितम्.. 1 ..
16.223.m:
Īśvara said:
"Then one should go, O great goddess, to the liṅga worshipped in the three worlds,
known as Gātrotsarga, situated to the south of it,

16.223.s:
yatra gātraṃ parityaktaṃ balabhadreṇa dhīmatā ..
anyaiścaiva mahābhāgairyādavaistatra saṃyuge .. 2 ..
16.223.d:
यत्र गात्रं परित्यक्तं बलभद्रेण धीमता ..
अन्यैश्चैव महाभागैर्यादवैस्तत्र संयुगे .. 2 ..
16.223.m:
where the body was cast off by the wise Balabhadra,
and by other illustrious Yādavas there in the battle,

16.223.s:
yatra te yādavāḥ kṣīṇā brahmaśāpabalāhinā ..
etatpuruṣottamaṃ kṣetraṃ samantāddhanuṣāṃ śatam.. 3 ..
16.223.d:
यत्र ते यादवाः क्षीणा ब्रह्मशापबलाहिना ..
एतत्पुरुषोत्तमं क्षेत्रं समन्ताद्धनुषां शतम्.. 3 ..
16.223.m:
where those Yādavas were destroyed by the serpent of the power of a brahmin's curse.
This holy sacred field of Puruṣottama measures a hundred bows all around,

16.223.s:
yatra sākṣātsvayaṃ devi tiṣṭhate puruṣottamaḥ ..
tadeva vaiṣṇavaṃ kṣetraṃ kalau pātakanāśanam.. 4 ..
16.223.d:
यत्र साक्षात्स्वयं देवि तिष्ठते पुरुषोत्तमः ..
तदेव वैष्णवं क्षेत्रं कलौ पातकनाशनम्.. 4 ..
16.223.m:
where Puruṣottama himself resides directly in visible form, O goddess.
That very sacred field of Viṣṇu destroys sins in the Kali age.

16.223.s:
rahasyaṃ paramaṃ devi tīrthānāṃ pravaraṃ hi tat..
pūrvaṃ kṛtayuge devi pretatīrthaṃ ca saṃsmṛtam ..
kalau yuge tu saṃprāpte gātrotsargamiti tvabhūt .. 5 ..
16.223.d:
रहस्यं परमं देवि तीर्थानां प्रवरं हि तत्..
पूर्वं कृतयुगे देवि प्रेततीर्थं च संस्मृतम् ..
कलौ युगे तु संप्राप्ते गात्रोत्सर्गमिति त्वभूत् .. 5 ..

16.223.s:
ṛṇamocanapārśve tu madhye tu pāpamocanāt..
etanmadhyaṃ samāśritya mṛtaḥ pāpairvimucyate .. 6 ..
16.223.d:
ऋणमोचनपार्श्वे तु मध्ये तु पापमोचनात्..
एतन्मध्यं समाश्रित्य मृतः पापैर्विमुच्यते .. 6 ..
16.223.m:
Near Ṛṇamocana, between [it and] Pāpamocana,
one who dies having sought refuge in this middle [place] is freed from sins.

16.223.s:
tasya kiṃ varṇyate devi yatrānantaphalaṃ mahat ..
athamedhasahasrasya phalaṃ snātvā hyavāpyate .. 7 ..
16.223.d:
तस्य किं वर्ण्यते देवि यत्रानन्तफलं महत् ..
अथमेधसहस्रस्य फलं स्नात्वा ह्यवाप्यते .. 7 ..
16.223.m:
How can its [virtue] be described, O goddess, where the fruit is infinite and great?
Indeed, by bathing [there], the fruit of a thousand horse-sacrifices is obtained.

16.223.s:
yatrāśvatthaṃ samāsādya samādhinyastamānasaḥ ..
mumoca dustyajānprāṇānbrahmadvāreṇa keśavaḥ .. 8 ..
16.223.d:
यत्राश्वत्थं समासाद्य समाधिन्यस्तमानसः ..
मुमोच दुस्त्यजान्प्राणान्ब्रह्मद्वारेण केशवः .. 8 ..
16.223.m:
Where, having reached an aśvattha tree, his mind fixed in absorption,
Keśava abandoned his life-breaths, so hard to abandon, through the aperture of Brahmā.

16.223.s:
tatra nārāyaṇaṃ sākṣādbalabhadraṃ ca rukmiṇīm ..
pūjayitvā vidhānena mucyate pātakatrayāt .. 9 ..
16.223.d:
तत्र नारायणं साक्षाद्बलभद्रं च रुक्मिणीम् ..
पूजयित्वा विधानेन मुच्यते पातकत्रयात् .. 9 ..
16.223.m:
Having properly worshipped Nārāyaṇa directly, Balabhadra, and Rukmiṇī there,
one is freed from the three types of sins.

16.223.s:
tatra snātvā naro bhaktyā yaḥ saṃtarpayate pitṝn ..
pretatvātpitaro muktā bhavanti śrāddhadāyinaḥ .. 7.1.223.10 ...
16.223.d:
तत्र स्नात्वा नरो भक्त्या यः संतर्पयते पितॄन् ..
प्रेतत्वात्पितरो मुक्ता भवन्ति श्राद्धदायिनः .. 7.1.223.10 ...
16.223.m:
Having bathed there, the man who propitiates the ancestors with devotion—
the ancestors of that giver of śrāddha become freed from the state of ghosts.

16.223.s:
goghnaḥ surāpo durmedhā brahmahā gurutalpagaḥ ..
tatra snātvā naraḥ sadyo vipāpaḥ saṃprapadyate .. 11 ..
16.223.d:
गोघ्नः सुरापो दुर्मेधा ब्रह्महा गुरुतल्पगः ..
तत्र स्नात्वा नरः सद्यो विपापः संप्रपद्यते .. 11 ..
16.223.m:
A cow-killer, a liquor-drinker, an evil-minded person, a slayer of a brahmin, or a violator of the guru's bed,
having bathed there, immediately becomes free from sin.

16.223.s:
bālye vayasi yatpāpaṃ vārddhake yauvane'pi vā ..
ajñānājjñānato vāpi yaḥ karoti naraḥ priye ..
tatra snātvā pramucyeta tīrthe gātrapramocane .. 12 ..
16.223.d:
बाल्ये वयसि यत्पापं वार्द्धके यौवनेऽपि वा ..
अज्ञानाज्ज्ञानतो वापि यः करोति नरः प्रिये ..
तत्र स्नात्वा प्रमुच्येत तीर्थे गात्रप्रमोचने .. 12 ..
16.223.m:
Whatever sin a man commits in childhood, in old age, or in youth,
whether through ignorance or with knowledge, O beloved,
having bathed there in the sacred ford of Gātrapramocana, he is completely freed from it.

16.223.s:
tatra piṇḍapradānena pitṝṇāṃ jāyate parā ..
tṛptirvarṣaśataṃ yāvadetadāha purā hariḥ .. 13 ..
16.223.d:
तत्र पिण्डप्रदानेन पितॄणां जायते परा ..
तृप्तिर्वर्षशतं यावदेतदाह पुरा हरिः .. 13 ..
16.223.m:
By offering rice-balls there, supreme satisfaction arises for the ancestors
for up to a hundred years: this Hari declared of old.

16.223.s:
yaḥ punaścānnadānaṃ tu tatra kuryātsamāhitaḥ ..
tasyānvaye'pi deveśi na preto jāyate naraḥ ..14.. ..
16.223.d:
यः पुनश्चान्नदानं तु तत्र कुर्यात्समाहितः ..
तस्यान्वयेऽपि देवेशि न प्रेतो जायते नरः ..14.. ..
16.223.m:
Furthermore, whoever attentively gives food there,
in his lineage too, O queen of the gods, no man is born as a ghost."

16.223.s:
..śrīdevyuvāca .. ..
pretatīrthamiti proktaṃ paścādgātravimocanam ..
vada me devadeveśa pretatīrthasya kāraṇam.. 19 ..
.. īśvara uvāca.. ..
śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi pretatīrthasya kāraṇam..
yacchrutvā mānavo bhaktyā muktaḥ syātsarvakilbiṣaiḥ .. 16 ..
purā''sīdgautamonāma maharṣiḥ śaṃsitavrataḥ ..
bhṛgukalpātsamāyātaḥ kṣetre prābhāsike śubhe .. 17 ..
ayane cottare puṇye śrīsomeśadidṛkṣayā ..
dṛṣṭvā someśvaraṃ devaṃ snātvā tīrtheṣu kṛtsnaśaḥ .. 18 ..
sa gacchaṃstīrthayātrāyāṃ gātrotsargaṃ tato gataḥ .. 19 ..
16.223.d:
..श्रीदेव्युवाच .. ..
प्रेततीर्थमिति प्रोक्तं पश्चाद्गात्रविमोचनम् ..
वद मे देवदेवेश प्रेततीर्थस्य कारणम्.. 19 ..
.. ईश्वर उवाच.. ..
शृणु देवि प्रवक्ष्यामि प्रेततीर्थस्य कारणम्..
यच्छ्रुत्वा मानवो भक्त्या मुक्तः स्यात्सर्वकिल्बिषैः .. 16 ..
पुरा'ऽसीद्गौतमोनाम महर्षिः शंसितव्रतः ..
भृगुकल्पात्समायातः क्षेत्रे प्राभासिके शुभे .. 17 ..
अयने चोत्तरे पुण्ये श्रीसोमेशदिदृक्षया ..
दृष्ट्वा सोमेश्वरं देवं स्नात्वा तीर्थेषु कृत्स्नशः .. 18 ..
स गच्छंस्तीर्थयात्रायां गात्रोत्सर्गं ततो गतः .. 19 ..
16.223.m:
The goddess said:
"It was called Pretatīrtha, and later Gātravimocana.
Tell me, O Lord of the gods of gods, the cause of [the name] Pretatīrtha."
Īśvara said:
"Listen, O goddess, I shall tell the cause of Pretatīrtha,
hearing which with devotion a mortal becomes freed from all sins.
Formerly there was a great seer named Gautama, of praised vows;
he came from Bhṛgukalpa to the auspicious Prabhāsakṣetra,
during the holy northern course of the sun, desiring to see the glorious Someśa.
Having seen god Someśvara and bathed in all the sacred fords,
going on the pilgrimage to the sacred fords, he then went to Gātrotsarga.

16.223.s:
athāsau brāhmaṇo devi yāvatsīmāmupāgataḥ ..
tāvadviṣṇupriyaṃ tatra dadṛśe vaiṣṇavaṃ vanam .. 7.1.223.20 ..
16.223.d:
अथासौ ब्राह्मणो देवि यावत्सीमामुपागतः ..
तावद्विष्णुप्रियं तत्र ददृशे वैष्णवं वनम् .. 7.1.223.20 ..
16.223.m:
Then, O goddess, as soon as that brahmin reached the boundary,
just then he beheld a Vaiṣṇava grove dear to Viṣṇu,

16.223.s:
puruṣottamanāmāḍhyaṃ kṣetraṃ ca dhanuṣāṃ śatam ..
tasminkṣetre sa cāpaśyatpaṃca pretānsudāruṇān .. 21 ..
16.223.d:
पुरुषोत्तमनामाढ्यं क्षेत्रं च धनुषां शतम् ..
तस्मिन्क्षेत्रे स चापश्यत्पंच प्रेतान्सुदारुणान् .. 21 ..
16.223.m:
and the sacred field filled with the name Puruṣottama, measuring a hundred bows.
In that sacred field he saw five very terrifying ghosts,

16.223.s:
mahāvṛkṣasamārūḍhānmahākāyānmahotkaṭān..
ūrdhvakeśāñchaṃkukarṇānsnāyunaddhakalevarān .. 22 ..
16.223.d:
महावृक्षसमारूढान्महाकायान्महोत्कटान्..
ऊर्ध्वकेशाञ्छंकुकर्णान्स्नायुनद्धकलेवरान् .. 22 ..
16.223.m:
mounted upon a huge tree, possessing huge bodies and immense power,
with hair standing upwards, spike-like ears, and bodies bound by sinews,

16.223.s:
vimāṃsarudhirānnagnānatha kṛṣṇakalevarān ..
dṛṣṭvā'sau bhayasaṃtrasto vinaṣṭo'smītyacintayat .. 23 ..
16.223.d:
विमांसरुधिरान्नग्नानथ कृष्णकलेवरान् ..
दृष्ट्वाऽसौ भयसंत्रस्तो विनष्टोऽस्मीत्यचिन्तयत् .. 23 ..
16.223.m:
destitute of flesh and blood, naked, and with black bodies.
Seeing them, terrified with fear, he thought: 'I am ruined!'

16.223.s:
dhyātvā''ha suciraṃ kālaṃ dhairyamāsthāya yatnataḥ ..
ke yūyaṃ vikṛtākārā dṛṣṭāḥ pūrvaṃ mayā purā .. 24 ..
16.223.d:
ध्यात्वा'ऽह सुचिरं कालं धैर्यमास्थाय यत्नतः ..
के यूयं विकृताकारा दृष्टाः पूर्वं मया पुरा .. 24 ..
16.223.m:
Having reflected for a long time and maintained firmness with effort, he said:
'Who are you of deformed forms? Formerly, in the past,

16.223.s:
na kadācidyathā yūyaṃ kimarthaṃ kṣetramadhyataḥ ..
dhāvamānāḥ suduḥkhārtā etanme kautukaṃ mahat .. 25 ..
16.223.d:
न कदाचिद्यथा यूयं किमर्थं क्षेत्रमध्यतः ..
धावमानाः सुदुःखार्ता एतन्मे कौतुकं महत् .. 25 ..
16.223.m:
I have never seen [beings] such as you! Why are you running about
within the sacred field, afflicted with great sorrow? This is a great wonder to me.'

16.223.s:
.. pretā ūcuḥ .. ..
vayaṃ pretā mahābhāga dūrādiha samāgatāḥ ..
śrutvā tīrthavaraṃ puṇyaṃ praveśaṃ na labhāmahe ..26..
16.223.d:
.. प्रेता ऊचुः .. ..
वयं प्रेता महाभाग दूरादिह समागताः ..
श्रुत्वा तीर्थवरं पुण्यं प्रवेशं न लभामहे ..26..

16.223.s:
gaṇairaṃtardhānagataiḥ prahārairjarjarīkṛtāḥ ..
lekhako rohakaścaiva sūcakaḥ śīghragastathā .. 27 ..
16.223.d:
गणैरंतर्धानगतैः प्रहारैर्जर्जरीकृताः ..
लेखको रोहकश्चैव सूचकः शीघ्रगस्तथा .. 27 ..
16.223.m: shattered by blows from the attendants who have become invisible: / [one is] Lekhaka, Rohaka, and also Sūcaka, and Śīghraga;

16.223.s: ahaṃ paryuṣitonāma pañcamaḥ pāpakṛttamaḥ .. 28 ..
16.223.d: अहं पर्युषितोनाम पञ्चमः पापकृत्तमः .. 28 ..
16.223.m: I am named Paryuṣita, the fifth, the worst committer of sin.”

16.223.s:
.. gautama uvāca .. ..
pretayonau pravṛttānāṃ kena nāmāni kṛtsnaśaḥ ..
yuṣmākaṃ nirmitānyevametanme kautukaṃ mahat .. 29 ..
16.223.d:
.. गौतम उवाच .. ..
प्रेतयोनौ प्रवृत्तानां केन नामानि कृत्स्नशः ..
युष्माकं निर्मितान्येवमेतन्मे कौतुकं महत् .. 29 ..
16.223.m: Gautama said: / “By whom were these names created completely for you, / who have entered the ghostly state? This causes me great curiosity.”

16.223.s:
.. pretā ūcuḥ .. ..
yācamānasya viprasya likhatyeṣa dharātale ..
nottaraṃ paṭhate kiñcittenāsau lekhakaḥ smṛtaḥ .. 7.1.223.30 ..
16.223.d:
.. प्रेता ऊचुः .. ..
याचमानस्य विप्रस्य लिखत्येष धरातले ..
नोत्तरं पठते किञ्चित्तेनासौ लेखकः स्मृतः .. 7.1.223.30 ..
16.223.m: The pretas said: / “When a brahmin was begging, this one would write on the surface of the ground / and recite no answer at all; therefore he is remembered as Lekhaka (the Scribe).

16.223.s:
dvitīyo brāhmaṇabhayātprāsādamadhirohati ..
tato'sau rohakākhyo'bhūcchṛṇu vipra tṛtīyakam .. 31 ..
16.223.d:
द्वितीयो ब्राह्मणभयात्प्रासादमधिरोहति ..
ततोऽसौ रोहकाख्योऽभूच्छृणु विप्र तृतीयकम् .. 31 ..
16.223.m: The second climbed up onto a palace out of fear of a brahmin; / hence he was called Rohaka (the Climber). Hear about the third, O brahmin:

16.223.s:
sūcitā bahavo'nena brāhmaṇā vittasaṃyutāḥ .
rājñe pāpena tenāsau sūcako bhuvi viśrutaḥ .. 32..
16.223.d:
सूचिता बहवोऽनेन ब्राह्मणा वित्तसंयुताः .
राज्ञे पापेन तेनासौ सूचको भुवि विश्रुतः .. 32..
16.223.m: many brahmins possessed of wealth were reported by him / to the king; because of that sin, he is renowned on earth as Sūcaka (the Informer).

16.223.s:
brāhmaṇaiḥ prārthyamānastu śīghraṃ dhāvati nityaśaḥ ..
na kadāciddadāti sma tenāsau śīghragaḥ smṛtaḥ .. 33 ..
16.223.d:
ब्राह्मणैः प्रार्थ्यमानस्तु शीघ्रं धावति नित्यशः ..
न कदाचिद्ददाति स्म तेनासौ शीघ्रगः स्मृतः .. 33 ..
16.223.m: When asked by brahmins, he constantly ran away swiftly; / he never gave anything, and therefore he is remembered as Śīghraga (the Swift-runner).

16.223.s:
mayā kadannaṃ dattaṃ ca paryuṣitaṃ brāhmaṇottame ..
brāhmaṇebhyaḥ sadā dānaṃ miṣṭānnena tu poṣaṇam ..
tasmātparyuṣitonāma saṃjāto'haṃ dharātale .. 34 ..
16.223.d:
मया कदन्नं दत्तं च पर्युषितं ब्राह्मणोत्तमे ..
ब्राह्मणेभ्यः सदा दानं मिष्टान्नेन तु पोषणम् ..
तस्मात्पर्युषितोनाम संजातोऽहं धरातले .. 34 ..
16.223.m: Bad, stale food was given by me to an excellent brahmin; / while giving to brahmins should always be feeding with sweet food. / Therefore I was born on the surface of the earth named Paryuṣita (the Stale-feeder).”

16.223.s:
.. gautama uvāca .. ..
na vinā bhojanenaiva vartante prāṇino bhuvi ..
kimāhārā bhavanto vai vadadhvaṃ mama kautukāt .. 35 ..
16.223.d:
.. गौतम उवाच .. ..
न विना भोजनेनैव वर्तन्ते प्राणिनो भुवि ..
किमाहारा भवन्तो वै वदध्वं मम कौतुकात् .. 35 ..
16.223.m: Gautama said: / “Living beings do not exist on earth without food. / What is your sustenance? Tell me out of my curiosity.”

16.223.s:
.. pretā ūcuḥ .. ..
prāpte bhojanakāle tu yatra yuddhaṃ pravartate ..
tasyānnasya rasaṃ sarvaṃ bhuṃjāmo dvijasattama .. 36 ..
16.223.d:
.. प्रेता ऊचुः .. ..
प्राप्ते भोजनकाले तु यत्र युद्धं प्रवर्तते ..
तस्यान्नस्य रसं सर्वं भुंजामो द्विजसत्तम .. 36 ..
16.223.m: The pretas said: / “Where a quarrel begins at the time mealtime arrives, / all the essence of that food we consume, O best of brahmins.

16.223.s:
nānulipte dharāpṛṣṭhe yatra bhuṃjanti mānavāḥ ..
bhraṣṭaśaucā dvijaśreṣṭha tadasmākaṃ tu bhojanam .. 37 ..
16.223.d:
नानुलिप्ते धरापृष्ठे यत्र भुंजन्ति मानवाः ..
भ्रष्टशौचा द्विजश्रेष्ठ तदस्माकं तु भोजनम् .. 37 ..
16.223.m: Where men eat upon a ground that is not smeared [with cow dung], / having fallen from purity, O best of brahmins, that is our food.

16.223.s:
aprakṣālitapādastu yo bhuṃkte dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ ..
yo veṣṭitaśirā bhuṃkte pretā bhuṃjanti nityaśaḥ .. 38 ..
16.223.d:
अप्रक्षालितपादस्तु यो भुंक्ते दक्षिणामुखः ..
यो वेष्टितशिरा भुंक्ते प्रेता भुंजन्ति नित्यशः .. 38 ..
16.223.m: He who eats with unwashed feet facing south, / he who eats with his head covered—pretas continually consume [his food].

16.223.s:
śrāddhaṃ saṃpaśyate śvā cennārī caiva rajasvalā ..
antyajaḥ śūkaraścānnaṃ tadasmākaṃ tu bhojanam .. 39 ..
16.223.d:
श्राद्धं संपश्यते श्वा चेन्नारी चैव रजस्वला ..
अन्त्यजः शूकरश्चान्नं तदस्माकं तु भोजनम् .. 39 ..
16.223.m: If a dog, a menstruating woman, / an outcaste, or a pig looks upon a funeral offering, that food is ours to eat.

16.223.s:
tyaktvā kramāgataṃ vipraṃ pūjitaṃ prapitāmahaiḥ ..
yo dānaṃ dadate'nyasmai tasmai cā'tuṣṭacetasā .. 7.1.223.40 ..
16.223.d:
त्यक्त्वा क्रमागतं विप्रं पूजितं प्रपितामहैः ..
यो दानं ददतेऽन्यस्मै तस्मै चाऽतुष्टचेतसा .. 7.1.223.40 ..
16.223.m: Abandoning a hereditary brahmin who was honored by great-grandfathers, / whoever gives a gift to another, and to him with a dissatisfied mind—

16.223.s:
tasya dānasya yatpuṇyaṃ tadasmākaṃ prajāyate ..
yasmingṛhe sadocchiṣṭaṃ sadā ca kalaho bhavet ..
vaiśvadevavihīne tu tatra bhuṃjāmahe vayam .. 41 ..
16.223.d:
तस्य दानस्य यत्पुण्यं तदस्माकं प्रजायते ..
यस्मिन्गृहे सदोच्छिष्टं सदा च कलहो भवेत् ..
वैश्वदेवविहीने तु तत्र भुंजामहे वयम् .. 41 ..
16.223.m: whatever religious merit belongs to that gift becomes ours. / In whichever house there are always food scraps and constant strife, / and which is devoid of the Vaiśvadeva rite, there we eat.”

16.223.s:
.. gautama uvāca .. ..
yuṣmākaṃ kīdṛśe gehe praveśo na ca vidyate ..
satyaṃ vadata mā'satyaṃ satyaṃ sādhuṣu saṃgatam .. 42 ..
16.223.d:
.. गौतम उवाच .. ..
युष्माकं कीदृशे गेहे प्रवेशो न च विद्यते ..
सत्यं वदत माऽसत्यं सत्यं साधुषु संगतम् .. 42 ..
16.223.m: Gautama said: / “Into what kind of house do you have no entrance? / Tell me the truth, not falsehood; truth is fitting among good people.”

16.223.s:
.. pretā ūcuḥ .. ..
vaiśvadevodbhavā yatra dhūmavartiḥ pradṛśyate ..
tasmingehe na cāsmākaṃ praveśo vidyate dvija .. 43 ..
16.223.d:
.. प्रेता ऊचुः .. ..
वैश्वदेवोद्भवा यत्र धूमवर्तिः प्रदृश्यते ..
तस्मिन्गेहे न चास्माकं प्रवेशो विद्यते द्विज .. 43 ..
16.223.m: The pretas said: / “Where a column of smoke arising from the Vaiśvadeva rite is seen, / into that house we have no entrance, O brahmin.

16.223.s:
yasmingṛhe prabhāte tu kriyate copalepanam ..
vidyate veda nirghoṣastatrāsmākaṃ na kiṃcana .. 44 ..
16.223.d:
यस्मिन्गृहे प्रभाते तु क्रियते चोपलेपनम् ..
विद्यते वेद निर्घोषस्तत्रास्माकं न किंचन .. 44 ..
16.223.m: In the house where smearing [with cow dung] is done at dawn, / and the sound of the Veda is present, there is nothing for us.”

16.223.s:
.. gautama uvāca .. ..
kena karmavipākena pretatvaṃ vrajate naraḥ ..
etanme vistareṇaiva yathāvadvaktu marhatha .. 45 ..
16.223.d:
.. गौतम उवाच .. ..
केन कर्मविपाकेन प्रेतत्वं व्रजते नरः ..
एतन्मे विस्तरेणैव यथावद्वक्तु मर्हथ .. 45 ..
16.223.m: Gautama said: / “By what fruition of actions does a man go to the state of a preta? / You should explain this to me in full detail and properly.”

16.223.s:
.. pretā ūcuḥ .. ..
mṛṣā'pahāriṇo ye ca ye cocchiṣṭā vrajanti ca ..
gobrāhmaṇahatāścaiva pretatvaṃ te vrajanti hi .. 46 ..
16.223.d:
.. प्रेता ऊचुः .. ..
मृषाऽपहारिणो ये च ये चोच्छिष्टा व्रजन्ति च ..
गोब्राह्मणहताश्चैव प्रेतत्वं ते व्रजन्ति हि .. 46 ..
16.223.m: The pretas said: / “Those who steal falsely, those who go about defiled by food scraps, / and those killed by cows or brahmins—they indeed go to the state of a preta.

16.223.s:
paiśunyaniratā ye ca kūṭasākṣyaratā narāḥ ..
nyāyapakṣe na vartaṃte mṛtāḥ pretā bhavaṃti te .. 47 ..
16.223.d:
पैशुन्यनिरता ये च कूटसाक्ष्यरता नराः ..
न्यायपक्षे न वर्तंते मृताः प्रेता भवंति ते .. 47 ..
16.223.m: Men devoted to slander, engaged in false testimony, / who do not take the side of justice—having died, they become pretas.

16.223.s:
śleṣmamūtrapurīṣāṇi ye kṣipanti sarovare ..
pretatvaṃ te samāsādya vicaraṃti ca mānavāḥ ..48..
16.223.d:
श्लेष्ममूत्रपुरीषाणि ये क्षिपन्ति सरोवरे ..
प्रेतत्वं ते समासाद्य विचरंति च मानवाः ..48..
16.223.m: Those who throw phlegm, urine, and feces into a lake— / reaching the state of pretas, those men roam about.

16.223.s:
dīyamānaṃ tu viprāṇāṃ goṣu viprātureṣu ca ..
mā dehīti prajalpantaste ca pretā bhavaṃti ca ..49..
16.223.d:
दीयमानं तु विप्राणां गोषु विप्रातुरेषु च ..
मा देहीति प्रजल्पन्तस्ते च प्रेता भवंति च ..49..
16.223.m: Those who, when something is being given to brahmins, to cows, and to afflicted brahmins, / chatter ‘Do not give!’—they also become pretas.

16.223.s:
śūdrānnenodarasthena yadi vipro mriyeta vai ..
pretatvaṃ yātyasau nūnaṃ yadyapi syātṣaḍaṃgavit .. 7.1.223.50 ..
16.223.d:
शूद्रान्नेनोदरस्थेन यदि विप्रो म्रियेत वै ..
प्रेतत्वं यात्यसौ नूनं यद्यपि स्यात्षडंगवित् .. 7.1.223.50 ..
16.223.m: If a brahmin should die with a śūdra’s food in his belly, / he surely goes to the state of a preta, even if he knows the six limbs of the Veda.

16.223.s:
yastrīnhale balīvardānvāhayenmadasaṃyutaḥ ..
amāvāsyāṃ viśeṣeṇa sa preto jāyate naraḥ .. 51 ..
16.223.d:
यस्त्रीन्हले बलीवर्दान्वाहयेन्मदसंयुतः ..
अमावास्यां विशेषेण स प्रेतो जायते नरः .. 51 ..
16.223.m: A man who in his arrogance yokes three bullocks to a plow, / especially on the new-moon day, is born as a preta.

16.223.s:
nāstiko niṃdakaḥ kṣudro nityanaimittyavarjitaḥ ..
brāhmaṇāndveṣṭi yo nūnaṃ sa preto jāyate naraḥ .. 52 ..
16.223.d:
नास्तिको निंदकः क्षुद्रो नित्यनैमित्त्यवर्जितः ..
ब्राह्मणान्द्वेष्टि यो नूनं स प्रेतो जायते नरः .. 52 ..
16.223.m: An atheist, a reviler, a base person, one who has abandoned daily and occasional rites, / and who surely hates brahmins—that man is born as a preta.

16.223.s:
viśvāsaghātako yastu brahmahā strīvadhe rataḥ ..
goghno gurughraḥ pitṛhā sa preto jāyate naraḥ..53..
16.223.d:
विश्वासघातको यस्तु ब्रह्महा स्त्रीवधे रतः ..
गोघ्नो गुरुघ्रः पितृहा स प्रेतो जायते नरः..53..
16.223.m: A betrayer of trust, a killer of a brahmin, one bent on slaying women, / a killer of cows, a killer of his guru, a killer of his father—that man is born as a preta.

16.223.s:
yasya naiva pradattāni ekoddiṣṭāni ṣoḍaśa ..
mṛtasya na vṛṣotsargaḥ sa preto jāyate naraḥ .. 54 ..
16.223.d:
यस्य नैव प्रदत्तानि एकोद्दिष्टानि षोडश ..
मृतस्य न वृषोत्सर्गः स प्रेतो जायते नरः .. 54 ..
16.223.m: A man for whom the sixteen single-purpose funeral rites are not performed after death, / and for whom no bull is set free, is born as a preta.

16.223.s:
etaddhi sarvamākhyātaṃ yatpṛṣṭāḥ sma dvijottama ..
bhūyo brūhi dvijaśreṣṭha yaścāsti tava saṃśayaḥ .. 55 ..
16.223.d:
एतद्धि सर्वमाख्यातं यत्पृष्टाः स्म द्विजोत्तम ..
भूयो ब्रूहि द्विजश्रेष्ठ यश्चास्ति तव संशयः .. 55 ..
16.223.m: All this indeed has been told, about which we were asked, O best of brahmins. / Tell us again, O best of brahmins, whatever doubt you still have.”

16.223.s:
.. gautama uvāca .. ..
yena karmavipākenana preto jāyate naraḥ ..
tanme vadata niḥśeṣaṃ kautukaṃ me'tra vidyate .. 56 ..
16.223.d:
.. गौतम उवाच .. ..
येन कर्मविपाकेनन प्रेतो जायते नरः ..
तन्मे वदत निःशेषं कौतुकं मेऽत्र विद्यते .. 56 ..
16.223.m: Gautama said: / “By what fruition of actions is a man not born as a preta? / Tell me that completely; I have curiosity about this.”

16.223.s:
.. pretā ūcuḥ .. ..
tīrthayātrā rato yastu devārcanaparāyaṇaḥ ..
brāhmaṇeṣu sadā bhakto na preto jāyate naraḥ .. 57 ..
16.223.d:
.. प्रेता ऊचुः .. ..
तीर्थयात्रा रतो यस्तु देवार्चनपरायणः ..
ब्राह्मणेषु सदा भक्तो न प्रेतो जायते नरः .. 57 ..
16.223.m: The pretas said: / “One who is devoted to pilgrimage to sacred fords, intent on worshiping deities, / and always devoted to brahmins, that man is not born as a preta.

16.223.s:
nityaṃ śṛṇoti śāstrāṇi nityaṃ sevati paṃḍitān..
vṛddhāṃstu pṛcchate nityaṃ na sa preto vijāyate .. 58 ..
16.223.d:
नित्यं शृणोति शास्त्राणि नित्यं सेवति पंडितान्..
वृद्धांस्तु पृच्छते नित्यं न स प्रेतो विजायते .. 58 ..
16.223.m: One who constantly hears the scriptures, constantly serves learned men, / and always inquires of elders, he is not born as a preta.

16.223.s:
etasmātkāraṇātprāptā vayaṃ sarve sudūrataḥ ..
śaknumo praveṣṭuṃ ca puṇye'sminkṣetra uttame .. 59 ..
16.223.d:
एतस्मात्कारणात्प्राप्ता वयं सर्वे सुदूरतः ..
शक्नुमो प्रवेष्टुं च पुण्येऽस्मिन्क्षेत्र उत्तमे .. 59 ..
16.223.m: For this reason we have all come from a great distance; / [yet] we are unable to enter into this holy, supreme sacred field.

16.223.s:
nirviṇṇāḥ pretarūpeṇa tasmāttvaṃ dvijasattama ..
gatirbhava mahābhāga sarveṣāṃ naḥ prayatnataḥ .. 7.1.223.60 ..
16.223.d:
निर्विण्णाः प्रेतरूपेण तस्मात्त्वं द्विजसत्तम ..
गतिर्भव महाभाग सर्वेषां नः प्रयत्नतः .. 7.1.223.60 ..
16.223.m: We are despondent in the form of pretas; therefore, O best of brahmins, / O highly fortunate one, diligently become the refuge for all of us.”

16.223.s:
.. gautama uvāca .. ..
kathaṃ vo jāyate mokṣo vadadhvaṃ kṛtsnaśo mama ..
kṛpayāviṣṭacitto'haṃ yatiṣye nātra saṃśayaḥ ..61..
16.223.d:
.. गौतम उवाच .. ..
कथं वो जायते मोक्षो वदध्वं कृत्स्नशो मम ..
कृपयाविष्टचित्तोऽहं यतिष्ये नात्र संशयः ..61..
16.223.m: Gautama said: / “How does your liberation take place? Tell me completely. / My mind is filled with compassion; I will make an effort, of this there is no doubt.”

16.223.s:
.. pretā ūcuḥ .. ..
prabhūtakālamasmākaṃ pretatve tiṣṭhatāṃ vibho ..
na tvabhyeti pumānkaścidasmākaṃ yo gatirbhavet .. 62 ..
16.223.d:
.. प्रेता ऊचुः .. ..
प्रभूतकालमस्माकं प्रेतत्वे तिष्ठतां विभो ..
न त्वभ्येति पुमान्कश्चिदस्माकं यो गतिर्भवेत् .. 62 ..
16.223.m: The pretas said: / “A long time has passed as we abide in the state of pretas, O lord, / yet no man has arrived who might become our refuge.

16.223.s:
tasmāttvaṃ dehi naḥ śrāddhaṃ gatvā kṣetraṃ tu vaiṣṇavam..
nāmagotrāṇi cādāya mokṣaṃ yāsyāmahe tataḥ .. 63 .. ..
16.223.d:
तस्मात्त्वं देहि नः श्राद्धं गत्वा क्षेत्रं तु वैष्णवम्..
नामगोत्राणि चादाय मोक्षं यास्यामहे ततः .. 63 .. ..
16.223.m: Therefore, go to the sacred field of Viṣṇu and offer a funeral rite for us, / uttering our names and lineages; from that we shall attain liberation.”

16.223.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato'sau brāhmaṇo gatvā dayāviṣṭo harergṛham ..
śrāddhaṃ ca pradadau teṣāmekaikasya pṛthakpṛthak .. 64 ..
16.223.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततोऽसौ ब्राह्मणो गत्वा दयाविष्टो हरेर्गृहम् ..
श्राद्धं च प्रददौ तेषामेकैकस्य पृथक्पृथक् .. 64 ..
16.223.m: Īśvara said: / “Then that brahmin, filled with compassion, went to the temple of Hari / and offered a funeral rite for them, each one individually.

16.223.s:
yasyayasya yadā śrāddhaṃ karoti dvijasattamaḥ ..
sa rātrau svapna etyainaṃ darśane vākyamabravīt .. 65 ..
16.223.d:
यस्ययस्य यदा श्राद्धं करोति द्विजसत्तमः ..
स रात्रौ स्वप्न एत्यैनं दर्शने वाक्यमब्रवीत् .. 65 ..
16.223.m: For whichever of them and whenever the best of brahmins performed a funeral rite, / he came to him in a dream at night and, having appeared, spoke these words:

16.223.s:
prasādāttava viprendra mukto'haṃ pretayonitaḥ ..
svasti te'stu gamiṣyāmi vimānaṃ me hyupasthitam .. 66 ..
16.223.d:
प्रसादात्तव विप्रेन्द्र मुक्तोऽहं प्रेतयोनितः ..
स्वस्ति तेऽस्तु गमिष्यामि विमानं मे ह्युपस्थितम् .. 66 ..
16.223.m: ‘By your favor, O lord among brahmins, I am freed from the ghostly state. / May there be welfare for you; I shall depart, for my aerial chariot has arrived.’

16.223.s: evaṃ saṃtāritāstena catvāraste dvijottamāḥ .. 67 ..
16.223.d: एवं संतारितास्तेन चत्वारस्ते द्विजोत्तमाः .. 67 ..
16.223.m: Thus those four best of brahmins were delivered by him.

16.223.s:
athāsau brāhmaṇaśreṣṭhaḥ saṃprāpte pañcame dine ..
pradadau vidhipūrvaṃ tu śrāddhaṃ paryuṣitasya ca .. 68 ..
16.223.d:
अथासौ ब्राह्मणश्रेष्ठः संप्राप्ते पञ्चमे दिने ..
प्रददौ विधिपूर्वं तु श्राद्धं पर्युषितस्य च .. 68 ..
16.223.m: Then, when the fifth day arrived, that best of brahmins / performed the śrāddha for Paryuṣita according to the rules.

16.223.s:
athāpaśyata svapnānte prāptaṃ paryuṣitaṃ naram ..
dīnavākyaṃ parikliṣṭaṃ niḥśvasantaṃ muhurmuhuḥ .. 69.. ..
16.223.d:
अथापश्यत स्वप्नान्ते प्राप्तं पर्युषितं नरम् ..
दीनवाक्यं परिक्लिष्टं निःश्वसन्तं मुहुर्मुहुः .. 69.. ..
16.223.m: Then, at the end of a dream, he saw the man Paryuṣita arrive, / speaking piteous words, afflicted with distress, and sighing repeatedly.

16.223.s:
.. paryuṣita uvāca .. ..
na me jātā gatirvipra maṃdabhāgyasya pāpinaḥ ..
mayā hṛtaṃ taḍāgārthaṃ yadvittaṃ praguṇīkṛtam .. 7.1.223.70 ..
16.223.d:
.. पर्युषित उवाच .. ..
न मे जाता गतिर्विप्र मंदभाग्यस्य पापिनः ..
मया हृतं तडागार्थं यद्वित्तं प्रगुणीकृतम् .. 7.1.223.70 ..
16.223.m: Paryuṣita said: / "No liberation has come to me, O brahmin, ill-fated and sinful as I am. / I took for myself the wealth collected for the sake of a water-reservoir.

16.223.s:
.. gautama uvāca .. ..
kathaṃ te jāyate mokṣo vada śīghramaśeṣataḥ ..
kariṣye nātra saṃdeho yadyapi syātsudurlabham .. 71 ..
16.223.d:
.. गौतम उवाच .. ..
कथं ते जायते मोक्षो वद शीघ्रमशेषतः ..
करिष्ये नात्र संदेहो यद्यपि स्यात्सुदुर्लभम् .. 71 ..
16.223.m: Gautama said: / 'Tell me fully and at once: how can your liberation come about? / I will do it, without any doubt, even if it should be exceedingly difficult to attain.'

16.223.s:
.. paryuṣita uvāca .. ...
ayane cottare prāpte gatvā tīrthaṃ haripriyam ..
śrāddhaṃ tvaṃ dehi me nūnaṃ tato gatirbhaviṣyati .. 72 ..
16.223.d:
.. पर्युषित उवाच .. ...
अयने चोत्तरे प्राप्ते गत्वा तीर्थं हरिप्रियम् ..
श्राद्धं त्वं देहि मे नूनं ततो गतिर्भविष्यति .. 72 ..
16.223.m: Paryuṣita said: / 'When the northern transit of the sun arrives, go to the sacred ford beloved of Hari / and surely offer a śrāddha for me; then liberation will take place for me.'

16.223.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
evamuktaḥ sa viprendrastena pretena vai muniḥ ..
ayane cottare prāpte gatvā tīrthaṃ haripriyam ..
pradadau vidhivacchrāddhaṃ tataḥ paryuṣitāya ca .. 73 ..
16.223.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
एवमुक्तः स विप्रेन्द्रस्तेन प्रेतेन वै मुनिः ..
अयने चोत्तरे प्राप्ते गत्वा तीर्थं हरिप्रियम् ..
प्रददौ विधिवच्छ्राद्धं ततः पर्युषिताय च .. 73 ..
16.223.m: Īśvara said: / Addressed in this way by that ghost, the sage, that best of brahmins, / when the northern transit arrived, went to the sacred ford beloved of Hari / and then duly offered the śrāddha for Paryuṣita.

16.223.s:
tataḥ paryuṣito rātrau svapnānte vākyamabravīt ..
prasannavadano bhūtvā divyamālyavapurdharaḥ .. 74 ..
16.223.d:
ततः पर्युषितो रात्रौ स्वप्नान्ते वाक्यमब्रवीत् ..
प्रसन्नवदनो भूत्वा दिव्यमाल्यवपुर्धरः .. 74 ..
16.223.m: Then at night, at the end of a dream, Paryuṣita spoke these words, / having a cheerful countenance and bearing a celestial garland and body:

16.223.s:
.. paryuṣita uvāca .. ..
mukto'haṃ tvatprasādena pretabhāvāddvijottama ..
svasti te'stu gamiṣyāmi vimānaṃ me hyupasthitam .. 75 ..
16.223.d:
.. पर्युषित उवाच .. ..
मुक्तोऽहं त्वत्प्रसादेन प्रेतभावाद्द्विजोत्तम ..
स्वस्ति तेऽस्तु गमिष्यामि विमानं मे ह्युपस्थितम् .. 75 ..
16.223.m: Paryuṣita said: / 'O best of brahmins, by your grace I am released from the state of a ghost. / May you fare well; I shall depart, for an aerial chariot has indeed arrived for me.

16.223.s:
devatvaṃ ca mayā prāptaṃ samartho'haṃ dvijottama ..
varaṃ dadāmi te vipra gṛhāṇa tvaṃ varaṃ śubham .. 76 ..
16.223.d:
देवत्वं च मया प्राप्तं समर्थोऽहं द्विजोत्तम ..
वरं ददामि ते विप्र गृहाण त्वं वरं शुभम् .. 76 ..
16.223.m: And I have attained divinity; I am capable [of granting boons], O best of brahmins. / I will give you a boon, O brahmin; accept an auspicious boon!

16.223.s:
brahmaghne ca surāpe ca caure bhagnavrate tathā ..
niṣkṛtirvihitā sadbhiḥ kṛtaghne nāsti niṣkṛtiḥ .. 77 ..
16.223.d:
ब्रह्मघ्ने च सुरापे च चौरे भग्नव्रते तथा ..
निष्कृतिर्विहिता सद्भिः कृतघ्ने नास्ति निष्कृतिः .. 77 ..
16.223.m: An expiation has been prescribed by the virtuous for the slayer of a brahmin, the drinker of liquor, / the thief, and likewise the breaker of vows; but there is no expiation for an ungrateful person.'

16.223.s:
.. gautama uvāca .. ..
yadi deyo varo'smākaṃ samartho'si varaprada ..
yatra sthāne mayā dṛṣṭāḥ pretā yūyaṃ suduḥkhitāḥ ..
tatrāhaṃ cāśramaṃ kṛtvā kariṣye cottamaṃ tapaḥ .. 78 ..
16.223.d:
.. गौतम उवाच .. ..
यदि देयो वरोऽस्माकं समर्थोऽसि वरप्रद ..
यत्र स्थाने मया दृष्टाः प्रेता यूयं सुदुःखिताः ..
तत्राहं चाश्रमं कृत्वा करिष्ये चोत्तमं तपः .. 78 ..
16.223.m: Gautama said: / 'If a boon is to be given to me, since you are able to grant a boon, O giver of boons: / at the place where you ghosts were seen by me in great distress, / having built a hermitage there, I shall perform supreme austerity.

16.223.s:
nirgatāsmi gṛhaṃ bhūyo snātvā tīrthamidaṃ mahat ..
tatra yo bhānavo bhaktyā pitṝnuddiśya bhaktitaḥ .. 79 ..
16.223.d:
निर्गतास्मि गृहं भूयो स्नात्वा तीर्थमिदं महत् ..
तत्र यो भानवो भक्त्या पितॄनुद्दिश्य भक्तितः .. 79 ..
16.223.m: [Though] I have left home again, having bathed in this great sacred ford, / whichever human beings there, out of devotion, aiming at their ancestors with devotion,

16.223.s:
vidhivaddāsyati śrāddhaṃ snātvā saṃtarpya devatāḥ ..
yuṣmatprasādatastasya hyanvaye'pi kadācana ..
mā bhūyātpretabhāvo hi api pāpānvitasya bhoḥ .. 7.1.223.80 ..
16.223.d:
विधिवद्दास्यति श्राद्धं स्नात्वा संतर्प्य देवताः ..
युष्मत्प्रसादतस्तस्य ह्यन्वयेऽपि कदाचन ..
मा भूयात्प्रेतभावो हि अपि पापान्वितस्य भोः .. 7.1.223.80 ..
16.223.m: shall offer a śrāddha according to the rules, after bathing and propitiating the gods— / by your grace, even in his lineage, / let there never be the state of a ghost, O sir, even for one possessed of sin!'

16.223.s:
.. paryuṣita uvāca .. ..
gaccha tvaṃ cāśramaṃ tatra kuru brāhmaṇasattama ..
gamiṣyasi parāṃ siddhiṃ loke khyātiṃ gamiṣyasi .. 81 ..
16.223.d:
.. पर्युषित उवाच .. ..
गच्छ त्वं चाश्रमं तत्र कुरु ब्राह्मणसत्तम ..
गमिष्यसि परां सिद्धिं लोके ख्यातिं गमिष्यसि .. 81 ..
16.223.m: Paryuṣita said: / 'Go, O best of brahmins, and make a hermitage there! / You will attain supreme perfection; you will attain renown in the world.

16.223.s:
tatra ye mānavā bhaktyā śrāddhaṃ dāsyaṃti sattamāḥ ..
pitṝṇāṃ te vimānasthā yāsyaṃti tridivālayam .. 82 ..
16.223.d:
तत्र ये मानवा भक्त्या श्राद्धं दास्यंति सत्तमाः ..
पितॄणां ते विमानस्था यास्यंति त्रिदिवालयम् .. 82 ..
16.223.m: Those excellent human beings who faithfully offer a śrāddha there / to their ancestors shall go, mounted on aerial chariots, to the heavenly abode.

16.223.s:
na teṣāṃ vaṃśajaḥ kaścitpretatvaṃ ca gamiṣyati ..
prāhuḥ saptapadīṃ maitrīṃ paṃḍitāḥ sthirabuddhayaḥ .. 83 ..
16.223.d:
न तेषां वंशजः कश्चित्प्रेतत्वं च गमिष्यति ..
प्राहुः सप्तपदीं मैत्रीं पंडिताः स्थिरबुद्धयः .. 83 ..
16.223.m: None born in their lineage shall ever go to the state of a ghost. / Wise men of steady intellect proclaim that friendship is formed within seven steps.

16.223.s:
mitratāṃ tu puraskṛtya kiṃ tadvakṣyāmi tacchṛṇu ..
tavāśramapadaṃ puṇyaṃ bhaviṣyati mahītale .. 84 ..
16.223.d:
मित्रतां तु पुरस्कृत्य किं तद्वक्ष्यामि तच्छृणु ..
तवाश्रमपदं पुण्यं भविष्यति महीतले .. 84 ..
16.223.m: Placing friendship foremost, hear what I shall say to you: / your hermitage-ground will become sacred upon the surface of the earth,

16.223.s:
sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ sarvaduḥkhavi nāśanam ..
mannāmnā khyātimāyātu pretatīrthamiti prabho .. 85 ..
16.223.d:
सर्वपापप्रशमनं सर्वदुःखवि नाशनम् ..
मन्नाम्ना ख्यातिमायातु प्रेततीर्थमिति प्रभो .. 85 ..
16.223.m: pacifying all sins and destroying all sorrows. / O lord, let it become renowned by my name as "Pretatīrtha"!'

16.223.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
taṃ tatheti pratijñāya gatastatra dvijottamaḥ ..
yathā vedoktamārgeṃṇa sarvaṃ kṛtyaṃ cakāra saḥ .. 86 ..
16.223.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
तं तथेति प्रतिज्ञाय गतस्तत्र द्विजोत्तमः ..
यथा वेदोक्तमार्गेंण सर्वं कृत्यं चकार सः .. 86 ..
16.223.m: Īśvara said: / Consenting to that, saying, 'So be it,' that best of brahmins went there; / he performed every rite according to the path declared in the Veda.

16.223.s:
so'pi svargamanuprāpto hṛṣṭaḥ paryuṣitaḥ priye ..
etatsarvaṃ purāvṛttaṃ sthāne'smingātramocane .. 87 ..
16.223.d:
सोऽपि स्वर्गमनुप्राप्तो हृष्टः पर्युषितः प्रिये ..
एतत्सर्वं पुरावृत्तं स्थानेऽस्मिन्गात्रमोचने .. 87 ..
16.223.m: He too, Paryuṣita, reached heaven rejoiced, O dear one. / All this took place formerly at this place [named] Gātramocana.

16.223.s:
yaḥ śṛṇoti naraḥ samyaksarvapāpaiḥ sa mucyate ..
śayanotthāpane yoge yaḥ paśyetpuruṣottamam ..
gātrotsarge tu gatvā'sau yajñāyutaphalaṃ labhet .. 88 ..
16.223.d:
यः शृणोति नरः सम्यक्सर्वपापैः स मुच्यते ..
शयनोत्थापने योगे यः पश्येत्पुरुषोत्तमम् ..
गात्रोत्सर्गे तु गत्वाऽसौ यज्ञायुतफलं लभेत् .. 88 ..
16.223.m: A person who hears this properly is freed from all sins. / One who sees Puruṣottama at the conjunction of his going to sleep and waking up, / having gone to Gātrotsarga, would obtain the fruit of ten thousand sacrifices.

16.223.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye puruṣottamatīrthapretatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma trayoviṃśatyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 223 ..
16.223.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये पुरुषोत्तमतीर्थप्रेततीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम त्रयोविंशत्युत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 223 ..
16.223.m: Thus ends the two hundred and twenty-third chapter, named 'Description of the Glory of Puruṣottamatīrtha and Pretatīrtha', in the first [part], 'Glory of Prabhāsakṣetra', in the seventh [book], Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, of the venerable Skandapurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses]. // 223

16.224.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi liṃgamiṃdrapratiṣṭhitam ..
pāpamocananāmāḍhyaṃ dakṣiṇe puruṣottamāt.. 1 ..
16.224.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि लिंगमिंद्रप्रतिष्ठितम् ..
पापमोचननामाढ्यं दक्षिणे पुरुषोत्तमात्.. 1 ..
16.224.m: Īśvara said: / Then, O great goddess, one should go to the liṅga installed by Indra, / richly endowed with the name Pāpamocana, south of Puruṣottama.

16.224.s:
vṛtraṃ hatvā purā śakro brahmahatyāsamanvitaḥ ..
abravītsa ṛṣīndivyānkathameṣā gamiṣyati .. 2 ..
16.224.d:
वृत्रं हत्वा पुरा शक्रो ब्रह्महत्यासमन्वितः ..
अब्रवीत्स ऋषीन्दिव्यान्कथमेषा गमिष्यति .. 2 ..
16.224.m: Long ago, having slain Vṛtra, Śakra, joined with [the sin of] brahmin-slaughter, / said to the divine seers: 'How will this go away?

16.224.s:
brahmahatyā hi duṣprekṣyā vivarṇajananī mama ..
durgaṃdhacāriṇī caiva sarvatejovināśinī .. 3 ..
16.224.d:
ब्रह्महत्या हि दुष्प्रेक्ष्या विवर्णजननी मम ..
दुर्गंधचारिणी चैव सर्वतेजोविनाशिनी .. 3 ..
16.224.m: Indeed, brahmin-slaughter is dreadful to behold, causing discoloration in me, / moving with a foul smell, and destroying all brilliance.'

16.224.s:
athocustaṃ suragaṇā nāradādyā maharṣayaḥ ..
prabhāsaṃ gaccha deveśa kṣetraṃ pāpaharaṃ hi tat .. 4 ..
16.224.d:
अथोचुस्तं सुरगणा नारदाद्या महर्षयः ..
प्रभासं गच्छ देवेश क्षेत्रं पापहरं हि तत् .. 4 ..
16.224.m: Then the hosts of gods and the great seers headed by Nārada said to him: / 'Go to Prabhāsa, O lord of gods, for that is a sacred field that takes away sins.

16.224.s:
tatrārādhya mahādevaṃ mokṣyase brahmahatyayā ..
sa tatheti pratijñāya gatastatra varānane .. 5 ..
16.224.d:
तत्राराध्य महादेवं मोक्ष्यसे ब्रह्महत्यया ..
स तथेति प्रतिज्ञाय गतस्तत्र वरानने .. 5 ..
16.224.m: Having worshipped Mahādeva there, you will be freed from brahmin-slaughter.' / Promising, 'So be it,' he went there, O lovely-faced one.

16.224.s:
liṃgaṃ saṃsthāpayāmāsa devadevasya śūlinaḥ ..
tasya pūjārato nityaṃ dhūpagaṃdhānulepanaiḥ .. 6 ..
16.224.d:
लिंगं संस्थापयामास देवदेवस्य शूलिनः ..
तस्य पूजारतो नित्यं धूपगंधानुलेपनैः .. 6 ..
16.224.m: He established a liṅga of the god of gods, the wielder of the trident; / he was constantly devoted to its worship with incenses, scents, and ointments.

16.224.s:
tato'sya gātradaurgaṃdhyaṃ nāśamāśvabhyagacchata ..
vivarṇatvaṃ gataṃ sarvaṃ vapuścābhūttathottamam.. 7 ..
16.224.d:
ततोऽस्य गात्रदौर्गंध्यं नाशमाश्वभ्यगच्छत ..
विवर्णत्वं गतं सर्वं वपुश्चाभूत्तथोत्तमम्.. 7 ..
16.224.m: Then the foul smell of his body quickly went to destruction; / all his discoloration vanished, and his body became supreme.

16.224.s:
atha hṛṣṭamanā bhūtvā vākyametaduvāca ha ..
tatrāgatya naro bhaktyā yaścainaṃ pūjayiṣyati .. 8 ..
16.224.d:
अथ हृष्टमना भूत्वा वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह ..
तत्रागत्य नरो भक्त्या यश्चैनं पूजयिष्यति .. 8 ..
16.224.m: Then, becoming joyful in mind, he spoke these words: / 'Whichever person, having come here, worships this [liṅga] with devotion,

16.224.s:
brahmahatyādikaṃ pāpaṃ nāśaṃ tasya prayāsyati ..
evamuktvā sahasrākṣaḥ prahṛṣṭastridivaṃ yayau .. 9 ..
16.224.d:
ब्रह्महत्यादिकं पापं नाशं तस्य प्रयास्यति ..
एवमुक्त्वा सहस्राक्षः प्रहृष्टस्त्रिदिवं ययौ .. 9 ..
16.224.m: his sin consisting of brahmin-slaughter and the like will go to destruction.' / Having spoken thus, the thousand-eyed [Indra], exceedingly glad, went to heaven,

16.224.s:
brahmahatyāvinirmuktaḥ pūjyamāno divaukasaiḥ ..
godānaṃ tatra dātavyaṃ brāhmaṇe vedapārage ..
brahmahatyāpanodārthaṃ tatra śrāddhaṃ samācaret .. 7.1.224.10 ..
16.224.d:
ब्रह्महत्याविनिर्मुक्तः पूज्यमानो दिवौकसैः ..
गोदानं तत्र दातव्यं ब्राह्मणे वेदपारगे ..
ब्रह्महत्यापनोदार्थं तत्र श्राद्धं समाचरेत् .. 7.1.224.10 ..
16.224.m: freed from brahmin-slaughter and worshipped by the denizens of heaven. / The gift of a cow is to be given there to a brahmin who has mastered the Vedas; / to remove brahmin-slaughter, one should perform a śrāddha there.

16.224.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya indreśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma caturviṃśatyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 224 ..
16.224.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्य इन्द्रेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम चतुर्विंशत्युत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 224 ..
16.224.m: Thus ends the two hundred and twenty-fourth chapter, named 'Description of the Glory of Indreśvara', in the first [part], 'Glory of Prabhāsakṣetra', in the seventh [book], Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, of the venerable Skandapurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses]. // 224

16.225.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tatogacchenmahādevi devaṃ cā'narakeśvaram..
tasmāduttaradigbhāge sarvapātakanāśanam ..
tanmāhātmyaṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu hyekamanāḥ priye .. 1..
16.225.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततोगच्छेन्महादेवि देवं चाऽनरकेश्वरम्..
तस्मादुत्तरदिग्भागे सर्वपातकनाशनम् ..
तन्माहात्म्यं प्रवक्ष्यामि शृणु ह्येकमनाः प्रिये .. 1..
16.225.m: Īśvara said: / Then, O great goddess, one should go to the god Anarakeśvara, / in the northern direction from that, destroying all sins. / I shall declare its glory; hear with a single-minded focus, O dear one!

16.225.s:
mathurānāma vikhyātā nagarī dharaṇītale..
tatra vipro'bhavatpūrvaṃ devaśarmeti viśrutaḥ ..
agastyagotro vidvānvai sa tu dāridryapīḍitaḥ .. 2 ..
16.225.d:
मथुरानाम विख्याता नगरी धरणीतले..
तत्र विप्रोऽभवत्पूर्वं देवशर्मेति विश्रुतः ..
अगस्त्यगोत्रो विद्वान्वै स तु दारिद्र्यपीडितः .. 2 ..
16.225.m: There was a city named Mathurā renowned upon the earth's surface. / There was a brahmin there formerly known as Devaśarman, / belonging to the gotra of Agastya, learned indeed, but afflicted by poverty.

16.225.s:
athāparo'bhavattatra tādṛgrūpavayo'nvitaḥ ..
tannāma gotro deveśi brāhmaṇo vedapāragaḥ .. 3 ..
16.225.d:
अथापरोऽभवत्तत्र तादृग्रूपवयोऽन्वितः ..
तन्नाम गोत्रो देवेशि ब्राह्मणो वेदपारगः .. 3 ..
16.225.m: Then another [brahmin] lived there, endowed with a similar form and age, / of the same name and gotra, O goddess of gods, a brahmin who had mastered the Vedas.

16.225.s:
atha prāha yamo dūtaṃ raudramūrdhaśiroruham ..
gaccha bho mathurāṃ śīghraṃ devaśarmāṇamānaya .. 4 ..
16.225.d:
अथ प्राह यमो दूतं रौद्रमूर्धशिरोरुहम् ..
गच्छ भो मथुरां शीघ्रं देवशर्माणमानय .. 4 ..
16.225.m: Then Yama said to his messenger, whose hair stood up terribly on his head: / "Go at once to Mathurā, friend, and bring Devaśarman!"

16.225.s:
athāgatya tato dūto gṛhītvā tatra vai gataḥ ..
taṃ dṛṣṭvātha yamo natvā prāha dūtaṃ krudhānvitaḥ .. 5 ..
16.225.d:
अथागत्य ततो दूतो गृहीत्वा तत्र वै गतः ..
तं दृष्ट्वाथ यमो नत्वा प्राह दूतं क्रुधान्वितः .. 5 ..
16.225.m: Having arrived there, the messenger seized him and went back. / Seeing him, Yama bowed [to the brahmin], and then, filled with anger, said to the messenger:

16.225.s:
nāyamānetumādiṣṭo devaśarmāṃ mayā tava ..
anyosti devaśarmā yasta mānaya gatāyuṣam ..
enaṃ vipraṃ ca dīrghāyuṃ naya tatrāvilaṃbitam .. 6 ..
16.225.d:
नायमानेतुमादिष्टो देवशर्मां मया तव ..
अन्योस्ति देवशर्मा यस्त मानय गतायुषम् ..
एनं विप्रं च दीर्घायुं नय तत्राविलंबितम् .. 6 ..
16.225.m: "This Devaśarman was not commanded by me for you to bring! / There is another Devaśarman whose lifespan is finished—bring him! / And lead this long-lived brahmin back there without delay!"

16.225.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
athābravīdbrāhmaṇo vai nāhaṃ yāsye gṛhaṃ vibho ..
dāridryeṇātinirviṇṇo yāvajjīvaṃ sureśvara ..
ihaiva kṣapayiṣyāmi śeṣamāyustavāṃtike .. 7 ..
16.225.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
अथाब्रवीद्ब्राह्मणो वै नाहं यास्ये गृहं विभो ..
दारिद्र्येणातिनिर्विण्णो यावज्जीवं सुरेश्वर ..
इहैव क्षपयिष्यामि शेषमायुस्तवांतिके .. 7 ..
16.225.m: Īśvara said: / Then the brahmin said: "Lord, I will not go home. / Despondent on account of extreme poverty as long as I live, O lord of gods, / I shall spend the remainder of my life right here in your presence."

16.225.s:
.. yama uvāca .. ..
akāle nātra cāyāti kaścidbrāhmaṇasattama ..
muhūrtamapi no jīvetpūrṇakālena vai bhuvi .. 8 ..
16.225.d:
.. यम उवाच .. ..
अकाले नात्र चायाति कश्चिद्ब्राह्मणसत्तम ..
मुहूर्तमपि नो जीवेत्पूर्णकालेन वै भुवि .. 8 ..
16.225.m: Yama said: / "No one comes here before their time, O best of brahmins! / Nor can one whose time is finished live on earth even for an instant.

16.225.s: ata eva hi me nāma dharmarājeti viśrutam .. 9 ..
16.225.d: अत एव हि मे नाम धर्मराजेति विश्रुतम् .. 9 ..
16.225.m: For this very reason my name is renowned as Dharmarāja.

16.225.s:
na me suhṛnna me dveṣyaḥ kaścidasti dharātale ..
viddhaḥ śaraśatenāpi nā'kāle mriyate yataḥ .. 7.1.225.10 ..
16.225.d:
न मे सुहृन्न मे द्वेष्यः कश्चिदस्ति धरातले ..
विद्धः शरशतेनापि नाऽकाले म्रियते यतः .. 7.1.225.10 ..
16.225.m: I have no friend and no enemy on the surface of the earth. / For even pierced by a hundred arrows, one does not die before one's time;

16.225.s:
kuśāgreṇāpi viddhaḥ sankāle pūrṇe na jīvati ..
tasmādgaccha dvijaśreṣṭha yāvadgātraṃ na dahyate .. 11 ..
16.225.d:
कुशाग्रेणापि विद्धः सन्काले पूर्णे न जीवति ..
तस्माद्गच्छ द्विजश्रेष्ठ यावद्गात्रं न दह्यते .. 11 ..
16.225.m: yet even pierced by the tip of a kuśa blade, one does not live when one's time is full. / Therefore go, O best of the twice-born, before your body is cremated!"

16.225.s:
athābravīdbrāhmaṇo'sau yadi preṣayase prabho ..
praśnamekaṃ mayā pṛṣṭo yathāvadvaktumarhasi .. 12 ..
16.225.d:
अथाब्रवीद्ब्राह्मणोऽसौ यदि प्रेषयसे प्रभो ..
प्रश्नमेकं मया पृष्टो यथावद्वक्तुमर्हसि .. 12 ..
16.225.m: Then that brahmin said: "If you send me away, O lord, / you ought to answer properly one question asked by me.

16.225.s:
na vṛthā jāyate deva sādhūnāṃ darśanaṃ kvacit ..
yuṣmākaṃ ca viśeṣeṇa tasmādetadbravīmyaham .. 13 ..
16.225.d:
न वृथा जायते देव साधूनां दर्शनं क्वचित् ..
युष्माकं च विशेषेण तस्मादेतद्ब्रवीम्यहम् .. 13 ..
16.225.m: The darśana of good people is never in vain, O god, / and especially yours; therefore I say this:

16.225.s:
ete ye narakā raudrā dṛśyante ca sudāruṇāḥ ..
karmaṇā kena kaṃ gacchenmānavo narakaṃ yama .. 14 ..
16.225.d:
एते ये नरका रौद्रा दृश्यन्ते च सुदारुणाः ..
कर्मणा केन कं गच्छेन्मानवो नरकं यम .. 14 ..
16.225.m: These terrible and exceedingly dreadful hells that are seen— / by what deed would a human go to which hell, O Yama?

16.225.s:
kati saṃkhyāḥ syurete ca narakāḥ kiṃpramāṇataḥ ..
etatsarvaṃ suraśreṣṭha yathāvadvaktumarhasi .. 15 ..
16.225.d:
कति संख्याः स्युरेते च नरकाः किंप्रमाणतः ..
एतत्सर्वं सुरश्रेष्ठ यथावद्वक्तुमर्हसि .. 15 ..
16.225.m: How many in number are these hells, and of what measure? / You ought to tell all this truly, O best of gods!"

16.225.s:
.. yama uvāca .. ..
śṛṇu deva pravakṣyāmi yāvanto narakāḥ sthitāḥ ..
karmaṇā yena gaccheta mānavo dvijasattama ..
ekaviṃśatsamākhyātā narakā mama mandire .. 16 ..
16.225.d:
.. यम उवाच .. ..
शृणु देव प्रवक्ष्यामि यावन्तो नरकाः स्थिताः ..
कर्मणा येन गच्छेत मानवो द्विजसत्तम ..
एकविंशत्समाख्याता नरका मम मन्दिरे .. 16 ..
16.225.m: Yama said: / "Listen, O noble one, I shall tell how many hells exist, / and by what deed a human would go [there], O best of brahmins. / Twenty-one hells are proclaimed in my abode.

16.225.s:
yānetānprekṣase vipra yaṃtra madhye vyavasthitān ..
pīḍyamānānkiṃkarairme kṛtaghnānpā pasaṃyutān .. 17 ..
16.225.d:
यानेतान्प्रेक्षसे विप्र यंत्र मध्ये व्यवस्थितान् ..
पीड्यमानान्किंकरैर्मे कृतघ्नान्पा पसंयुतान् .. 17 ..
16.225.m: Those ungrateful, sin-laden ones whom you see, O brahmin, placed inside mechanical presses / and being tormented by my servants—

16.225.s:
lohāsyavāyasā yeṣāṃ netroddhāraṃ prakurvate ..
etairnirīkṣitānyeva kalatrāṇi durātmabhiḥ .. 18 ..
16.225.d:
लोहास्यवायसा येषां नेत्रोद्धारं प्रकुर्वते ..
एतैर्निरीक्षितान्येव कलत्राणि दुरात्मभिः .. 18 ..
16.225.m: whose eyes iron-beaked crows gouge out— / those evil-minded ones looked upon

16.225.s:
pareṣāṃ dvijaśārdūla sarāgaiḥ pāpi bhiḥ sadā ..
kumbhīpākagatānetānatha paśyasi pāpinaḥ .. 19 ..
16.225.d:
परेषां द्विजशार्दूल सरागैः पापि भिः सदा ..
कुम्भीपाकगतानेतानथ पश्यसि पापिनः .. 19 ..
16.225.m: the wives of others with lust, O tiger among the twice-born, sinners always. / And now you see these sinners who have entered Kumbhīpāka:

16.225.s:
kūṭasākṣyaratā hyete kaṭuvāṅniratāstathā ..
ete lohamayāstambhānsaṃtaptānpāvakapra bhān .. 7.1.225.20 ..
16.225.d:
कूटसाक्ष्यरता ह्येते कटुवाङ्निरतास्तथा ..
एते लोहमयास्तम्भान्संतप्तान्पावकप्र भान् .. 7.1.225.20 ..
16.225.m: they were engaged in false testimony and devoted to harsh speech. / Those who embrace these iron pillars glowing like fire,

16.225.s:
āliṃgaṃti durātmānaḥ paradāraratāstu ye ..
ete vaitaraṇīmadhye pūyaśoṇitasaṃkule .. 21 ..
16.225.d:
आलिंगंति दुरात्मानः परदाररतास्तु ये ..
एते वैतरणीमध्ये पूयशोणितसंकुले .. 21 ..
16.225.m: those evil-minded ones were devoted to the wives of others. / Those who stand in the midst of the Vaitaraṇī, packed with pus and blood,

16.225.s:
ye tiṣṭhaṃti dvijaśreṣṭha sarve viśvāsaghātakāḥ ..
asipatravane ghore bhidyante ye tu khaṇḍaśaḥ ..
te naṣṭāḥ svāminaṃ tyaktvā saṃgrāme samupasthite .. 22 ..
16.225.d:
ये तिष्ठंति द्विजश्रेष्ठ सर्वे विश्वासघातकाः ..
असिपत्रवने घोरे भिद्यन्ते ये तु खण्डशः ..
ते नष्टाः स्वामिनं त्यक्त्वा संग्रामे समुपस्थिते .. 22 ..
16.225.m: all of them are betrayers of trust, O best of the twice-born. / Those who are cut to pieces in the terrifying Asipatravana / ran away, abandoning their master when battle was joined.

16.225.s:
aṃgārarāśīnvai dīptānye gāhante narādhamāḥ ..
svāmidroharatā hyete tathā hetupravādakāḥ .. 23 ..
16.225.d:
अंगारराशीन्वै दीप्तान्ये गाहन्ते नराधमाः ..
स्वामिद्रोहरता ह्येते तथा हेतुप्रवादकाः .. 23 ..
16.225.m: The vile men who plunge into heaps of blazing charcoal / were devoted to treachery against their masters and were sophists.

16.225.s:
lohaśaṃkubhirākīrṇamākramanti narādhamāḥ ..
krandamānā dvijaśreṣṭha upānaddānavarjitāḥ .. 24 ..
16.225.d:
लोहशंकुभिराकीर्णमाक्रमन्ति नराधमाः ..
क्रन्दमाना द्विजश्रेष्ठ उपानद्दानवर्जिताः .. 24 ..
16.225.m: Vile men, wailing, tread upon [ground] / strewn with iron spikes, O best of the twice-born, [because] they never gave the gift of shoes.

16.225.s:
adhomukhā nibaddhā ye vṛkṣāgre pāvakopari ..
brahmahatyānvitāḥ sarva ete caiva narādhamāḥ .. 25 ..
16.225.d:
अधोमुखा निबद्धा ये वृक्षाग्रे पावकोपरि ..
ब्रह्महत्यान्विताः सर्व एते चैव नराधमाः .. 25 ..
16.225.m: Those who are bound head-downwards at the top of a tree above fire / are all vile men guilty of killing a brahmin.

16.225.s:
maśakairmatkuṇaiḥ kākairye bhakṣyaṃte vihaṃgamaiḥ ..
vratabhaṃgaratā hyete vratinā caiva hiṃsakāḥ .. 26 ..
16.225.d:
मशकैर्मत्कुणैः काकैर्ये भक्ष्यंते विहंगमैः ..
व्रतभंगरता ह्येते व्रतिना चैव हिंसकाः .. 26 ..
16.225.m: Those who are eaten by mosquitoes, bedbugs, crows, and birds / were devoted to breaking vows and harmed those observing vows.

16.225.s:
kuṭhārakaṇṭhitā hyete bhūyaḥ saṃti tathāvidhāḥ ..
gohantāro durātmāno devabrāhmaṇāniṃdakā .. 27 ..
16.225.d:
कुठारकण्ठिता ह्येते भूयः संति तथाविधाः ..
गोहन्तारो दुरात्मानो देवब्राह्मणानिंदका .. 27 ..
16.225.m: Those whose throats are struck with axes are also of such a kind: / evil-minded slayers of cows and revilers of gods and brahmins.

16.225.s:
ye bhakṣyaṃte śṛgālaiśca vṛkairlohamayairmukhaiḥ ..
parasvānāṃ ca hartāraḥ parastrīṇāṃ ca hartṛkāḥ ..
ātmamāṃsāni ye pāpā bhakṣayaṃti bubhukṣitāḥ .. .. 28 ..
16.225.d:
ये भक्ष्यंते शृगालैश्च वृकैर्लोहमयैर्मुखैः ..
परस्वानां च हर्तारः परस्त्रीणां च हर्तृकाः ..
आत्ममांसानि ये पापा भक्षयंति बुभुक्षिताः .. .. 28 ..
16.225.m: Those who are devoured by jackals and wolves with iron jaws / are stealers of others' wealth and stealers of others' wives. / Those sinners who, starving, eat their own flesh,

16.225.s:
na dattamannametaistu kadācidvai dvijottama ..
rudhiraṃ ye pibaṃtyete vasāpūyapariplutam ..
brāhmaṇānāṃ vināśāya gavāmete sadā sthitāḥ .. .. 29 ..
16.225.d:
न दत्तमन्नमेतैस्तु कदाचिद्वै द्विजोत्तम ..
रुधिरं ये पिबंत्येते वसापूयपरिप्लुतम् ..
ब्राह्मणानां विनाशाय गवामेते सदा स्थिताः .. .. 29 ..
16.225.m: never gave food, O best of brahmins. / Those who drink blood overflowing with fat and pus / always stood for the destruction of brahmins and cows.

16.225.s:
kūṭaśālmalibaddhāśca tīkṣṇakaṇṭakapīḍitāḥ ..
chidrānveṣaṇasaṃyuktāḥ pareṣāṃ nityasaṃsthitāḥ .. 7.1.225.30 ..
16.225.d:
कूटशाल्मलिबद्धाश्च तीक्ष्णकण्टकपीडिताः ..
छिद्रान्वेषणसंयुक्ताः परेषां नित्यसंस्थिताः .. 7.1.225.30 ..
16.225.m: Bound to the spiny Śālmali tree and pierced by sharp thorns, / they were constantly engaged in finding fault in others.

16.225.s:
krakacena tu chidyante ya ime dvijasattama ..
abhakṣyaniratā hyete svadharmasya vidūṣakāḥ .. 31 ..
16.225.d:
क्रकचेन तु छिद्यन्ते य इमे द्विजसत्तम ..
अभक्ष्यनिरता ह्येते स्वधर्मस्य विदूषकाः .. 31 ..
16.225.m: These who are cut with a saw, O best of brahmins, / were devoted to inedible food and defiled their own duty.

16.225.s:
kanyāvikrayakarttāraḥ kanyānāṃ jīvabhaṃjakāḥ ..
purīṣamadhyagā hyete pacyaṃte mama kiṃkaraiḥ .. 32 ..
16.225.d:
कन्याविक्रयकर्त्तारः कन्यानां जीवभंजकाः ..
पुरीषमध्यगा ह्येते पच्यंते मम किंकरैः .. 32 ..
16.225.m: Those who sell maidens and those who ruin the lives of maidens / dwell in the midst of feces and are boiled by my servants.

16.225.s:
saṃdeśairdāruṇairjihvā yeṣāmutpāṭyate muhuḥ ..
vāglopaniratā hyete mṛṣāvādaparāyaṇāḥ .. 33 ..
16.225.d:
संदेशैर्दारुणैर्जिह्वा येषामुत्पाट्यते मुहुः ..
वाग्लोपनिरता ह्येते मृषावादपरायणाः .. 33 ..
16.225.m: Those whose tongues are repeatedly torn out with cruel pincers / were devoted to breach of words and dedicated to lying speech.

16.225.s:
ye śītena prabādhyaṃte vepa mānā muhurmuhuḥ ..
devasvānāṃ ca hartāro brāhmaṇānāṃ viśeṣataḥ .. 34 ..
16.225.d:
ये शीतेन प्रबाध्यंते वेप माना मुहुर्मुहुः ..
देवस्वानां च हर्तारो ब्राह्मणानां विशेषतः .. 34 ..
16.225.m: Those who are tormented by cold, trembling again and again, / are stealers of the property of gods, and especially of brahmins.

16.225.s:
teṣāṃ śirasi nikṣipto bhūribhāro dvijottama ..
ato'mī brāhmaṇaśreṣṭha pūtkā rayanti bhairavam .. 35 ..
16.225.d:
तेषां शिरसि निक्षिप्तो भूरिभारो द्विजोत्तम ..
अतोऽमी ब्राह्मणश्रेष्ठ पूत्का रयन्ति भैरवम् .. 35 ..
16.225.m: A heavy burden is placed on their heads, O best of brahmins; / therefore, O foremost of brahmins, they utter a terrible cry of distress."

16.225.s:
.. yama uvāca .. ..
evametatsamākhyātaṃ tava sarvaṃ dvijottama ..
narakāṇāṃ svarūpaṃ tu karmaṇāṃ vai yathākramam .. 36 ..
16.225.d:
.. यम उवाच .. ..
एवमेतत्समाख्यातं तव सर्वं द्विजोत्तम ..
नरकाणां स्वरूपं तु कर्मणां वै यथाक्रमम् .. 36 ..
16.225.m: Yama said: / "Thus all of this has been declared to you, O best of brahmins: / the nature of the hells and [the corresponding] deeds in proper order.

16.225.s: gaccha śīghraṃ mahābhāga yāvatkāyo na dahyate .. 37 ..
16.225.d: गच्छ शीघ्रं महाभाग यावत्कायो न दह्यते .. 37 ..
16.225.m: Go quickly, O fortunate one, before your body is cremated!"

16.225.s:
.. brāhmaṇa uvāca .. ..
kathaya tvaṃ suraśreṣṭha mama sarvaṃ samāhitaḥ ..
na gacchetkarmaṇā yena narakaṃ mānavaḥ kvacit .. 38 ..
16.225.d:
.. ब्राह्मण उवाच .. ..
कथय त्वं सुरश्रेष्ठ मम सर्वं समाहितः ..
न गच्छेत्कर्मणा येन नरकं मानवः क्वचित् .. 38 ..
16.225.m: The brahmin said: / "Tell me, attentive, O best of gods, / by what deed a human would never go to hell anywhere.

16.225.s:
satāṃ saptapadaṃ maitramityāhurbuddhikovidāḥ ..
mitratāṃ ca puraskṛtya samāsādvaktumarhasi .. 39 ..
16.225.d:
सतां सप्तपदं मैत्रमित्याहुर्बुद्धिकोविदाः ..
मित्रतां च पुरस्कृत्य समासाद्वक्तुमर्हसि .. 39 ..
16.225.m: "Friendship of the virtuous is formed in seven steps," so say those skilled in intellect. / Honoring our friendship, you ought to speak in brief."

16.225.s:
.. yama uvāca .. ..
prabhāsaṃ kṣetramāsādyā narakeśvaramuttamam ..
yaḥ paśyati naro bhaktyā narakaṃ sa na paśyati .. 7.1.225.40 ..
16.225.d:
.. यम उवाच .. ..
प्रभासं क्षेत्रमासाद्या नरकेश्वरमुत्तमम् ..
यः पश्यति नरो भक्त्या नरकं स न पश्यति .. 7.1.225.40 ..
16.225.m: Yama said: / "Reaching the sacred field of Prabhāsa, whoever beholds with devotion / the supreme Narakeśvara, that person does not see hell.

16.225.s:
sthāpitaṃ yanmayā liṃgaṃ śivabhaktyā yutena ca ..
etadguhyaṃ mayā proktaṃ tava prītyai dvijottama .. 41 ..
16.225.d:
स्थापितं यन्मया लिंगं शिवभक्त्या युतेन च ..
एतद्गुह्यं मया प्रोक्तं तव प्रीत्यै द्विजोत्तम .. 41 ..
16.225.m: That liṅga which was established by me, endowed with devotion to Śiva— / this secret has been spoken by me for your pleasure, O best of brahmins.

16.225.s:
gopanīyaṃ prayatnena mama vākyādasaṃśayam ..
evamuktastadā vipraḥ svayamevāvaniṃ yayau .. 42 ..
16.225.d:
गोपनीयं प्रयत्नेन मम वाक्यादसंशयम् ..
एवमुक्तस्तदा विप्रः स्वयमेवावनिं ययौ .. 42 ..
16.225.m: It should be concealed with care by my word, without doubt." / Thus addressed, the brahmin then went to the earth on his own.

16.225.s:
labdhvā kalevaraṃ so'tha vismayaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ ..
tatsmṛtvā vacanaṃ sarvaṃ dharmarājasya dhīmataḥ .. 43 ..
16.225.d:
लब्ध्वा कलेवरं सोऽथ विस्मयं परमं गतः ..
तत्स्मृत्वा वचनं सर्वं धर्मराजस्य धीमतः .. 43 ..
16.225.m: Regaining his physical body, he experienced supreme astonishment. / Remembering all that speech of the wise Dharmarāja,

16.225.s:
gatvā tatra sa nityaṃ vai pūjayāmāsa taṃ prabhum ..
yāvajjīvaṃ varārohe tataḥ siddhiṃ parāṃ gataḥ .. 44 ..
16.225.d:
गत्वा तत्र स नित्यं वै पूजयामास तं प्रभुम् ..
यावज्जीवं वरारोहे ततः सिद्धिं परां गतः .. 44 ..
16.225.m: having gone there, he constantly worshipped that lord / for the rest of his life, O fair-hipped lady, and then attained supreme perfection.

16.225.s:
tasmātsarvaprayatnena bhaktyā tamavalokayan ..
api pātakayukto'pi na yāti narake naraḥ .. 45 ..
16.225.d:
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन भक्त्या तमवलोकयन् ..
अपि पातकयुक्तोऽपि न याति नरके नरः .. 45 ..
16.225.m: Therefore, beholding it with devotion by every effort, / even a man burdened with sins does not go to hell.

16.225.s:
āśvayukkṛṣṇapakṣe tu caturdaśyāṃ vidhānataḥ ..
yastatra kurute śrāddhaṃ so'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet .. 46 ..
16.225.d:
आश्वयुक्कृष्णपक्षे तु चतुर्दश्यां विधानतः ..
यस्तत्र कुरुते श्राद्धं सोऽश्वमेधफलं लभेत् .. 46 ..
16.225.m: Whoever performs an ancestral offering there according to the rules on the fourteenth day of the dark fortnight of Āśvayuja, / he obtains the fruit of an horse sacrifice.

16.225.s:
kṛṣṇājinaṃ tatra deyaṃ brāhmaṇe vedapārage ..
yāvattilānāṃ saṃkhyānaṃ tāvatsvarge mahīyate .. 47 ..
16.225.d:
कृष्णाजिनं तत्र देयं ब्राह्मणे वेदपारगे ..
यावत्तिलानां संख्यानं तावत्स्वर्गे महीयते .. 47 ..
16.225.m: The skin of a black antelope should be given there to a brahmin who has mastered the Vedas; / for as many sesamum seeds as there are, for that long he is honored in heaven.

16.225.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetra māhātmye 'narakeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma pañcaviṃśatyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 225 .. .. cha ..
16.225.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्र माहात्म्ये ऽनरकेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम पञ्चविंशत्युत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 225 .. .. छ ..
