16.225.m: Thus ends the two hundred and twenty-fifth chapter, entitled 'Description of the Māhātmya of Anarakeśvara', in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh [section], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skandapurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

16.226.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tasyaiva pūrvabhāge tu nairṛte pāpamocanāt ..
megheśvareti vikhyātaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam .. 1 ..
16.226.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
तस्यैव पूर्वभागे तु नैरृते पापमोचनात् ..
मेघेश्वरेति विख्यातं सर्वपातकनाशनम् .. 1 ..
16.226.m: Īśvara said: / To the east of that very [place], however, and southwest of Pāpamocana, / is the renowned [liṅga] named Megheśvara, which destroys all sins.

16.226.s:
anāvṛṣṭibhaye jāte śāṃtiṃ tatraiva kārayet ..
vāruṇīṃ vipramukhyaistu bhāvayedudakairmahīm .. 2 ..
16.226.d:
अनावृष्टिभये जाते शांतिं तत्रैव कारयेत् ..
वारुणीं विप्रमुख्यैस्तु भावयेदुदकैर्महीम् .. 2 ..
16.226.m: When fear of drought arises, one should have a pacification rite performed right there; / he should cause the earth to be drenched with waters dedicated to Varuṇa by the foremost among brahmins.

16.226.s:
meghaiḥ pratiṣṭhitaṃ liṃgaṃ yatra nityaṃ prapūjyate ..
anāvṛṣṭibhayaṃ kiṃcinna ca tatra prajāyate .. 3 ..
16.226.d:
मेघैः प्रतिष्ठितं लिंगं यत्र नित्यं प्रपूज्यते ..
अनावृष्टिभयं किंचिन्न च तत्र प्रजायते .. 3 ..
16.226.m: Where the liṅga consecrated by the clouds is continually worshiped, / no fear of drought ever arises there.

16.226.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye megheśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaḍviṃśatyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 226 .. ..
16.226.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीति साहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये मेघेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम षड्विंशत्युत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 226 .. ..
16.226.m: Thus ends the two hundred and twenty-sixth chapter, entitled 'Description of the Māhātmya of Megheśvara', in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh [section], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skandapurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

16.227.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi balabhadrapratiṣṭhitam ..
liṃgaṃ mahāpāpaharaṃ gātrotsargāttaduttare .. 1 ..
16.227.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि बलभद्रप्रतिष्ठितम् ..
लिंगं महापापहरं गात्रोत्सर्गात्तदुत्तरे .. 1 ..
16.227.m: Īśvara said: / Then, O great goddess, one should go to the liṅga consecrated by Balabhadra, / which removes great sins, to the north of Gātrotsarga.

16.227.s:
mahāliṃgaṃ mahādevi mahāsiddhi phalapradam ..
balabhadreṇa vidhinā sthāpitaṃ pāpaśuddhaye .. 2 ..
16.227.d:
महालिंगं महादेवि महासिद्धि फलप्रदम् ..
बलभद्रेण विधिना स्थापितं पापशुद्धये .. 2 ..
16.227.m: It is a great liṅga, O great goddess, which bestows the fruit of great perfections, / installed by Balabhadra according to ritual injunction for purification from sin.

16.227.s:
yastaṃ pūjayate bhaktyā gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ kramāt ..
tṛtīyārevatīyoge sa yogeśapadaṃ labhet .. 3 ..
16.227.d:
यस्तं पूजयते भक्त्या गन्धपुष्पादिभिः क्रमात् ..
तृतीयारेवतीयोगे स योगेशपदं लभेत् .. 3 ..
16.227.m: Whoever worships it with devotion, successively with perfumes, flowers, and the like, / during the conjunction of the third lunar day and Revatī, attains the rank of the lord of yoga.

16.227.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye balabhadreśvaramāhātmya varṇanaṃnāma saptaviṃśatyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 227 ..
16.227.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये बलभद्रेश्वरमाहात्म्य वर्णनंनाम सप्तविंशत्युत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 227 ..
16.227.m: Thus ends the two hundred and twenty-seventh chapter, entitled 'Description of the Māhātmya of Balabhadreśvara', in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh [section], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skandapurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

16.228.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi mātṛsthānamanuttamam ..
bhairaveśeti vikhyātaṃ sarvabhayavināśanam .. 1 ..
16.228.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि मातृस्थानमनुत्तमम् ..
भैरवेशेति विख्यातं सर्वभयविनाशनम् .. 1 ..
16.228.m: Īśvara said: / Then, O great goddess, one should go to the unsurpassed abode of the Mothers, / known as Bhairaveśa, which destroys all fear.

16.228.s:
caturdaśyāṃ vidhānena kṛṣṇapakṣe yatātmavān ..
pūjayedgandhapuṣpaiśca balidānaistathottamaiḥ .. 2 ..
16.228.d:
चतुर्दश्यां विधानेन कृष्णपक्षे यतात्मवान् ..
पूजयेद्गन्धपुष्पैश्च बलिदानैस्तथोत्तमैः .. 2 ..
16.228.m: One who is self-controlled, on the fourteenth day of the dark fortnight, / should worship [them] according to ritual with perfumes and flowers, and likewise with excellent offerings of oblations.

16.228.s: taṃ putramiva yoginyo rakṣaṃti bhuvi mātaraḥ .. 3 ..
16.228.d: तं पुत्रमिव योगिन्यो रक्षंति भुवि मातरः .. 3 ..
16.228.m: The yoginīs and Mothers on earth protect him like a son.

16.228.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetra māhātmye bhairaveśvaramātṛgaṇamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭāviṃśatyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 228 .. .. cha ..
16.228.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्र माहात्म्ये भैरवेश्वरमातृगणमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामाष्टाविंशत्युत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 228 .. .. छ ..
16.228.m: Thus ends the two hundred and twenty-eighth chapter, entitled 'Description of the Māhātmya of the Host of Mothers at Bhairaveśvara', in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh [section], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skandapurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

16.229.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi gaṃgāṃ tripathagāminīm ..
anarakeśato devi aiśānyāṃ diśi saṃsthitām .. 1 ..
16.229.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि गंगां त्रिपथगामिनीम् ..
अनरकेशतो देवि ऐशान्यां दिशि संस्थिताम् .. 1 ..
16.229.m: Īśvara said: / Then, O great goddess, one should go to the Gaṅgā that flows in three paths, / situated in the northeastern direction from Anarakeśa, O goddess.

16.229.s:
svayaṃbhūtāṃ dharāmadhyādānītāṃ viṣṇunā purā ..
yādavānāṃ tu muktyarthaṃ sarvapāpopaśāntaye .. 2 ..
16.229.d:
स्वयंभूतां धरामध्यादानीतां विष्णुना पुरा ..
यादवानां तु मुक्त्यर्थं सर्वपापोपशान्तये .. 2 ..
16.229.m: Self-manifested from the midst of the earth, she was formerly brought by Viṣṇu / for the liberation of the Yādavas and for the appeasement of all sins.

16.229.s:
yastatra kurute snānaṃ kathaṃcitpuṇyasaṃcayāt ..
śrāddhaṃ caiva vidhānena na sa śocetkṛtākṛte .. 3 ..
16.229.d:
यस्तत्र कुरुते स्नानं कथंचित्पुण्यसंचयात् ..
श्राद्धं चैव विधानेन न स शोचेत्कृताकृते .. 3 ..
16.229.m: Whoever takes a bath there somehow by an accumulation of religious merit, / and performs an ancestral offering according to the rules, does not grieve over what was done or left undone.

16.229.s:
brahmāṇḍaṃ sakalaṃ dattvā yatpuṇyaphalamāpnuyāt ..
tatpuṇyaṃ prāpnuyāddevi kārtikyāṃ jāhnavījale .. 4 ..
16.229.d:
ब्रह्माण्डं सकलं दत्त्वा यत्पुण्यफलमाप्नुयात् ..
तत्पुण्यं प्राप्नुयाद्देवि कार्तिक्यां जाह्नवीजले .. 4 ..
16.229.m: The religious merit one would obtain by gifting the entire egg of Brahmā, / that merit he obtains, O goddess, in the water of the Jāhnavī on the full moon of Kārttika.

16.229.s:
kalau yuge tu saṃprāpte durllabhaṃ tatra darśanam..
kiṃ punaḥ snānadānaṃ tu prabhāse jāhnavījale .. 5 ..
16.229.d:
कलौ युगे तु संप्राप्ते दुर्ल्लभं तत्र दर्शनम्..
किं पुनः स्नानदानं तु प्रभासे जाह्नवीजले .. 5 ..
16.229.m: When the Kali age arrives, even seeing it is difficult to attain; / how much more so ritual ablution and charity in the waters of the Jāhnavī in Prabhāsa?

16.229.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye gaṃgāmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikonatriṃśaduttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 229 ..
16.229.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये गंगामाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामैकोनत्रिंशदुत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 229 ..
16.229.m: Thus ends the two hundred and twenty-ninth chapter, entitled 'Description of the Māhātmya of Gaṅgā', in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh [section], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skandapurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

16.230.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi devaṃ gaṇapatipriyam ..
tatraiva saṃsthitaṃ samyaṅmayā tatra niyojitaḥ .. 1 ..
16.230.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि देवं गणपतिप्रियम् ..
तत्रैव संस्थितं सम्यङ्मया तत्र नियोजितः .. 1 ..
16.230.m: Īśvara said: / Then, O great goddess, one should go to the deity who is dear to Gaṇapati, / situated right there properly; he was appointed there by me,

16.230.s:
gaṅgāyā dakṣiṇe devi kṣetrarakṣaṇatatparaḥ ..
māghe kṛṣṇacaturdaśyāṃ yastaṃ pūjayate naraḥ .. 2 ..
16.230.d:
गङ्गाया दक्षिणे देवि क्षेत्ररक्षणतत्परः ..
माघे कृष्णचतुर्दश्यां यस्तं पूजयते नरः .. 2 ..
16.230.m: to the south of the Gaṅgā, O goddess, intent upon protecting the sacred field. / Whichever man worships him on the fourteenth day of the dark fortnight of Māgha,

16.230.s:
divyamodakanaivedyaiḥ puṣpadhūpādibhiḥ kramāt ..
na tasya jāyate vighnaṃ yāvatkṣetre vasatyasau .. 3 ..
16.230.d:
दिव्यमोदकनैवेद्यैः पुष्पधूपादिभिः क्रमात् ..
न तस्य जायते विघ्नं यावत्क्षेत्रे वसत्यसौ .. 3 ..
16.230.m: successively with celestial food offerings of sweetmeats, flowers, incense, and the like, / no obstacle arises for him as long as he dwells in the sacred field.

16.230.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye gaṇapatimāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma triṃśaduttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 230 .. ..
16.230.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीति साहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये गणपतिमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम त्रिंशदुत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 230 .. ..
16.230.m: Thus ends the two hundred and thirtieth chapter, entitled 'Description of the Māhātmya of Gaṇapati', in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh [section], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skandapurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

16.231.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi yatra jāṃbavatī nadī ..
purā jāṃbavatīnāma viṣṇoryā mahiṣīpriyā ..
apṛcchadarjunaṃ sādhvī vada vārtāṃ kurū dvaha .. 1 ..
16.231.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि यत्र जांबवती नदी ..
पुरा जांबवतीनाम विष्णोर्या महिषीप्रिया ..
अपृच्छदर्जुनं साध्वी वद वार्तां कुरू द्वह .. 1 ..
16.231.m: Īśvara said: / Then, O great goddess, one should go where the Jāmbavatī river is. / Formerly, she who was known as Jāmbavatī, the beloved queen of Viṣṇu, / the chaste woman, asked Arjuna: 'Tell the news, O uplifter of the Kurus!'

16.231.s:
tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā arjuno niśvasanmuhuḥ ..
vāṣpagadgadayā vācā idaṃ vacanamabravīt .. 2 ..
16.231.d:
तस्यास्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा अर्जुनो निश्वसन्मुहुः ..
वाष्पगद्गदया वाचा इदं वचनमब्रवीत् .. 2 ..
16.231.m: Hearing her words, Arjuna, sighing repeatedly, / spoke these words in a voice choked with tears:

16.231.s:
parityaktā vayaṃ bhadre yādavaiḥ sumahātmabhiḥ ..9
baladevasya vīrasya sātyakeśca mahātmanaḥ .. 3 ..
anyeṣāṃ yaduvīrāṇāṃ pāpakarmātinirghṛṇaḥ ..
jijīviṣuriha prāpto vāsudevanirākṛtaḥ .. 4 ..
sā śrutvā bhartṛnidhanamarjunācca mahāsatī ..
gaṃgātīre samutpādya pāvakaṃ pāvakaprabhā ..
samutsṛjya mahākāyaṃ nadībhūtvā viniryayau .. 5 ..
sā gṛhītvā satī bharturbhasma sarvaṃ citestathā ..
praviṣṭā sāgaraṃ devi tadā jāṃbavatī śubhā ..6..
yā nārī tatra deveśi bhaktyā snānaṃ samācaret ..
tadanvayepi kācitstrī na vaidhavyamavāpnuyāt .. 7 ..
tasmātsarvaprayatnena tatra snānaṃ samācaret ..
naro vā yadi vā nārī prāpnoti paramāṃ gatim .. 8 ..
16.231.d:
परित्यक्ता वयं भद्रे यादवैः सुमहात्मभिः ..9
बलदेवस्य वीरस्य सात्यकेश्च महात्मनः .. 3 ..
अन्येषां यदुवीराणां पापकर्मातिनिर्घृणः ..
जिजीविषुरिह प्राप्तो वासुदेवनिराकृतः .. 4 ..
सा श्रुत्वा भर्तृनिधनमर्जुनाच्च महासती ..
गंगातीरे समुत्पाद्य पावकं पावकप्रभा ..
समुत्सृज्य महाकायं नदीभूत्वा विनिर्ययौ .. 5 ..
सा गृहीत्वा सती भर्तुर्भस्म सर्वं चितेस्तथा ..
प्रविष्टा सागरं देवि तदा जांबवती शुभा ..6..
या नारी तत्र देवेशि भक्त्या स्नानं समाचरेत् ..
तदन्वयेपि काचित्स्त्री न वैधव्यमवाप्नुयात् .. 7 ..
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन तत्र स्नानं समाचरेत् ..
नरो वा यदि वा नारी प्राप्नोति परमां गतिम् .. 8 ..
16.231.m:
'We have been abandoned, O blessed lady, by the high-souled Yādavas,
by the heroic Baladeva and by the high-souled Sātyaki,
and by the other heroes of the Yadus. Being exceedingly cruel and of sinful deeds, / desiring to live, I have arrived here, rejected by Vāsudeva.'
Hearing of the death of her husband from Arjuna, the exceedingly faithful wife, / glowing like fire, ignited a fire on the bank of the Gaṅgā, / abandoned her noble body, and went forth having become a river.
Taking all the ashes of her husband from the funeral pyre, O goddess, / the chaste, auspicious Jāmbavatī then entered the ocean.
Whatever woman performs a ritual ablution there with devotion, O queen of gods, / no woman whatsoever in her lineage shall ever suffer widowhood.
Therefore, by every effort one should perform a ritual ablution there; / whether a man or a woman, one attains the supreme state.

16.231.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye jāṃbavatīnadīmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikatriṃśaduttaradvi śatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 231 .. .. cha ..
16.231.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये जांबवतीनदीमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामैकत्रिंशदुत्तरद्वि शततमोऽध्यायः .. 231 .. .. छ ..
16.231.m: Thus ends the two hundred and thirty-first chapter, entitled 'Description of the Māhātmya of the Jāmbavatī River', in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh [section], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skandapurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

16.232.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi kūpaṃ trailokyapūjitam ..
paścime tasya tīrthasya pāṃḍavānāṃ mahātmanām .. 1 ..
16.232.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि कूपं त्रैलोक्यपूजितम् ..
पश्चिमे तस्य तीर्थस्य पांडवानां महात्मनाम् .. 1 ..
16.232.m: Īśvara said: / Then, O great goddess, one should go to the well worshiped by the three worlds / to the west of that sacred ford, [pertaining] to the high-souled Pāṇḍavas.

16.232.s:
yadā'raṇyamanuprāptāḥ pāṃḍavāḥ pṛthivītale ..
bhramamāṇā mahādevi prabhāsaṃ kṣetramāgatāḥ .. 2 ..
16.232.d:
यदाऽरण्यमनुप्राप्ताः पांडवाः पृथिवीतले ..
भ्रममाणा महादेवि प्रभासं क्षेत्रमागताः .. 2 ..
16.232.m: When the Pāṇḍavas reached the forest on the surface of the earth, / wandering, O great goddess, they arrived at the sacred field of Prabhāsa.

16.232.s:
tataste nyavasaṃstatra kiṃcitkālaṃ samāhitāḥ ..
gatvā kṣetraṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ tataḥ kṛṣṇā'bravīdidam .. 3 ..
16.232.d:
ततस्ते न्यवसंस्तत्र किंचित्कालं समाहिताः ..
गत्वा क्षेत्रं महापुण्यं ततः कृष्णाऽब्रवीदिदम् .. 3 ..
16.232.m: Then, having gone to that most sacred field, they resided there concentrated in mind for some time; then Kṛṣṇā spoke these words:

16.232.s:
brāhmaṇānāṃ sahasrāṇi bhuṃjate bhavatāṃ gṛhe ..
dūre jalāśrayaścaiva na tāvaṃtaśca kiṃkarāḥ .. 4 ..
16.232.d:
ब्राह्मणानां सहस्राणि भुंजते भवतां गृहे ..
दूरे जलाश्रयश्चैव न तावंतश्च किंकराः .. 4 ..
16.232.m: "Thousands of brahmins dine in your household, / but the reservoir of water is far away, nor are there so many servants.

16.232.s:
tasmājjalāśrayaḥ kāryaṃ āśramasya samīpataḥ ..
yatra snānaṃ kariṣyāmi yuṣmākaṃ saṃprasādataḥ .. 5 ..
16.232.d:
तस्माज्जलाश्रयः कार्यं आश्रमस्य समीपतः ..
यत्र स्नानं करिष्यामि युष्माकं संप्रसादतः .. 5 ..
16.232.m: Therefore, a reservoir of water should be made near the hermitage, / wherein I shall bathe by your gracious favour."

16.232.s:
tatastu pāṃḍavāḥ sarve sahitāste varānane ..
akhanaṃstatra te kūpaṃ draupadīvākyapreritāḥ .. 6 ..
16.232.d:
ततस्तु पांडवाः सर्वे सहितास्ते वरानने ..
अखनंस्तत्र ते कूपं द्रौपदीवाक्यप्रेरिताः .. 6 ..
16.232.m: Then all the Pāṇḍavas together, O fair-faced lady, / urged by the words of Draupadī, dug a well there.

16.232.s:
athājagāma tatraiva bhagavāndevakīsutaḥ ..
śrutvā samāgatānpārthāndvārāvatyāḥ sabāṃdhavaḥ .. 7 ..
16.232.d:
अथाजगाम तत्रैव भगवान्देवकीसुतः ..
श्रुत्वा समागतान्पार्थान्द्वारावत्याः सबांधवः .. 7 ..
16.232.m: Then, having heard that the sons of Pṛthā had arrived, the blessed son of Devakī / came to that very place from Dvāravatī accompanied by his kinsmen:

16.232.s:
pradyumnena ca sāṃbena gadena niṣadhena ca ..
yuyudhānena rāmeṇa cārudeṣṇena dhīmatā .. 8 ..
16.232.d:
प्रद्युम्नेन च सांबेन गदेन निषधेन च ..
युयुधानेन रामेण चारुदेष्णेन धीमता .. 8 ..
16.232.m: with Pradyumna, Sāmba, Gada, and Niṣadha, / with Yuyudhāna, Rāma, and the wise Cārudeṣṇa,

16.232.s:
anyaiḥ parivṛtaḥ śūrairyādavairyuddha durmadaiḥ ..
te sametya yathānyāyaṃ samastā yadupuṃgavāḥ .. 9 ..
16.232.d:
अन्यैः परिवृतः शूरैर्यादवैर्युद्ध दुर्मदैः ..
ते समेत्य यथान्यायं समस्ता यदुपुंगवाः .. 9 ..
16.232.m: surrounded by other heroic Yādavas fierce in battle. / Those chiefs of the Yadus, having assembled according to proper custom,

16.232.s:
tataḥ kathāvasāne ca kasmiṃścitkāraṇāṃtare ..
vāsudevaḥ pāṃḍusutamidaṃ vacanamabravīt .. .. 7.1.232.10 ..
16.232.d:
ततः कथावसाने च कस्मिंश्चित्कारणांतरे ..
वासुदेवः पांडुसुतमिदं वचनमब्रवीत् .. .. 7.1.232.10 ..
16.232.m: then, at the conclusion of their conversation, on some subsequent occasion, / Vāsudeva spoke these words to the son of Pāṇḍu:

16.232.s:
yudhiṣṭhira mahābāho kiṃ te kāmakaromyaham ..
rājyaṃ dhānyaṃ dhanaṃ cāpi athavā ripunāśanam .. 11 ..
16.232.d:
युधिष्ठिर महाबाहो किं ते कामकरोम्यहम् ..
राज्यं धान्यं धनं चापि अथवा रिपुनाशनम् .. 11 ..
16.232.m: "O mighty-armed Yudhiṣṭhira, what desire of yours shall I fulfill? / Sovereignty, grain, wealth, or the destruction of your enemies?"

16.232.s:
.. yudhiṣṭhira uvāca .. ..
śaktastvaṃ yādavaśreṣṭha sarvakarmasvasaṃśayaḥ ..
pratijñātaṃ tvayā pūrvaṃ varṣairdvādaśabhiḥ priyam.. 12 ..
16.232.d:
.. युधिष्ठिर उवाच .. ..
शक्तस्त्वं यादवश्रेष्ठ सर्वकर्मस्वसंशयः ..
प्रतिज्ञातं त्वया पूर्वं वर्षैर्द्वादशभिः प्रियम्.. 12 ..
16.232.m: Yudhiṣṭhira said: / "O best of the Yādavas, you are capable of all deeds, without doubt. / Formerly, after twelve years, a favour was promised by you.

16.232.s:
tannāsti triṣu lokeṣu yanna siddhyati bhūtale ..
tvayi tuṣṭe jagannātha sarvadevanamaskṛte .. 13 ..
16.232.d:
तन्नास्ति त्रिषु लोकेषु यन्न सिद्ध्यति भूतले ..
त्वयि तुष्टे जगन्नाथ सर्वदेवनमस्कृते .. 13 ..
16.232.m: There is nothing on the earth, in the three worlds, that is not accomplished / when you are pleased, O Lord of the Universe, revered by all the gods.

16.232.s:
avaśyaṃ yadi tuṣṭo'si mama sarvajagatpate ..
atra sāṃnidhyamāgaccha kūpe nityaṃ janārdana .. 14 ..
16.232.d:
अवश्यं यदि तुष्टोऽसि मम सर्वजगत्पते ..
अत्र सांनिध्यमागच्छ कूपे नित्यं जनार्दन .. 14 ..
16.232.m: If you are indeed pleased with me, O Lord of the entire world, / manifest your eternal presence here in this well, O Janārdana.

16.232.s:
atrāgatya naro yastu bhaktyā snānaṃ samācaret ..
sa yātu vaiṣṇavaṃ sthānaṃ prasādāttava keśava .. 15 ..
16.232.d:
अत्रागत्य नरो यस्तु भक्त्या स्नानं समाचरेत् ..
स यातु वैष्णवं स्थानं प्रसादात्तव केशव .. 15 ..
16.232.m: Whatever person comes here and performs a ritual ablution with devotion, / let him go to the realm of Viṣṇu by your grace, O Keśava."

16.232.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
evaṃ bhaviṣyatītyuktvā tadā'mantrya yudhiṣṭhiram ..
prayayau dvārakāṃ kṛṣṇaḥ sarvalokanamaskṛtaḥ .. 16 ..
16.232.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
एवं भविष्यतीत्युक्त्वा तदाऽमन्त्र्य युधिष्ठिरम् ..
प्रययौ द्वारकां कृष्णः सर्वलोकनमस्कृतः .. 16 ..
16.232.m: Īśvara said: / Having said, "So it shall be," and taking leave of Yudhiṣṭhira, / Kṛṣṇa, revered by all the worlds, departed for Dvārakā.

16.232.s:
tasmiñchrāddhaṃ naraḥ kṛtvā vājimedhaphalaṃ labhet ..
prasādāddevadevasya viṣṇoramitatejasaḥ .. 17 ..
16.232.d:
तस्मिञ्छ्राद्धं नरः कृत्वा वाजिमेधफलं लभेत् ..
प्रसादाद्देवदेवस्य विष्णोरमिततेजसः .. 17 ..
16.232.m: A man performing a śrāddha there obtains the fruit of a horse sacrifice / by the grace of Viṣṇu, the god of gods, of boundless splendour.

16.232.s:
tadardhaṃ tarpaṇenaiva snānātpādamavāpnuyāt ..
tasmātsarvaprayatnena tatra śrāddhaṃ samācaret .. 18 ..
16.232.d:
तदर्धं तर्पणेनैव स्नानात्पादमवाप्नुयात् ..
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन तत्र श्राद्धं समाचरेत् .. 18 ..
16.232.m: He obtains half of that merely by libation, and a quarter [of that fruit] from a ritual ablution; / therefore, one should perform a śrāddha there with every effort.

16.232.s:
jyeṣṭhasya paurṇamāsyāṃ yaḥ snānaṃ śrāddhaṃ kariṣyati ..
sāvitrīṃ caiva saṃpūjya sa yāsyati paramaṃ padam .. 19 ..
16.232.d:
ज्येष्ठस्य पौर्णमास्यां यः स्नानं श्राद्धं करिष्यति ..
सावित्रीं चैव संपूज्य स यास्यति परमं पदम् .. 19 ..
16.232.m: He who performs a ritual ablution and śrāddha on the full moon of Jyeṣṭha / and worships Sāvitrī, shall go to the supreme state.

16.232.s: godānaṃ tatra deyaṃ tu samyagyātrāphalepsubhiḥ ..7.1.232.20..
16.232.d: गोदानं तत्र देयं तु सम्यग्यात्राफलेप्सुभिः ..7.1.232.20..
16.232.m: A gift of a cow should be given there by those desiring the full fruit of the pilgrimage.

16.232.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahā purāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ sahitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye pāṃḍavakūpamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvātriṃśaduttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. .. 232 .. .. cha ..
16.232.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महा पुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां सहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये पांडवकूपमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम द्वात्रिंशदुत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. .. 232 .. .. छ ..
16.232.m: Thus ends the two hundred and thirty-second chapter, entitled 'Description of the Glory of the Pāṇḍava Well,' in the first [sub-section], 'The Glory of Prabhāsakṣetra,' of the seventh section, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, the compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

16.233.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tatraiva pūjayeddevi paṃca liṃgāni bhāvitaḥ ..
pratiṣṭhitāni deveśi pāṃḍavaiśca mahātmabhiḥ .. 1 ..
16.233.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
तत्रैव पूजयेद्देवि पंच लिंगानि भावितः ..
प्रतिष्ठितानि देवेशि पांडवैश्च महात्मभिः .. 1 ..
16.233.m: Īśvara said: / In that very place, O goddess, one should worship with devotion the five liṅgas / installed, O ruler of the gods, by the high-souled Pāṇḍavas.
He who worships them with devotion becomes freed from sins.

16.233.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye pāṃḍaveśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma trayastriṃśaduttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 233 ..
16.233.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये पांडवेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम त्रयस्त्रिंशदुत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 233 ..
16.233.m: Thus ends the two hundred and thirty-third chapter, entitled 'Description of the Glory of Pāṇḍaveśvara,' in the first [sub-section], 'The Glory of Prabhāsakṣetra,' of the seventh section, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, the compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

16.234.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi tīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam ..
daśāśvamedhikaṃnāma mahāpātakanāśanam .. 1 ..
16.234.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि तीर्थं त्रैलोक्यविश्रुतम् ..
दशाश्वमेधिकंनाम महापातकनाशनम् .. 1 ..
16.234.m: Īśvara said: / Then, O great goddess, one should go to the sacred ford renowned in the three worlds, / named Daśāśvamedhika, which destroys grave sins.

16.234.s:
vājimedhaḥ purā ceṣṭaṃ daśabhistatra bhāmini ..
bharatena samāgatya matvā kṣetramanuttamam .. 2 ..
16.234.d:
वाजिमेधः पुरा चेष्टं दशभिस्तत्र भामिनि ..
भरतेन समागत्य मत्वा क्षेत्रमनुत्तमम् .. 2 ..
16.234.m: Formerly, O passionate lady, ten horse sacrifices were performed there / by Bharata, who came there considering it an unexcelled sacred field.

16.234.s:
tatra tṛptaḥ sahasrākṣaḥ somanāthena bhāmini ..
kṛpaṇāḥ khānapānaiśca dakṣiṇābhirdvijātayaḥ .. 3 ..
16.234.d:
तत्र तृप्तः सहस्राक्षः सोमनाथेन भामिनि ..
कृपणाः खानपानैश्च दक्षिणाभिर्द्विजातयः .. 3 ..
16.234.m: There, the thousand-eyed Indra was satisfied, O passionate lady, along with Somanātha, / the destitute [were satisfied] with food and drink, and the twice-born with priestly gifts.

16.234.s:
athocustridaśāḥ sarve suprītā bharataṃ nṛpam ..
tuṣṭāstava mahābāho yajñaiḥ saṃtarpitā vayam ..
varaṃ vṛṇīṣva rājeṃdra yatte manasi varttate .. 4. ..
.. rājovāca .. ..
atrāgatya naro bhaktyā yaḥ snānaṃ kurute naraḥ ..
daśānāmaśvamedhānāṃ sa prāpnotu phalaṃ śubham ... 5 ..
16.234.d:
अथोचुस्त्रिदशाः सर्वे सुप्रीता भरतं नृपम् ..
तुष्टास्तव महाबाहो यज्ञैः संतर्पिता वयम् ..
वरं वृणीष्व राजेंद्र यत्ते मनसि वर्त्तते .. 4. ..
.. राजोवाच .. ..
अत्रागत्य नरो भक्त्या यः स्नानं कुरुते नरः ..
दशानामश्वमेधानां स प्राप्नोतु फलं शुभम् ... 5 ..
16.234.m: Then all the gods, well-pleased, said to King Bharata: / "O mighty-armed one, we are pleased with you, fully gratified by your sacrifices; / choose a boon, O king of kings, whatever is in your mind." / The king said: / "Whatever man comes here and performs a ritual ablution with devotion, / let that man obtain the auspicious fruit of ten horse sacrifices."

16.234.s:
.. devā ūcuḥ .. ..
daśānāmaśvamedhānāṃ śraddhayā phalamāpsyati ..
daśāśvamedhikaṃnāma tīrthametanmahītale ..
khyātiṃ yāsyati rājeṃdra nātra kāryā vicāraṇā .. 6 ..
16.234.d:
.. देवा ऊचुः .. ..
दशानामश्वमेधानां श्रद्धया फलमाप्स्यति ..
दशाश्वमेधिकंनाम तीर्थमेतन्महीतले ..
ख्यातिं यास्यति राजेंद्र नात्र कार्या विचारणा .. 6 ..
16.234.m: The gods said: / "He shall obtain the fruit of ten horse sacrifices through faith; / this sacred ford on the surface of the earth shall attain fame / by the name Daśāśvamedhika, O king of kings; there is no doubt about this."

16.234.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tataḥ prabhṛti tattīrthaṃ prakhyātaṃ dharaṇītale ..
daśāśvamedhikamiti sarvapāpapraṇāśanam .. 7 ..
16.234.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततः प्रभृति तत्तीर्थं प्रख्यातं धरणीतले ..
दशाश्वमेधिकमिति सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् .. 7 ..
16.234.m: Īśvara said: / From that time forth, that sacred ford became celebrated on the surface of the earth / as Daśāśvamedhika, destroying all sins.

16.234.s:
aiṃdravāruṇamāśritya gomukhādā''śvamedhikam ..
atrāṃtare mahādevi śivakṣetraṃ vidurbudhāḥ .. 8 ..
16.234.d:
ऐंद्रवारुणमाश्रित्य गोमुखादा'ऽश्वमेधिकम् ..
अत्रांतरे महादेवि शिवक्षेत्रं विदुर्बुधाः .. 8 ..
16.234.m: From the east to the west, extending from Gomukha to Āśvamedhika, / in this interval, O great goddess, the wise know the sacred field of Śiva.

16.234.s:
sarvapāpaharaṃ divyaṃ svargasopānasaṃnibham ..
sapādakoṭitīrthānāṃ sthānaṃ tatparikīrtitama .. 9 ..
16.234.d:
सर्वपापहरं दिव्यं स्वर्गसोपानसंनिभम् ..
सपादकोटितीर्थानां स्थानं तत्परिकीर्तितम .. 9 ..
16.234.m: Removing all sins, celestial, resembling a stairway to heaven, / that place is proclaimed to contain one and a quarter crores of sacred fords.

16.234.s:
prāṇatyāge kṛte tatra śivaloke ca modate ..
tiryagyonigatāḥ pāpā kīṭapakṣimṛgādayaḥ .. 7.1.234.10 ..
16.234.d:
प्राणत्यागे कृते तत्र शिवलोके च मोदते ..
तिर्यग्योनिगताः पापा कीटपक्षिमृगादयः .. 7.1.234.10 ..
16.234.m: When life is given up there, one rejoices in the world of Śiva; / even sinners born in the wombs of animals, such as insects, birds, and beasts,

16.234.s:
te'pi yāṃti paraṃ sthānaṃ yatra devo maheśvaraḥ ..
tilodakapradānena mātṛkāḥ paitṛkāstathā .. 11 ..
16.234.d:
तेऽपि यांति परं स्थानं यत्र देवो महेश्वरः ..
तिलोदकप्रदानेन मातृकाः पैतृकास्तथा .. 11 ..
16.234.m: they too go to the supreme state where the god Maheśvara resides. / By the offering of water with sesame seeds, maternal as well as paternal

16.234.s:
pitarastasya tṛpyaṃti yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam ..
tatreṣṭā brahmaṇā pūrvamasaṃkhyātā makhottamāḥ .. 12 ..
16.234.d:
पितरस्तस्य तृप्यंति यावदाभूतसंप्लवम् ..
तत्रेष्टा ब्रह्मणा पूर्वमसंख्याता मखोत्तमाः .. 12 ..
16.234.m: ancestors are satisfied until the dissolution of all created beings. / Formerly, countless supreme sacrifices were performed there by Brahmā;

16.234.s:
śakraśca devarājatve tatreṣṭvā samavāptavān ..
kārttavīryeṇa tatraiva kṛtaṃ yajñaśataṃ purā .. 13 ..
16.234.d:
शक्रश्च देवराजत्वे तत्रेष्ट्वा समवाप्तवान् ..
कार्त्तवीर्येण तत्रैव कृतं यज्ञशतं पुरा .. 13 ..
16.234.m: and Śakra attained the kingship of the gods after sacrificing there; / a hundred sacrifices were performed there in ancient times by Kārttavīrya.

16.234.s:
evaṃ tatpravaraṃ sthānaṃ kṣetragarbhāṃtikaṃ priye ..
mṛtānāṃ tatra jaṃtūnāmapunarbhavadāyakam .. 14 ..
16.234.d:
एवं तत्प्रवरं स्थानं क्षेत्रगर्भांतिकं प्रिये ..
मृतानां तत्र जंतूनामपुनर्भवदायकम् .. 14 ..
16.234.m: Thus, that excellent place is adjacent to the heart of the sacred field, O dear one; / it grants non-rebirth to creatures who die there.

16.234.s:
vṛṣotsargaṃ tu yastatra kuryādvai bhāvitātmavān ..
yāvaṃti vṛṣaromāṇi tāvatsvarge mahīyate .. 15 ..
16.234.d:
वृषोत्सर्गं तु यस्तत्र कुर्याद्वै भावितात्मवान् ..
यावंति वृषरोमाणि तावत्स्वर्गे महीयते .. 15 ..
16.234.m: Moreover, he who, with a purified soul, performs the release of a bull there, / is honoured in heaven for as many years as there are hairs on the bull.

16.234.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetra māhātmye daśāśvamedhamāhatmyavarṇanaṃnāma catustriṃśaduttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 234 ..
16.234.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्र माहात्म्ये दशाश्वमेधमाहत्म्यवर्णनंनाम चतुस्त्रिंशदुत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 234 ..
16.234.m: Thus ends the two hundred and thirty-fourth chapter, entitled 'Description of the Glory of Daśāśvamedha,' in the first [sub-section], 'The Glory of Prabhāsakṣetra,' of the seventh section, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, the compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

16.235.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tatraiva saṃsthitaṃ paśyelliṃgatrayamanuttamam ..
śatamedhaṃ sahasramedhaṃ koṭimedhamiti kramāt .. 1 ..
16.235.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
तत्रैव संस्थितं पश्येल्लिंगत्रयमनुत्तमम् ..
शतमेधं सहस्रमेधं कोटिमेधमिति क्रमात् .. 1 ..
16.235.m: Īśvara said: / In that very place, one should behold the three unexcelled liṅgas / situated in sequence: Śatamedha, Sahasramedha, and Koṭimedha.

16.235.s:
dakṣiṇe śatamedhaṃ tu śatayajñaphalapradam ..
kārtavīryyeṇa tatraiva kṛtaṃ yajñaśataṃ purā .. 2 ..
16.235.d:
दक्षिणे शतमेधं तु शतयज्ञफलप्रदम् ..
कार्तवीर्य्येण तत्रैव कृतं यज्ञशतं पुरा .. 2 ..
16.235.m: To the south is Śatamedha, which grants the fruit of a hundred sacrifices; / a hundred sacrifices were performed there in ancient times by Kārtavīrya.

16.235.s:
pratiṣṭhāpya mahāliṃgaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam ..
madhyabhāge'tra yalliṃgaṃ koṭimedheti viśrutam .. 3 ..
16.235.d:
प्रतिष्ठाप्य महालिंगं सर्वपातकनाशनम् ..
मध्यभागेऽत्र यल्लिंगं कोटिमेधेति विश्रुतम् .. 3 ..
16.235.m: having installed a great liṅga that destroys all sins. / The liṅga situated in the central part here is renowned as Koṭimedha.

16.235.s:
tatreṣṭā brahmaṇā pūrvaṃ koṭi saṃkhyā makhottamāḥ ..
saṃsthāpya tu mahādevaṃ śaṃkaraṃ lokaśaṃkarama .. 4 ..
16.235.d:
तत्रेष्टा ब्रह्मणा पूर्वं कोटि संख्या मखोत्तमाः ..
संस्थाप्य तु महादेवं शंकरं लोकशंकरम .. 4 ..
16.235.m: There formerly one crore of the best sacrifices were offered by Brahmā, / after having installed Mahādeva, Śaṃkara, who brings welfare to the world.

16.235.s:
tasya uttarabhāgasthaṃ sahasrakratusaṃjñakam ..
śakraśca devarājo'pi sahasraṃ yaṣṭavānkratūn .. 5 ..
16.235.d:
तस्य उत्तरभागस्थं सहस्रक्रतुसंज्ञकम् ..
शक्रश्च देवराजोऽपि सहस्रं यष्टवान्क्रतून् .. 5 ..
16.235.m: The one located in its northern part is named Sahasrakratu; / Śakra, the king of the gods, also offered a thousand sacrifices [there],
having installed a great liṅga, the primal deity of the gods, / according to the rite, with fragrant powders, flowers, and the like, with the five nectars and water.

16.235.s:
sa prāpnuyātphalaṃ devi liṃganāmodbhavaṃ kramāt ..
godānaṃ tatra deyaṃ tu samyagyātrāphalepsubhiḥ ..7..
16.235.d:
स प्राप्नुयात्फलं देवि लिंगनामोद्भवं क्रमात् ..
गोदानं तत्र देयं तु सम्यग्यात्राफलेप्सुभिः ..7..
16.235.m: He obtains, O goddess, the fruit born of the name of the liṅga in order. / A gift of a cow should be given there by those desiring the full fruit of pilgrimage.

16.235.s:
daśalakṣāṇi tīrthānāṃ tatra tiṣṭhaṃti bhāmini ..
liṃgatrayaṃ tathā madhye sarvapātakanāśanam .. .. 8 ..
16.235.d:
दशलक्षाणि तीर्थानां तत्र तिष्ठंति भामिनि ..
लिंगत्रयं तथा मध्ये सर्वपातकनाशनम् .. .. 8 ..
16.235.m: Ten hundred thousand tīrthas stay there, O passionate lady, / and likewise in the center the three liṅgas, which destroy all sins.

16.235.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ sahitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsa khaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye daśāśvamedhamāhātmye śatamedhādi liṃgatrayamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma pañcatriṃśaduttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 235 ..
16.235.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां सहितायां सप्तमे प्रभास खण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये दशाश्वमेधमाहात्म्ये शतमेधादि लिंगत्रयमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम पञ्चत्रिंशदुत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 235 ..
16.235.m: Thus ends the two hundred and thirty-fifth chapter, entitled 'Description of the Māhātmya of the Three Liṅgas Beginning with Śatamedha in the Māhātmya of Daśāśvamedha,' in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, in the seventh section, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses].

16.236.s:
tato gacchenmahādevi durvāsādityamuttamam ..
yatra durvāsasā taptaṃ tapo varṣasahasrakam ..
nirāhāro jitāhāraḥ sūryārādhanatatparaḥ .. 1 ..
16.236.d:
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि दुर्वासादित्यमुत्तमम् ..
यत्र दुर्वाससा तप्तं तपो वर्षसहस्रकम् ..
निराहारो जिताहारः सूर्याराधनतत्परः .. 1 ..
16.236.m: Then one should go, O great goddess, to the excellent Durvāsāditya, / where tapas was performed by Durvāsas for a thousand years, / taking no food, conquering hunger, intent on worshiping the Sun.

16.236.s:
evaṃ kālena mahatā divyatejā janādhipaḥ ..
pratyakṣaṃ darśanaṃ gatvā prāha sūryo mahāmunim .. 2 ..
16.236.d:
एवं कालेन महता दिव्यतेजा जनाधिपः ..
प्रत्यक्षं दर्शनं गत्वा प्राह सूर्यो महामुनिम् .. 2 ..
16.236.m: Thus after a great length of time, the Sun of divine radiance, the lord of people, / became visible to his sight and spoke to the great sage.

16.236.s:
.. sūrya uvāca .. ..
mā brahmansāhasaṃ kārṣīrvaraṃ varaya suvrata ..
aprāpyamapi dāsyāmi yatte manasi vartate .. 3 .. ..
16.236.d:
.. सूर्य उवाच .. ..
मा ब्रह्मन्साहसं कार्षीर्वरं वरय सुव्रत ..
अप्राप्यमपि दास्यामि यत्ते मनसि वर्तते .. 3 .. ..
16.236.m: Sūrya said: / 'O brahmin, do not commit rashness; choose a boon, O one of good vows! / Even if unachievable, I will give what is in your heart.'

16.236.s:
.. durvāsā uvāca .. ..
prasanno yadi me deva varārho yadi cā'pyaham ..
atra sthāne tvayā stheyaṃ yāvattiṣṭhati medinī .. 4 ..
16.236.d:
.. दुर्वासा उवाच .. ..
प्रसन्नो यदि मे देव वरार्हो यदि चाऽप्यहम् ..
अत्र स्थाने त्वया स्थेयं यावत्तिष्ठति मेदिनी .. 4 ..
16.236.m: Durvāsas said: / 'If you are pleased with me, O god, and if I am worthy of a boon, / you must remain in this place as long as the earth stands.

16.236.s:
durvāsādityanā mā'tra loke khyātiṃ ca gacchatu ..
mayā pratiṣṭhitā yā tu pratimā tava sundarī ..5 ..
16.236.d:
दुर्वासादित्यना माऽत्र लोके ख्यातिं च गच्छतु ..
मया प्रतिष्ठिता या तु प्रतिमा तव सुन्दरी ..5 ..
16.236.m: May your fame go forth in the world under the name of Durvāsāditya here; / and that beautiful image of yours which has been installed by me,

16.236.s:
tasyāṃ sāṃnidhyamevāstu tava deva jagatpate ..
sāṃnidhyaṃ kuruta cātra yamunā duhitā tava ..
tvatsutastu mahātejā dharmarājo mahābalaḥ .. 6 ..
16.236.d:
तस्यां सांनिध्यमेवास्तु तव देव जगत्पते ..
सांनिध्यं कुरुत चात्र यमुना दुहिता तव ..
त्वत्सुतस्तु महातेजा धर्मराजो महाबलः .. 6 ..
16.236.m: in it let there be your very presence, O god, lord of the universe! / And may Yamunā, your daughter, establish her presence here, / as well as your son of great splendor, Dharmarāja of great might.'

16.236.s:
.. sūrya uvāca .. ..
etatsarvaṃ muniśreṣṭha tvayoktaṃ saṃbhaviṣyati ..
tīrthānāṃ koṭiranyā ca gaṃgādīnāṃ mahāmune .. 7 ..
16.236.d:
.. सूर्य उवाच .. ..
एतत्सर्वं मुनिश्रेष्ठ त्वयोक्तं संभविष्यति ..
तीर्थानां कोटिरन्या च गंगादीनां महामुने .. 7 ..
16.236.m: Sūrya said: / 'All this that you have spoken, O best of sages, will come to pass. / Another crore of tīrthas, beginning with the Gaṅgā, O great sage,

16.236.s:
āgamiṣyati te sthānaṃ niścitaṃ vacanānmama ..
atra sthāne mayā brahmansthātavyaṃ saha daivataiḥ .. 8..
16.236.d:
आगमिष्यति ते स्थानं निश्चितं वचनान्मम ..
अत्र स्थाने मया ब्रह्मन्स्थातव्यं सह दैवतैः .. 8..
16.236.m: will come to your place, surely by my word. / In this place, O brahmin, I shall dwell together with the deities.

16.236.s:
ādityānāṃ prabhāvaistu brahmāṃḍodaravāsinām..
teṣāṃ māhātmyasaṃyuktaḥ sthāsye cātra mahāmune .. 9 ..
16.236.d:
आदित्यानां प्रभावैस्तु ब्रह्मांडोदरवासिनाम्..
तेषां माहात्म्यसंयुक्तः स्थास्ये चात्र महामुने .. 9 ..
16.236.m: Endowed with the glories and power of the Ādityas / who dwell within the womb of the cosmic egg, I shall dwell here, O great sage.

16.236.s:
savitṝṇāṃ sahasreṇa dṛṣṭenaiva tu yatphalam ..
tatphalaṃ koṭiguṇitaṃ durvāsādityadarśanāt..7.1.236.10..
16.236.d:
सवितॄणां सहस्रेण दृष्टेनैव तु यत्फलम् ..
तत्फलं कोटिगुणितं दुर्वासादित्यदर्शनात्..7.1.236.10..
16.236.m: Whatever fruit is obtained simply by seeing a thousand suns, / that fruit is multiplied a crore of times by the darśana of Durvāsāditya.

16.236.s:
lapsyaṃte prāṇinaḥ sarve yajñakoṭiphalaṃ tathā ..
evamuktvā tadā sūryaḥ sasmāra tanayāṃ nijām ..
tathā ca dharmerājānaṃ sarvaprāṇiniyāmakam .. 11 ..
16.236.d:
लप्स्यंते प्राणिनः सर्वे यज्ञकोटिफलं तथा ..
एवमुक्त्वा तदा सूर्यः सस्मार तनयां निजाम् ..
तथा च धर्मेराजानं सर्वप्राणिनियामकम् .. 11 ..
16.236.m: All living beings shall also obtain the fruit of a crore of sacrifices.' / Having spoken thus, the Sun then remembered his daughter,

16.236.s:
smṛtamātrā tatra bhittvā pātālatalamudyayau ..
sā nadīrūpiṇī devī tīrthakoṭisamanvitā..12..
16.236.d:
स्मृतमात्रा तत्र भित्त्वा पातालतलमुद्ययौ ..
सा नदीरूपिणी देवी तीर्थकोटिसमन्विता..12..
16.236.m: as well as King Dharma, the ruler of all living beings. / The moment she was remembered, having broken through the subterranean world, she rose up there, / that goddess in the form of a river, accompanied by a crore of tīrthas.

16.236.s:
yamaśca tatra bhagavānkāladaṃḍadharastadā ..
ūcatuḥ praṇayopetau sūryaṃ bhuvanasākṣiṇam .. 13 ..
16.236.d:
यमश्च तत्र भगवान्कालदंडधरस्तदा ..
ऊचतुः प्रणयोपेतौ सूर्यं भुवनसाक्षिणम् .. 13 ..
16.236.m: And the Lord Yama also, holding the staff of time, [arrived] then. / Filled with affection, the two of them spoke to the Sun, the witness of the universe.

16.236.s:
.. yama uvāca .. ..
ājñāpayatu māṃ devo yamunāṃ ca jagatprabhuḥ ..
kāryaṃ yadbhāvino'rthasya tatkariṣye na saṃśayaḥ ..14..
16.236.d:
.. यम उवाच .. ..
आज्ञापयतु मां देवो यमुनां च जगत्प्रभुः ..
कार्यं यद्भाविनोऽर्थस्य तत्करिष्ये न संशयः ..14..
16.236.m: Yama said: / 'Let the god, the lord of the universe, command me and Yamunā. / Whatever task is to be done in future purpose, that I will do without doubt.'

16.236.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
atra kṣetre svarūpeṇa sthātavyaṃ vacanānmama ..
pāpināṃ prāṇināṃ cātra rakṣā kāryā prayatnataḥ .. 15 ..
16.236.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
अत्र क्षेत्रे स्वरूपेण स्थातव्यं वचनान्मम ..
पापिनां प्राणिनां चात्र रक्षा कार्या प्रयत्नतः .. 15 ..
16.236.m: Sūta said: / '[The Sun said:] "In this kṣetra you must stay in your own form by my word, / and here protection should be provided diligently for sinful beings.

16.236.s:
sūryabhaktāḥ sadā rakṣyā brāhmaṇā gṛhamedhinaḥ ..
tvaṃ cāpi yamune cātra koṭitīrthena saṃyutā .. 16 ..
16.236.d:
सूर्यभक्ताः सदा रक्ष्या ब्राह्मणा गृहमेधिनः ..
त्वं चापि यमुने चात्र कोटितीर्थेन संयुता .. 16 ..
16.236.m: Devotees of the Sun, householder brahmins, must always be protected. / And you also, O Yamunā, together with a crore of tīrthas here,

16.236.s:
vasa tvaṃ bhava suprītā sthāne durvāsasodbhave ..
ityevamuktvā deveśastatra durvāsasoṃ'tike ..17..
16.236.d:
वस त्वं भव सुप्रीता स्थाने दुर्वाससोद्भवे ..
इत्येवमुक्त्वा देवेशस्तत्र दुर्वाससोंऽतिके ..17..
16.236.m: dwell you, be well pleased in the place originating from Durvāsas." / Having spoken thus, the lord of the gods, there in the presence of Durvāsas,

16.236.s:
paśyatāṃ sarvadevānāmaṃtarddhānamagātprabhuḥ ..
durvāsāstu tadā hṛṣṭo yāvatpaśyati svāśramam..18..
16.236.d:
पश्यतां सर्वदेवानामंतर्द्धानमगात्प्रभुः ..
दुर्वासास्तु तदा हृष्टो यावत्पश्यति स्वाश्रमम्..18..
16.236.m: disappeared while all the gods were looking on, the Lord. / Durvāsas then, delighted, as he looked upon his own hermitage,

16.236.s:
tāvatpātālamārgeṇa yamunā prādurābhavat ..
yamaśca bhagavāṃstatra dṛṣṭaḥ kṣetraparūpadhṛk ..19..
16.236.d:
तावत्पातालमार्गेण यमुना प्रादुराभवत् ..
यमश्च भगवांस्तत्र दृष्टः क्षेत्रपरूपधृक् ..19..
16.236.m: at that moment Yamunā appeared by way of the path from Pātāla, / and the blessed Yama was seen there, assuming the form of the guardian of the field.'

16.236.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
itthaṃ samabhavattatra yamunodbhedamuttamam..
kuṇḍamādityato yāmye duṃdubhistatra pūrvataḥ .. 7.1.236.20 ..
16.236.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
इत्थं समभवत्तत्र यमुनोद्भेदमुत्तमम्..
कुण्डमादित्यतो याम्ये दुंदुभिस्तत्र पूर्वतः .. 7.1.236.20 ..
16.236.m: Īśvara said: / Thus there came to be the excellent spring of Yamunā. / The pool is south of the Sun; there Dundubhi is to the east.

16.236.s:
kṣetrapālo mahādevi yato duṃdubhiniḥsvanaḥ ..
tatra snātvā mahākuṇḍe yaḥ saṃtarpayate pitṝn.. 21 ..
16.236.d:
क्षेत्रपालो महादेवि यतो दुंदुभिनिःस्वनः ..
तत्र स्नात्वा महाकुण्डे यः संतर्पयते पितॄन्.. 21 ..
16.236.m: He is the guardian of the field, O great goddess, from whom comes the sound of a drum. / Having bathed there in the great pool, whoever offers libation to the ancestors,

16.236.s:
daśa varṣāṇi pañcaiva tṛptiṃ yāṃti pitāmahaḥ ..
piṃḍadānena dattena pitṝṇāṃ tuṣṭimāvahet ..
narake tu sthitānāṃ ca muktirbhūyānna saṃśayaḥ ..22..
16.236.d:
दश वर्षाणि पञ्चैव तृप्तिं यांति पितामहः ..
पिंडदानेन दत्तेन पितॄणां तुष्टिमावहेत् ..
नरके तु स्थितानां च मुक्तिर्भूयान्न संशयः ..22..
16.236.m: the ancestors attain satisfaction for fifteen years. / By the giving of the rice ball, he brings satisfaction to the ancestors, / and for those who reside in hell, there shall be liberation, without doubt.

16.236.s:
māghe māsi site pakṣe saptamyāṃ saṃyatātmavān ..
durvāsārkaṃ ca saṃpūjya mucyate brahmahatyayā .. 23 ..
16.236.d:
माघे मासि सिते पक्षे सप्तम्यां संयतात्मवान् ..
दुर्वासार्कं च संपूज्य मुच्यते ब्रह्महत्यया .. 23 ..
16.236.m: On the seventh day of the bright fortnight in the month of Māgha, self-restrained, / having worshiped Durvāsārka, one is freed from the sin of killing a brahmin.

16.236.s:
snātvā tu yamunā kuṇḍe mādhave māsi mānavaḥ ..
pūjayedbhaktibhāvena raviṃ gaganabhūṣaṇam .. 24 ..
16.236.d:
स्नात्वा तु यमुना कुण्डे माधवे मासि मानवः ..
पूजयेद्भक्तिभावेन रविं गगनभूषणम् .. 24 ..
16.236.m: Having bathed in the Yamunā pool in the month of Mādhava, a human / should worship with devotion the Sun, the ornament of the sky.

16.236.s:
paṭhetsahasraṃ nāmnā tu durvāsādityasaṃnidhau ..
ṣaṇmāsānmucyate jaṃturyadyapi brahmahā naraḥ .. 25..
16.236.d:
पठेत्सहस्रं नाम्ना तु दुर्वासादित्यसंनिधौ ..
षण्मासान्मुच्यते जंतुर्यद्यपि ब्रह्महा नरः .. 25..
16.236.m: If he recites the thousand names in the presence of Durvāsāditya, / after six months a living creature is freed, even if the person is a slayer of a brahmin.

16.236.s:
sarvamaṃgalamāṃgalyaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam ..
durvāsādityanāmānaṃ sūryaṃ ko nu na pūjayet .. 26 ..
16.236.d:
सर्वमंगलमांगल्यं सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् ..
दुर्वासादित्यनामानं सूर्यं को नु न पूजयेत् .. 26 ..
16.236.m: The most auspicious of all auspicious things, the destroyer of all sins, / who indeed would not worship the Sun named Durvāsāditya?

16.236.s:
na tadasti bhayaṃ kiṃcidyadanena na śāmyati ..
darśanenāpi sūryasya tatra durvāsasaḥ priye .. 27 ..
16.236.d:
न तदस्ति भयं किंचिद्यदनेन न शाम्यति ..
दर्शनेनापि सूर्यस्य तत्र दुर्वाससः प्रिये .. 27 ..
16.236.m: There is no fear whatsoever that is not pacified by this, / even by the darśana of the Sun of Durvāsas there, O beloved.

16.236.s:
saṃpadyaṃte tathā kāmāḥ sarva eva yathepsitāḥ ..
baṃdhyānāṃ putraphaladaṃ bhītānāṃ bhayanāśanam.. 28 ..
16.236.d:
संपद्यंते तथा कामाः सर्व एव यथेप्सिताः ..
बंध्यानां पुत्रफलदं भीतानां भयनाशनम्.. 28 ..
16.236.m: Likewise, all desires whatever are attained as wished. / It grants the fruit of sons to barren women and destroys fear for the frightened.

16.236.s:
bhūtipradaṃ daridrāṇāṃ kuṣṭhināṃ paramauṣadham ..
bālānāṃ caiva sarveṣāṃ graharakṣonivāraṇam ..
mahāpāpopaśamanaṃ durvāsādityadarśanam.. 29 ..
16.236.d:
भूतिप्रदं दरिद्राणां कुष्ठिनां परमौषधम् ..
बालानां चैव सर्वेषां ग्रहरक्षोनिवारणम् ..
महापापोपशमनं दुर्वासादित्यदर्शनम्.. 29 ..
16.236.m: It grants prosperity to the poor and is the supreme medicine for lepers. / It removes evil spirits and demons from all children; / the darśana of Durvāsāditya pacifies great sins.

16.236.s:
hemāśvastatra dātavyaḥ sūryamuddiśya bhāmini ..
brāhmaṇe vedasaṃyukte tena dattā mahī bhavet .. 7.1.236.30 ..
16.236.d:
हेमाश्वस्तत्र दातव्यः सूर्यमुद्दिश्य भामिनि ..
ब्राह्मणे वेदसंयुक्ते तेन दत्ता मही भवेत् .. 7.1.236.30 ..
16.236.m: A golden horse should be given there dedicated to the Sun, O passionate woman, / to a brahmin endowed with Vedic learning; by that, the earth will have been given.

16.236.s:
yastatra pūjayeddevaṃ kṣetrapālaṃ ca dundubhim ..
sa putrapaśumāndhīmāñchrīmānbhavati mānavaḥ .. 31 ..
16.236.d:
यस्तत्र पूजयेद्देवं क्षेत्रपालं च दुन्दुभिम् ..
स पुत्रपशुमान्धीमाञ्छ्रीमान्भवति मानवः .. 31 ..
16.236.m: Whoever worships the god and Dundubhi, the guardian of the field, there, / that person becomes possessed of sons and cattle, wise, and prosperous.

16.236.s:
na bhayaṃ jāyate tasya trividhaṃ varavarṇini ..
ardhagavyūtimātraṃ tu tatra kṣetraṃ raveḥ smṛtam.. 32 ..
16.236.d:
न भयं जायते तस्य त्रिविधं वरवर्णिनि ..
अर्धगव्यूतिमात्रं तु तत्र क्षेत्रं रवेः स्मृतम्.. 32 ..
16.236.m: No threefold fear arises for him, O fair-complexioned one. / The kṣetra of the Sun is considered to be just half a gavyūti there.

16.236.s:
na tatra praviśejjantuḥ sūryabhaktivivarjitaḥ ..
ityetatkathitaṃ devi māhātmyaṃ sūryadaivatam .. 33 ..
16.236.d:
न तत्र प्रविशेज्जन्तुः सूर्यभक्तिविवर्जितः ..
इत्येतत्कथितं देवि माहात्म्यं सूर्यदैवतम् .. 33 ..
16.236.m: A creature destitute of devotion to the Sun should not enter there. / Thus this māhātmya dedicated to the Sun deity has been told to you, O goddess.

16.236.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye durvāsādityamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṭtriṃśaduttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. .. 236 ..
16.236.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये दुर्वासादित्यमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम षट्त्रिंशदुत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. .. 236 ..
16.236.m: Thus ends the two hundred and thirty-sixth chapter, named 'Description of the Māhātmya of Durvāsāditya', in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, in the seventh [section], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses, the glorious Skandapurāṇa.

16.237.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi yādavasthalamuttamam ..
yādavā yatra naṣṭā vai ṣaṭpaṃcāśacca koṭayaḥ .. 1 ..
16.237.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि यादवस्थलमुत्तमम् ..
यादवा यत्र नष्टा वै षट्पंचाशच्च कोटयः .. 1 ..
16.237.m: Īśvara said: / Then one should go, O great goddess, to the excellent Yādavasthala, / where fifty-six crores of Yādavas perished,

16.237.s:
yatra vajreśvaro devo vajreṇārādhitaḥ sadā ..
yatrābhūddivyadṛṣṭīnāmṛṣīṇāmāśramaṃ kulam .. 2 ..
16.237.d:
यत्र वज्रेश्वरो देवो वज्रेणाराधितः सदा ..
यत्राभूद्दिव्यदृष्टीनामृषीणामाश्रमं कुलम् .. 2 ..
16.237.m: where the god Vajreśvara was perpetually worshipped by Vajra, / [and] where there was the hermitage and lineage of the seers endowed with divine vision.

16.237.s:
.. devyuvāca .. ..
kathaṃ vinaṣṭā bhagavannandhakā vṛṣṇibhiḥ saha ..
paśyato vāsudevasya bhojāścaiva mahārathāḥ .. 3 ..
16.237.d:
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
कथं विनष्टा भगवन्नन्धका वृष्णिभिः सह ..
पश्यतो वासुदेवस्य भोजाश्चैव महारथाः .. 3 ..
16.237.m: The goddess said: / How did the Andhakas perish together with the Vṛṣṇis, / O Blessed One, along with the Bhojas, the great chariot-warriors, while Vāsudeva looked on?

16.237.s:
kena śaptāstu te vīrā naṣṭā vṛṣṇyandhakādayaḥ ..
bhojāścaiva mahādeva vistareṇa vadasva me .. 4 ..
16.237.d:
केन शप्तास्तु ते वीरा नष्टा वृष्ण्यन्धकादयः ..
भोजाश्चैव महादेव विस्तरेण वदस्व मे .. 4 ..
16.237.m: By whom were those heroes cursed, so that the Vṛṣṇis, Andhakas, and others / and the Bhojas perished, O Mahādeva? Tell me in detail.

16.237.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
ṣaṭtriṃśe ca kalau varṣe saṃprāpte'ndhakavṛṣṇayaḥ ..
anyonyaṃ muśalaiste hi nijaghnuḥ kālanoditāḥ .. 5 ..
16.237.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
षट्त्रिंशे च कलौ वर्षे संप्राप्तेऽन्धकवृष्णयः ..
अन्योन्यं मुशलैस्ते हि निजघ्नुः कालनोदिताः .. 5 ..
16.237.m: Īśvara said: / When the thirty-sixth year arrived in the Kali [age], the Andhakas and Vṛṣṇis, / impelled by Time, slew one another with iron pestles.

16.237.s:
viśvāmitraṃ ca kaṇvaṃ ca nāradaṃ ca yaśasvinam ..
sāraṇapramukhānbhojāndadṛśurdvārakāṃ gatān .. 6 ..
16.237.d:
विश्वामित्रं च कण्वं च नारदं च यशस्विनम् ..
सारणप्रमुखान्भोजान्ददृशुर्द्वारकां गतान् .. 6 ..
16.237.m: The Bhojas headed by Sāraṇa saw Viśvāmitra, / Kaṇva, and the glorious Nārada, who had come to Dvārakā.

16.237.s:
te vai sāṃbaṃ samāninyurbhūṣayitvā striyaṃ yathā ..
abruvannupasaṃgamya devadaṃḍanipīḍitāḥ .. 7 ..
16.237.d:
ते वै सांबं समानिन्युर्भूषयित्वा स्त्रियं यथा ..
अब्रुवन्नुपसंगम्य देवदंडनिपीडिताः .. 7 ..
16.237.m: Having adorned Sāmba like a woman, they brought [him] along, / and, afflicted by divine punishment, approached and spoke:

16.237.s:
iyaṃ strī putrakāmasya babhroramitatejasaḥ ..
ṛṣayaḥ sādhu jānīta kimiyaṃ janayiṣyati .. 8 ..
16.237.d:
इयं स्त्री पुत्रकामस्य बभ्रोरमिततेजसः ..
ऋषयः साधु जानीत किमियं जनयिष्यति .. 8 ..
16.237.m: 'This is the wife of Babhru of boundless splendour, who desires a son. / O seers, accurately discern: what will she give birth to?'

16.237.s:
ityuktāste tadā devi vipralaṃbhapradharṣitāḥ ..
pratyabruvaṃstānmunayastacchṛṇuṣva yathātatham .. 9 ..
16.237.d:
इत्युक्तास्ते तदा देवि विप्रलंभप्रधर्षिताः ..
प्रत्यब्रुवंस्तान्मुनयस्तच्छृणुष्व यथातथम् .. 9 ..
16.237.m: Addressed thus, O goddess, provoked by the deceit, / those sages replied to them. Hear that as it truly happened.

16.237.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
vṛṣṇyandhakavināśāya muśalaṃ ghoramāyasam..
vāsudevasya dāyādaḥ sāṃbo'yaṃ janayiṣyati .. 7.1.237.10 ..
16.237.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
वृष्ण्यन्धकविनाशाय मुशलं घोरमायसम्..
वासुदेवस्य दायादः सांबोऽयं जनयिष्यति .. 7.1.237.10 ..
16.237.m: The seers said: / 'For the destruction of the Vṛṣṇis and Andhakas, this Sāmba, / the heir of Vāsudeva, will give birth to a dreadful iron pestle,

16.237.s:
yena yūyaṃ sudurvṛttā nṛśaṃsā jātamanyavaḥ ..
ucchettāraḥ kulaṃ sarvamṛte rāmājjanārddanāt .. 11 ..
16.237.d:
येन यूयं सुदुर्वृत्ता नृशंसा जातमन्यवः ..
उच्छेत्तारः कुलं सर्वमृते रामाज्जनार्द्दनात् .. 11 ..
16.237.m: by which you wicked, cruel men, filled with wrath, / shall exterminate your entire race, except for Rāma and Janārdana.

16.237.s:
tyaktvā yāsyati vaḥ śrīmāṃtyaktvā bhūmiṃ halāyudhaḥ ..
jarā kṛṣṇaṃ mahābhāgaṃ śayānaṃ tu nivetsyati .. 12 ..
16.237.d:
त्यक्त्वा यास्यति वः श्रीमांत्यक्त्वा भूमिं हलायुधः ..
जरा कृष्णं महाभागं शयानं तु निवेत्स्यति .. 12 ..
16.237.m: Abandoning you, the glorious plough-weaponed one will leave the earth; / and Jarā will pierce the illustrious Kṛṣṇa as he lies asleep.'

16.237.s:
ityabruvaṃstato devi pralabdhāste durātmabhiḥ ..
munayaḥ krodharaktākṣāḥ samīkṣyātha parasparam .. 13 ..
16.237.d:
इत्यब्रुवंस्ततो देवि प्रलब्धास्ते दुरात्मभिः ..
मुनयः क्रोधरक्ताक्षाः समीक्ष्याथ परस्परम् .. 13 ..
16.237.m: Thus they spoke, O goddess, having been mocked by those evil-minded ones; / then those sages, their eyes red with wrath, looked at one another.

16.237.s:
tathoktā munayaste tu tataḥ keśavamabhyayuḥ ..
athāvadattadā vṛṣṇīñchrutvaivaṃ madhusūdanaḥ .. 14 ..
16.237.d:
तथोक्ता मुनयस्ते तु ततः केशवमभ्ययुः ..
अथावदत्तदा वृष्णीञ्छ्रुत्वैवं मधुसूदनः .. 14 ..
16.237.m: Having been addressed thus, those sages then went to Keśava. / Having heard this, Madhusūdana then said to the Vṛṣṇis:

16.237.s:
abhijño matimāṃstasya bhavitavyaṃ tatheti tat ..
evamuktvā hṛṣīkeśaḥ praviveśa punargṛhān .. 15 ..
16.237.d:
अभिज्ञो मतिमांस्तस्य भवितव्यं तथेति तत् ..
एवमुक्त्वा हृषीकेशः प्रविवेश पुनर्गृहान् .. 15 ..
16.237.m: 'That which is destined to be, shall be so.' / Having spoken thus, the wise Hṛṣīkeśa, knowing it, entered his house again.

16.237.s:
kṛtāṃtamanyathākarttuṃ naicchatsa jagataḥ prabhuḥ ..
śvobhūte satataḥ sāṃbo musalaṃ tadasūta vai ..16..
16.237.d:
कृतांतमन्यथाकर्त्तुं नैच्छत्स जगतः प्रभुः ..
श्वोभूते सततः सांबो मुसलं तदसूत वै ..16..
16.237.m: The Lord of the universe did not wish to alter the decree of Destiny. / On the following day, Sāmba indeed brought forth that iron pestle,

16.237.s:
yena vṛṇṣyandhakakule puruṣā bhasmasātkṛtāḥ..
vṛṣṇyandhakavināśāya kiṃkarapratimaṃ mahat .. 17 .. (kiṃkara – yamakiṃkara)
16.237.d:
येन वृण्ष्यन्धककुले पुरुषा भस्मसात्कृताः..
वृष्ण्यन्धकविनाशाय किंकरप्रतिमं महत् .. 17 .. (किंकर – यमकिंकर)
16.237.m: by which the men in the race of the Vṛṣṇis and Andhakas were reduced to ashes— / a great [pestle] resembling a messenger of Yama, meant for the destruction of the Vṛṣṇis and Andhakas.

16.237.s:
asūta śāpajaṃ ghoraṃ tacca rājñe nyavedayat ..
viṣaṇṇo'tha tato rājā sūkṣmaṃ cūrṇamakārayat .. 18 ..
16.237.d:
असूत शापजं घोरं तच्च राज्ञे न्यवेदयत् ..
विषण्णोऽथ ततो राजा सूक्ष्मं चूर्णमकारयत् .. 18 ..
16.237.m: He gave birth to that terrible thing born of a curse, and reported it to the king. / Then the king, despondent, had it ground into fine powder.

16.237.s:
prākṣipatsāgare tatra puruṣo rājaśāsitaḥ ..
athovāca svanagare vacanādāhukasya hi .. 19 ..
janārddanasya rāmasya babhroścaiva mahātmanaḥ ..
adyaprabhṛti sarveṣāṃ vṛṣṇandhakagṛheṣviha ..
surāsavo na karttavyaḥ sarvairviṣayavāsibhiḥ .. 7.1.237.2...
16.237.d:
प्राक्षिपत्सागरे तत्र पुरुषो राजशासितः ..
अथोवाच स्वनगरे वचनादाहुकस्य हि .. 19 ..
जनार्द्दनस्य रामस्य बभ्रोश्चैव महात्मनः ..
अद्यप्रभृति सर्वेषां वृष्णन्धकगृहेष्विह ..
सुरासवो न कर्त्तव्यः सर्वैर्विषयवासिभिः .. 7.1.237.2...
16.237.m:
A man directed by the king cast it into the ocean there. / Then, by the command of Āhuka,
and of Janārdana, Rāma, and the high-souled Babhru, he proclaimed in his city: / 'From this day forth, in the houses of all the Vṛṣṇis and Andhakas here, / no liquor or distilled spirit is to be made by any inhabitants of the realm.

16.237.s:
yaśca vo viditaṃ kuryādevaṃ kaścitkvacinnaraḥ ..
sa jīvañchūlamārohetsvayaṃ kṛtvā sabāṃdhavaḥ .. 21 ..
16.237.d:
यश्च वो विदितं कुर्यादेवं कश्चित्क्वचिन्नरः ..
स जीवञ्छूलमारोहेत्स्वयं कृत्वा सबांधवः .. 21 ..
16.237.m: And whatever man among you is known to do so anywhere, / he, having done so himself, shall be impaled alive on a stake along with his kin.'

16.237.s:
tato rājabhayātsarve niyamaṃ tatra cakrire ..
narāḥ śāsanamājñāya rāmasyākliṣṭakarmaṇaḥ .. 22 ..
16.237.d:
ततो राजभयात्सर्वे नियमं तत्र चक्रिरे ..
नराः शासनमाज्ञाय रामस्याक्लिष्टकर्मणः .. 22 ..
16.237.m: Then, out of fear of the king, all the men made a vow there, / having learned the command of Rāma of untiring deeds.

16.237.s:
evaṃ prayatamānānāṃ vṛṣṇīnāmandhakaiḥ saha ..
kālo gṛhāṇi sarvāṇi paricakrāma nityaśaḥ .. 23 ..
16.237.d:
एवं प्रयतमानानां वृष्णीनामन्धकैः सह ..
कालो गृहाणि सर्वाणि परिचक्राम नित्यशः .. 23 ..
16.237.m: While the Vṛṣṇis along with the Andhakas were thus taking precautions, / Time constantly wandered about all their houses:

16.237.s:
karālo vikaṭo muṃḍaḥ puruṣaḥ kṛṣṇapiṃgalaḥ ..
sammārjanī mahāketurjapāpuṣpāvataṃsakaḥ .. 24 ..
16.237.d:
करालो विकटो मुंडः पुरुषः कृष्णपिंगलः ..
सम्मार्जनी महाकेतुर्जपापुष्पावतंसकः .. 24 ..
16.237.m: a frightful, hideous, shaven-headed man of dark and reddish-brown hue, / with a broom as his great banner, wearing a China-rose as an ear-ornament,

16.237.s:
kṛkalāsavāhanaśca rattikākarṇabhūṣaṇaḥ ..
gṛhāṇyavekṣya vṛṣṇīnāṃ nādṛśyata punaḥ kvacit .. 25 ..
16.237.d:
कृकलासवाहनश्च रत्तिकाकर्णभूषणः ..
गृहाण्यवेक्ष्य वृष्णीनां नादृश्यत पुनः क्वचित् .. 25 ..
16.237.m: having a chameleon for his mount, and wearing a guñjā berry as an ear-ornament. / Having looked at the houses of the Vṛṣṇis, he was no longer seen anywhere.

16.237.s:
tasya cāsanmaheṣvāsāḥ śaraiḥ śatasahasraśaḥ ..
na cāśakyata veddhuṃ sa sarvabhūtāpyayaṃ sadā .. 26 ..
16.237.d:
तस्य चासन्महेष्वासाः शरैः शतसहस्रशः ..
न चाशक्यत वेद्धुं स सर्वभूताप्ययं सदा .. 26 ..
16.237.m: Great archers shot at him with arrows by hundreds and thousands, / but he, who is the perpetual dissolution of all beings, could not be pierced.

16.237.s:
utpedire mahāvātā dāruṇā hi dine dine ..
vṛṣṇyandhakavināśāya bahavo lomaharṣaṇāḥ .. 27 ..
16.237.d:
उत्पेदिरे महावाता दारुणा हि दिने दिने ..
वृष्ण्यन्धकविनाशाय बहवो लोमहर्षणाः .. 27 ..
16.237.m: Terrible and hair-raising great winds arose day after day / in abundance, portending the destruction of the Vṛṣṇis and Andhakas.

16.237.s:
vivṛddhya mūṣikā rathyāvitunnamaṇikāstathā ..
keśāndadaṃśuḥ suptānāṃ nṛṇāṃ yuvatayo niśi .. 28 ..
16.237.d:
विवृद्ध्य मूषिका रथ्यावितुन्नमणिकास्तथा ..
केशान्ददंशुः सुप्तानां नृणां युवतयो निशि .. 28 ..
16.237.m: Rats multiplied, the clay water-jars in the streets were broken open, / and at night [rodents] gnawed the hair of sleeping men and young women.

16.237.s:
cīcīkūcītyavāśaṃta sārikā vṛṣṇiveśmasu ..
nopaśāmyati śabdaśca sa divārātrameva vā .. 29 ..
16.237.d:
चीचीकूचीत्यवाशंत सारिका वृष्णिवेश्मसु ..
नोपशाम्यति शब्दश्च स दिवारात्रमेव वा .. 29 ..
16.237.m: Mynas in the houses of the Vṛṣṇis shrieked 'cīcīkūcī'; / and that sound did not cease, whether by day or by night.

16.237.s:
anvakurvannulūkāśca vāyasānvṛṣṇiveśmasu ..
ajāḥ śivānāṃ ca rutamanvakurvata bhāmini .. 7.1.237.30 ..
16.237.d:
अन्वकुर्वन्नुलूकाश्च वायसान्वृष्णिवेश्मसु ..
अजाः शिवानां च रुतमन्वकुर्वत भामिनि .. 7.1.237.30 ..
16.237.m: Owls imitated crows in the houses of the Vṛṣṇis, / and goats imitated the howling of jackals, O spirited lady!

16.237.s:
pāṃḍurāraktapādāśca vihagāḥ kālapreritāḥ ..
vṛṣṇyandhakagṛheṣvevaṃ kapotā vyacaraṃstadā .. 31 ..
16.237.d:
पांडुरारक्तपादाश्च विहगाः कालप्रेरिताः ..
वृष्ण्यन्धकगृहेष्वेवं कपोता व्यचरंस्तदा .. 31 ..
16.237.m: Pale-bodied birds with red feet, impelled by Time— / pigeons thus wandered about the houses of the Vṛṣṇis and Andhakas at that time.

16.237.s:
vyajāyaṃta kharā goṣu karabhāścāśvatarīṣu ca ..
śunīṣvapi biḍālāśca mūṣakā nakulīṣu ca .. 32 ..
16.237.d:
व्यजायंत खरा गोषु करभाश्चाश्वतरीषु च ..
शुनीष्वपि बिडालाश्च मूषका नकुलीषु च .. 32 ..
16.237.m: Donkeys were born from cows, and young camels from she-mules; / cats were born from female dogs, and mice from female mongooses.

16.237.s:
tāpatrayāṃta pāpāni kurvaṃto vṛṣṇayastathā ..
adviṣanbrāhmaṇāṃścāpi pitṝndevāṃstathaiva ca ..33..
16.237.d:
तापत्रयांत पापानि कुर्वंतो वृष्णयस्तथा ..
अद्विषन्ब्राह्मणांश्चापि पितॄन्देवांस्तथैव च ..33..
16.237.m: The Vṛṣṇis, committing sins that lead to the threefold affliction, / hated brahmins, ancestors, and the gods alike.

16.237.s:
gurūṃścāpyavamanyaṃte na tu rāmajanārdanau ..
bhāryāḥ patīnvyuccaraṃti patnīśca puruṣāstathā .. 34 ..
16.237.d:
गुरूंश्चाप्यवमन्यंते न तु रामजनार्दनौ ..
भार्याः पतीन्व्युच्चरंति पत्नीश्च पुरुषास्तथा .. 34 ..
16.237.m: They also showed disrespect to their elders, though not to Rāma and Janārdana; / wives transgressed against their husbands, and men likewise against their wives.

16.237.s:
vibhāvasuḥ prajvalito vāmaṃ viparivarttate ..
nīlalohitamāṃjiṣṭhā visṛjaṃścārciṣaḥ pṛthak .. 35 ..
16.237.d:
विभावसुः प्रज्वलितो वामं विपरिवर्त्तते ..
नीललोहितमांजिष्ठा विसृजंश्चार्चिषः पृथक् .. 35 ..
16.237.m: The fire, when blazing, turned to the left, / giving off distinct blue, red, and madder-coloured flames.

16.237.s:
udayāstamane nityaṃ paryastaḥ syāddivākaraḥ ..
vyadṛśyata sakṛtpuṃbhiḥ kabandhaiḥ parivāritaḥ .. 36 ..
16.237.d:
उदयास्तमने नित्यं पर्यस्तः स्याद्दिवाकरः ..
व्यदृश्यत सकृत्पुंभिः कबन्धैः परिवारितः .. 36 ..
16.237.m: At sunrise and sunset the sun was constantly overthrown [and eclipsed]; / it was seen by men surrounded by headless trunks.

16.237.s:
mahānaseṣu siddhāṃte saṃskṛte'nne tu bhāmini ..
uttāryamāṇe kṛmayo dṛśyaṃte ca varānane .. 37 ..
16.237.d:
महानसेषु सिद्धांते संस्कृतेऽन्ने तु भामिनि ..
उत्तार्यमाणे कृमयो दृश्यंते च वरानने .. 37 ..
16.237.m: O spirited lady, when food was prepared and dressed in the kitchens, / worms were seen in it as it was being served, O fair-faced one!

16.237.s:
puṇyāhe vācyamāne ca paṭhatsu ca mahātmasu ..
abhidhāvaṃti śrūyaṃte na cādṛśyata kaścana .. 38 ..
16.237.d:
पुण्याहे वाच्यमाने च पठत्सु च महात्मसु ..
अभिधावंति श्रूयंते न चादृश्यत कश्चन .. 38 ..
16.237.m: While an auspicious day was being proclaimed and great-souled men were reciting, / rushing sounds were heard, but no one was seen.

16.237.s:
parasparasya nakṣatraṃ hanyamānaṃ punaḥpunaḥ ..
grahairapaśyansarvaiste nātmanastu kathañcana .. 39 ..
16.237.d:
परस्परस्य नक्षत्रं हन्यमानं पुनःपुनः ..
ग्रहैरपश्यन्सर्वैस्ते नात्मनस्तु कथञ्चन .. 39 ..
16.237.m: They all saw one another's asterism repeatedly struck / by the planets, but by no means their own.

16.237.s:
na hutaṃ pācayatyagnirvṛṣṇyaṃdhakapuraskṛtam ..
samaṃtātpratyavāśaṃta rāsabhā dāruṇasvanāḥ .. 7.1.237.40 ..
16.237.d:
न हुतं पाचयत्यग्निर्वृष्ण्यंधकपुरस्कृतम् ..
समंतात्प्रत्यवाशंत रासभा दारुणस्वनाः .. 7.1.237.40 ..
16.237.m: The fire did not cook the offering presented by the Vṛṣṇis and Andhakas; / from all sides, donkeys brayed with terrible sounds.

16.237.s:
evaṃ paśyanhṛṣīkeśaḥ saṃprāptānkālaparyayān ..
trayodaśīṃ hyamāvāsyāṃ tāṃ dṛṣṭvā prābravīdidam.. 41 ..
16.237.d:
एवं पश्यन्हृषीकेशः संप्राप्तान्कालपर्ययान् ..
त्रयोदशीं ह्यमावास्यां तां दृष्ट्वा प्राब्रवीदिदम्.. 41 ..
16.237.m: Seeing these inversions of Time that had arrived, / Hṛṣīkeśa, beholding that thirteenth [tithi] as the new moon, spoke this:

16.237.s:
trayodaśī paṃcadaśī kṛteyaṃ rāhuṇā punaḥ ..
tadā ca bhārate yuddhe prāptā cādya kṣayāya naḥ .. 42 ..
16.237.d:
त्रयोदशी पंचदशी कृतेयं राहुणा पुनः ..
तदा च भारते युद्धे प्राप्ता चाद्य क्षयाय नः .. 42 ..
16.237.m: 'This thirteenth day has been made the fifteenth again by Rāhu; / it occurred then in the Bhārata war, and today it has arrived for our destruction.'

16.237.s:
dhigdhigityevakālaṃ taṃ pariciṃtya janārdanaḥ ..
mene prāptaṃ sa ṣaṭtriṃśaṃ varṣaṃ keśiniṣūdanaḥ ..
putraśokābhisaṃtaptā gāṃdhārī yaduvāca ha .. 43 ..
16.237.d:
धिग्धिगित्येवकालं तं परिचिंत्य जनार्दनः ..
मेने प्राप्तं स षट्त्रिंशं वर्षं केशिनिषूदनः ..
पुत्रशोकाभिसंतप्ता गांधारी यदुवाच ह .. 43 ..
16.237.m: Reflecting on that time, saying 'Fie, fie!', Janārdana, / the slayer of Keśin, considered that the thirty-sixth year had arrived, / [recalling] what Gāndhārī, afflicted with grief for her sons, had spoken:

16.237.s:
evaṃ paśyanhṛṣīkeśastadidaṃ samupasthitam..
idaṃ ca samanuprāptamabravīdyadyudhiṣṭhiraḥ .. 44 ..
16.237.d:
एवं पश्यन्हृषीकेशस्तदिदं समुपस्थितम्..
इदं च समनुप्राप्तमब्रवीद्यद्युधिष्ठिरः .. 44 ..
16.237.m: Seeing this come to pass, Hṛṣīkeśa [recalled] / what Yudhiṣṭhira had said had now also arrived,

16.237.s:
purā vyūḍheṣvanīkeṣu dṛṣṭvotpātānsudāruṇān..
puṇyagranthasya śravaṇācchāṃtihomādviśodhanāt ..45..
16.237.d:
पुरा व्यूढेष्वनीकेषु दृष्ट्वोत्पातान्सुदारुणान्..
पुण्यग्रन्थस्य श्रवणाच्छांतिहोमाद्विशोधनात् ..45..
16.237.m: Formerly, having seen dreadful portents when the battle arrays were deployed: / 'Other than listening to a sacred text, an expiatory fire offering, purification,

16.237.s:
pūtatīrthābhiṣekāṃcca nānyacchreyo bhavediti ..
ityuktvā vāsudevastaccikīrṣansatyameva ca ..
ājñāpayāmāsa tadā tīrthayātrāmariṃdamaḥ .. 46 ..
16.237.d:
पूततीर्थाभिषेकांच्च नान्यच्छ्रेयो भवेदिति ..
इत्युक्त्वा वासुदेवस्तच्चिकीर्षन्सत्यमेव च ..
आज्ञापयामास तदा तीर्थयात्रामरिंदमः .. 46 ..
16.237.m: and ablution in a pure sacred ford, there can be no other good.' / Having said this, wishing to make that very truth come about, / Vāsudeva, the subduer of enemies, then ordered a pilgrimage to the sacred ford.

16.237.s:
aghoṣayaṃta puruṣāstatra keśavaśāsanāt ..
tīrthayātrā prabhāse vai kāryeti varavarṇini .. 47 ..
16.237.d:
अघोषयंत पुरुषास्तत्र केशवशासनात् ..
तीर्थयात्रा प्रभासे वै कार्येति वरवर्णिनि .. 47 ..
16.237.m: By Keśava's command, men proclaimed there, / O woman of fair complexion: 'A pilgrimage must indeed be made to Prabhāsa.'

16.237.s:
athāriṣṭāni vakṣyāmi purīṃ dvāravatīṃ prati ..
kālī strī pāṃḍurairdaṃtaiḥ praviśya nagarīṃ niśi .. 48 ..
16.237.d:
अथारिष्टानि वक्ष्यामि पुरीं द्वारवतीं प्रति ..
काली स्त्री पांडुरैर्दंतैः प्रविश्य नगरीं निशि .. 48 ..
16.237.m: Now I shall tell of the portents regarding the city of Dvāravatī. / A black woman with pale teeth, entering the city at night,

16.237.s:
striyaḥ svapneṣu muṣṇantī dvārakāṃ prati dhāvati ..
agnihotraniketaṃ ca sumedhyeṣu ca veśmasu .. 49 ..
16.237.d:
स्त्रियः स्वप्नेषु मुष्णन्ती द्वारकां प्रति धावति ..
अग्निहोत्रनिकेतं च सुमेध्येषु च वेश्मसु .. 49 ..
16.237.m: robbing women in their dreams, ran toward Dvārakā, / and into the sanctuary of the sacred fire and pure dwellings.

16.237.s:
vṛṣṇyaṃdhakāṃśca khādaṃtī svapne dṛṣṭā bhayānakā ..
kurvaṃtī bhīṣaṇaṃ nādaṃ kurkuṭaśvānasaṃyutā .. 7.1.237.50 ..
16.237.d:
वृष्ण्यंधकांश्च खादंती स्वप्ने दृष्टा भयानका ..
कुर्वंती भीषणं नादं कुर्कुटश्वानसंयुता .. 7.1.237.50 ..
16.237.m: Devouring the Vṛṣṇis and Andhakas, the terrifying woman was seen in dreams, / making a dreadful screech, accompanied by roosters and dogs.

16.237.s:
tathā sahasraśo raudrāścaturbāhava eva ca ..
strīṇāṃ garbheṣvajāyaṃta rākṣasā guhyakāstathā .. .. 51 ..
16.237.d:
तथा सहस्रशो रौद्राश्चतुर्बाहव एव च ..
स्त्रीणां गर्भेष्वजायंत राक्षसा गुह्यकास्तथा .. .. 51 ..
16.237.m: Likewise, fearful four-armed rākṣasas and guhyakas / were born by the thousands from the wombs of women.

16.237.s:
alaṃkārāśca cchatrāṇi dhvajāśca kavacāni ca ..
hriyamāṇāni dṛśyaṃte rakṣobhistu bhayānakaiḥ .. 52..
16.237.d:
अलंकाराश्च च्छत्राणि ध्वजाश्च कवचानि च ..
ह्रियमाणानि दृश्यंते रक्षोभिस्तु भयानकैः .. 52..
16.237.m: Ornaments, parasols, banners, and armor / were seen being carried off by dreadful rakṣases.

16.237.s:
yaccāgnidattaṃ kṛṣṇasya vajranābhamayasmayam ..
divamācakrame cakraṃ vṛṣṇīnāṃ paśyatāṃ tadā .. 53 ..
16.237.d:
यच्चाग्निदत्तं कृष्णस्य वज्रनाभमयस्मयम् ..
दिवमाचक्रमे चक्रं वृष्णीनां पश्यतां तदा .. 53 ..
16.237.m: And the discus of iron with an adamantine navel given to Kṛṣṇa by Agni / ascended into heaven as the Vṛṣṇis watched then.

16.237.s:
yuktaṃ rathaṃ divyamādityavarṇaṃ bhayāvahaṃ paśyato dārukasya ..
te sāgarasyopariṣṭādvartamānānmanojavāṃścaturo vājimukhyān .. 54 ..
16.237.d:
युक्तं रथं दिव्यमादित्यवर्णं भयावहं पश्यतो दारुकस्य ..
ते सागरस्योपरिष्टाद्वर्तमानान्मनोजवांश्चतुरो वाजिमुख्यान् .. 54 ..
16.237.m: As Dāruka watched, the celestial, fearful chariot yoked [and] having the luster of the sun, / [and] the four foremost steeds, swift as thought, sped across the surface of the sea.

16.237.s:
tālaḥ suparṇaśca mahādhvajau tau supūjitau rāmajanārdanābhyām ..
uccairjaguḥ svapsaraso divāniśaṃ vācaṃ cocurgamyatāṃ tīrthayātrām .. 55 ..
16.237.d:
तालः सुपर्णश्च महाध्वजौ तौ सुपूजितौ रामजनार्दनाभ्याम् ..
उच्चैर्जगुः स्वप्सरसो दिवानिशं वाचं चोचुर्गम्यतां तीर्थयात्राम् .. 55 ..
16.237.m: The two great banners—the palm tree and Suparṇa—greatly worshipped by Rāma and Janārdana [vanished]; / apsarases sang loudly night and day, and spoke these words: 'Go on a pilgrimage to the sacred ford.'

16.237.s:
tato jigamiṣaṃtaste vṛṣṇyaṃdhakamahārathāḥ ..
sāṃtaḥpurāstīrthayātrāmīhaṃte sma nararṣabhāḥ ..56..
16.237.d:
ततो जिगमिषंतस्ते वृष्ण्यंधकमहारथाः ..
सांतःपुरास्तीर्थयात्रामीहंते स्म नरर्षभाः ..56..
16.237.m: Then, desiring to depart, those great chariot-warriors of the Vṛṣṇis and Andhakas, / the bulls among men, set their minds on the pilgrimage together with their harems.

16.237.s:
tato māṃsaparā hṛṣṭāḥ peyaṃ veśmasu vṛṣṇayaḥ ..
bahu nānāvidhaṃ cakrurmāṃsāni vividhāni ca .. 57 ..
16.237.d:
ततो मांसपरा हृष्टाः पेयं वेश्मसु वृष्णयः ..
बहु नानाविधं चक्रुर्मांसानि विविधानि च .. 57 ..
16.237.m: Then, delighted and devoted to meat, the Vṛṣṇis prepared drinks / of many diverse kinds in their homes, and diverse meats.

16.237.s:
tathā sīdhuṣu baddheṣu niryayurnagarādbahiḥ ..
yānairaśvairgajaiścaiva śrīmaṃtastigmatejasaḥ .. 58 ..
16.237.d:
तथा सीधुषु बद्धेषु निर्ययुर्नगराद्बहिः ..
यानैरश्वैर्गजैश्चैव श्रीमंतस्तिग्मतेजसः .. 58 ..
16.237.m: Likewise, with liquor packed [for travel], the illustrious ones of fierce splendor / went out of the city with vehicles, horses, and elephants.

16.237.s:
tataḥ prabhāse nyavasanyathoddeśaṃ yathāgṛham ..
prabhūtabhakṣyapeyāste sadārā yādavāstadā .. 59 ..
16.237.d:
ततः प्रभासे न्यवसन्यथोद्देशं यथागृहम् ..
प्रभूतभक्ष्यपेयास्ते सदारा यादवास्तदा .. 59 ..
16.237.m: Then the Yādavas, together with their wives, dwelling in Prabhāsa / each in his appointed place and quarters, had abundant food and drink.

16.237.s:
nirviṣṭāṃstānniśamyātha samudrāṃte sa yogavit ..
jagāmāmaṃtrya tānvīrānuddhavorthaviśāradaḥ .. 7.1.237.60 ..
16.237.d:
निर्विष्टांस्तान्निशम्याथ समुद्रांते स योगवित् ..
जगामामंत्र्य तान्वीरानुद्धवोर्थविशारदः .. 7.1.237.60 ..
16.237.m: Hearing that they had settled there at the shore of the sea, the knower of yoga, / Uddhava, skilled in what is beneficial, took leave of those heroes and departed.

16.237.s:
prasthitaṃ taṃ mahātmānamabhivādya kṛtāṃjalim..
jānanvināśaṃ bhojānāṃ naicchadvārayituṃ hariḥ .. 61 ..
16.237.d:
प्रस्थितं तं महात्मानमभिवाद्य कृतांजलिम्..
जानन्विनाशं भोजानां नैच्छद्वारयितुं हरिः .. 61 ..
16.237.m: To that great-souled one who had set out, greeting with folded hands, / Hari, knowing the destruction of the Bhojas, did not wish to stop him.

16.237.s:
tataḥ kālaparītāste vṛṣṇyaṃdhakamahārathāḥ ..
apaśyannuddhavaṃ yāṃtaṃ tejasā''dīpya rodasī .. 62 ..
16.237.d:
ततः कालपरीतास्ते वृष्ण्यंधकमहारथाः ..
अपश्यन्नुद्धवं यांतं तेजसा'ऽदीप्य रोदसी .. 62 ..
16.237.m: Then those great chariot-warriors of the Vṛṣṇis and Andhakas, seized by time, / saw Uddhava departing, illuminating heaven and earth with his splendor.

16.237.s:
brāhmaṇārtheṣu yatklṛptamannaṃ teṣāṃ varānane ..
tadvāhanebhyaḥ pradaduḥ surāgaṃdharasānvitam..63..
16.237.d:
ब्राह्मणार्थेषु यत्क्लृप्तमन्नं तेषां वरानने ..
तद्वाहनेभ्यः प्रददुः सुरागंधरसान्वितम्..63..
16.237.m: The food that was prepared for the sake of brahmins, O fair-faced lady, / they gave to their horses, mixed with the smell and taste of liquor.

16.237.s:
tatastūryaśatākīrṇaṃ naṭanarttakasaṃkulam..
prāvarttata mahāpānaṃ prabhāse tigmatejasām.. 64..
16.237.d:
ततस्तूर्यशताकीर्णं नटनर्त्तकसंकुलम्..
प्रावर्त्तत महापानं प्रभासे तिग्मतेजसाम्.. 64..
16.237.m: Then, filled with hundreds of musical instruments and crowded with actors and dancers, / a great drinking bout of those of fierce splendor commenced at Prabhāsa.

16.237.s:
kṛṣṇasya saṃnidhau rāmaḥ sahitaḥ kṛtavarmaṇā ..
apibadyuyudhānaśca gado babhrustathaiva ca ..65..
16.237.d:
कृष्णस्य संनिधौ रामः सहितः कृतवर्मणा ..
अपिबद्युयुधानश्च गदो बभ्रुस्तथैव च ..65..
16.237.m: In the presence of Kṛṣṇa, Rāma drank together with Kṛtavarman, / and Yuyudhāna, Gada, and Babhru as well.

16.237.s:
tataḥ pariṣado madhye yuyudhāno madotkaṭaḥ ..
abravītkṛtavarmāṇamavahasyāvamanya ca .. 66 ..
16.237.d:
ततः परिषदो मध्ये युयुधानो मदोत्कटः ..
अब्रवीत्कृतवर्माणमवहस्यावमन्य च .. 66 ..
16.237.m: Then in the midst of the assembly, Yuyudhāna, intoxicated with drink, / spoke to Kṛtavarman, mocking and disdaining him:

16.237.s:
kaḥ kṣatriyo manyamānaḥ suptānhanyānmṛtāniva ..
na tanmṛṣyata hārdikyastvayā tatsādhu yatkṛtam .. 67 ..
16.237.d:
कः क्षत्रियो मन्यमानः सुप्तान्हन्यान्मृतानिव ..
न तन्मृष्यत हार्दिक्यस्त्वया तत्साधु यत्कृतम् .. 67 ..
16.237.m: 'What kṣatriya, considering himself [one], would slay sleeping men like corpses? / No descendant of Hṛdīka should condone that; how was that well done by you?'

16.237.s:
ityukte yuyudhānena pūjayāmāsa tadvacaḥ ..
pradyumno rathināṃ śreṣṭho hārdikyamatha bhartsayan .. 68 ..
16.237.d:
इत्युक्ते युयुधानेन पूजयामास तद्वचः ..
प्रद्युम्नो रथिनां श्रेष्ठो हार्दिक्यमथ भर्त्सयन् .. 68 ..
16.237.m: When this was spoken by Yuyudhāna, Pradyumna, the foremost of chariot-warriors, / praised that speech, and then rebuked the descendant of Hṛdīka.

16.237.s:
tataḥ punarapi kruddhaḥ kṛtavarmā tamabravīt ..
nirviśanniva sāvajñaṃ tadā savyena pāṇinā .. 69 ..
16.237.d:
ततः पुनरपि क्रुद्धः कृतवर्मा तमब्रवीत् ..
निर्विशन्निव सावज्ञं तदा सव्येन पाणिना .. 69 ..
16.237.m: Then Kṛtavarman, enraged again, spoke to him, / pointing scornfully at him with his left hand:

16.237.s:
bhūriśravāśchinnabāhuryuddhe prāyogatastvayā ..
vyādheneva nṛśaṃsena kathaṃ vaireṇa ghātitaḥ .. 7.1.237.70 ..
16.237.d:
भूरिश्रवाश्छिन्नबाहुर्युद्धे प्रायोगतस्त्वया ..
व्याधेनेव नृशंसेन कथं वैरेण घातितः .. 7.1.237.70 ..
16.237.m: 'How was Bhūriśravas, whose arm was severed in battle and who was seated for the vow of death, / slain by you out of enmity, like by a cruel hunter?'

16.237.s:
iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā keśavaḥ paravīrahā ..
tiryaksaroṣayā dṛṣṭyā vīkṣāṃcakre samaḥ pumān .. 71 ..
16.237.d:
इति तस्य वचः श्रुत्वा केशवः परवीरहा ..
तिर्यक्सरोषया दृष्ट्या वीक्षांचक्रे समः पुमान् .. 71 ..
16.237.m: Hearing his words, Keśava, the slayer of enemy heroes, / that impartial person, glanced askance with an angry look.

16.237.s:
maṇiṃ syamaṃtakaṃ caiva yaḥ sa satrājito'bhavat ..
sa kathaṃ smārayāmāsa sātyakirmadhusūdanam .. 72 ..
16.237.d:
मणिं स्यमंतकं चैव यः स सत्राजितोऽभवत् ..
स कथं स्मारयामास सात्यकिर्मधुसूदनम् .. 72 ..
16.237.m: And how Sātyaki reminded Madhusūdana / of the Syamantaka jewel, which belonged to Satrājit!

16.237.s:
tacchrutvā keśavasyāṃkamagamadrudatī satī ..
satyabhāmā prakṣubhitā kopayantī janārddanam .. 73 ..
16.237.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा केशवस्यांकमगमद्रुदती सती ..
सत्यभामा प्रक्षुभिता कोपयन्ती जनार्द्दनम् .. 73 ..
16.237.m: Hearing that, the virtuous Satyabhāmā, weeping, went to Keśava's lap, / agitated and inciting Janārdana to anger.

16.237.s:
tata utthāya sa krodhātsātyakirvākyamabravīt ..
paṃcānāṃ draupadeyānāṃ dhṛṣṭadyumnaśikhaṃḍinaḥ .. 74 ..
16.237.d:
तत उत्थाय स क्रोधात्सात्यकिर्वाक्यमब्रवीत् ..
पंचानां द्रौपदेयानां धृष्टद्युम्नशिखंडिनः .. 74 ..
16.237.m: Then, rising in anger, Sātyaki spoke these words: / 'For the sake of the five sons of Draupadī, of Dhṛṣṭadyumna, and of Śikhaṇḍin,

16.237.s:
eṣa gacchāmi padavīṃ satye tava pathe sadā ..
sauptike nihatā ye ca suptāstena durātmanā .. 75 ..
16.237.d:
एष गच्छामि पदवीं सत्ये तव पथे सदा ..
सौप्तिके निहता ये च सुप्तास्तेन दुरात्मना .. 75 ..
16.237.m: I go upon this path, ever adhering to your truth! / And those who were asleep were slain during the night attack by that evil-souled

16.237.s:
droṇaputrasahāyena pāpena kṛtavarmaṇā ..
samāptaṃ cāyurasyādya yaśaścāpi sumadhyame .. 76 ..
16.237.d:
द्रोणपुत्रसहायेन पापेन कृतवर्मणा ..
समाप्तं चायुरस्याद्य यशश्चापि सुमध्यमे .. 76 ..
16.237.m: wicked Kṛtavarman, the companion of Droṇa's son! / Today his lifespan and also his fame are ended, O woman of slender waist!'

16.237.s:
itīdamuktvā khaṅgena keśavasya samīpataḥ ..
abhihatya śiraḥ kruddhaściccheda kṛtavarmaṇaḥ .. 77 ..
16.237.d:
इतीदमुक्त्वा खङ्गेन केशवस्य समीपतः ..
अभिहत्य शिरः क्रुद्धश्चिच्छेद कृतवर्मणः .. 77 ..
16.237.m: Having said this, striking near Keśava with a sword, / he furiously cut off Kṛtavarman's head.

16.237.s:
tathānyānapi nighnaṃtaṃ yuyudhānaṃ samaṃtataḥ ..
anvadhāvaddhṛṣīkeśo vinivārayiṣustathā .. 78 ..
16.237.d:
तथान्यानपि निघ्नंतं युयुधानं समंततः ..
अन्वधावद्धृषीकेशो विनिवारयिषुस्तथा .. 78 ..
16.237.m: As he was striking others all around as well, / Hṛṣīkeśa rushed after Yuyudhāna, wishing to restrain him.

16.237.s:
ekībhūtāstatastasya kālaparyāyapreritāḥ ..
bhojāṃdhakā mahārājaṃ śaineyaṃ paryavārayan .. 79 ..
16.237.d:
एकीभूतास्ततस्तस्य कालपर्यायप्रेरिताः ..
भोजांधका महाराजं शैनेयं पर्यवारयन् .. 79 ..
16.237.m: Then, having united, impelled by the turn of time, / the Bhojas and Andhakas surrounded the descendant of Śini, O great king.

16.237.s:
tāndṛṣṭvā''patatastūrṇamabhikruddhāñjanārddanaḥ ..
na cukrodha mahātejā jānankālasya paryayam .. 7.1.237.80 ..
16.237.d:
तान्दृष्ट्वा'ऽपततस्तूर्णमभिक्रुद्धाञ्जनार्द्दनः ..
न चुक्रोध महातेजा जानन्कालस्य पर्ययम् .. 7.1.237.80 ..
16.237.m: Seeing them rushing swiftly in great fury, Janārdana, / of great splendor, did not become angry, knowing the turn of time.

16.237.s:
te ca pānamadāviṣṭāścoditāścaiva manyunā ..
yuyudhānamathājaghnurucchiṣṭai rbhojanaistathā .. 81 ..
16.237.d:
ते च पानमदाविष्टाश्चोदिताश्चैव मन्युना ..
युयुधानमथाजघ्नुरुच्छिष्टै र्भोजनैस्तथा .. 81 ..
16.237.m: And overcome with the intoxication of drink and impelled by wrath, / they then struck Yuyudhāna even with the leftovers of their meal.

16.237.s:
hanyamāne tu śaineye kuddho rukmiṇinaṃdanaḥ ..
tadaṃtaramathādhāvanmokṣayiṣyañchineḥ sutam .. 82 ..
16.237.d:
हन्यमाने तु शैनेये कुद्धो रुक्मिणिनंदनः ..
तदंतरमथाधावन्मोक्षयिष्यञ्छिनेः सुतम् .. 82 ..
16.237.m: While the descendant of Śini was being struck, the son of Rukmiṇī, enraged, / ran into their midst, wishing to rescue the son of Śini.

16.237.s:
sa bhojaiḥ saha saṃyuktaḥ sātyakiścāṃdhakaiḥ saha ..
bahutvāttu hatau vīrāvubhau kṛṣṇasya paśyataḥ .. 83 ..
16.237.d:
स भोजैः सह संयुक्तः सात्यकिश्चांधकैः सह ..
बहुत्वात्तु हतौ वीरावुभौ कृष्णस्य पश्यतः .. 83 ..
16.237.m: He joined battle with the Bhojas, and Sātyaki with the Andhakas; / but because of their numbers, both heroes were slain as Kṛṣṇa looked on.

16.237.s:
hataṃ dṛṣṭvā tu śaineyaṃ putraṃ ca yadunaṃdanaḥ ..
erakāṇāṃ tadā muṣṭiṃ kopājjagrāha keśavaḥ .. 84 ..
16.237.d:
हतं दृष्ट्वा तु शैनेयं पुत्रं च यदुनंदनः ..
एरकाणां तदा मुष्टिं कोपाज्जग्राह केशवः .. 84 ..
16.237.m: Seeing the descendant of Śini and his son slain, the joy of the Yadus, / Keśava, then grasped a fistful of erakā grass in rage.

16.237.s:
tadabhūnmuśalaṃ ghoraṃ vajrakalpamayasmayam ..
jaghāna tena kṛṣṇopi ye tasya pramukhe sthitāḥ .. 89 ..
tatoṃ'dhakāśca bhojāśca śinayo vṛṣṇayastadā ..
nyaghnannanyonyamākrandairmuśalaiḥ kālapreritāḥ .. 86 ..
yaścaikāmerakāṃ kaścijjagrāha ruṣito naraḥ ..
vajrabhūtā ca sā devi hyadṛśyata tadā priye .. 87 ..
tṛṇaṃ ca muśalībhūtamaṇvapi tatra dṛśyate ..
brahmadaṃḍakṛtaṃ sarvamiti tadviddhi bhāmini .. 88 ..
āvidhyāvidhya deveśi praharaṃti sma sāyakān..
tadvajrabhūtaṃ muśalamapaśyaṃta tadā dṛḍham .. 89 ..
16.237.d:
तदभून्मुशलं घोरं वज्रकल्पमयस्मयम् ..
जघान तेन कृष्णोपि ये तस्य प्रमुखे स्थिताः .. 89 ..
ततोंऽधकाश्च भोजाश्च शिनयो वृष्णयस्तदा ..
न्यघ्नन्नन्योन्यमाक्रन्दैर्मुशलैः कालप्रेरिताः .. 86 ..
यश्चैकामेरकां कश्चिज्जग्राह रुषितो नरः ..
वज्रभूता च सा देवि ह्यदृश्यत तदा प्रिये .. 87 ..
तृणं च मुशलीभूतमण्वपि तत्र दृश्यते ..
ब्रह्मदंडकृतं सर्वमिति तद्विद्धि भामिनि .. 88 ..
आविध्याविध्य देवेशि प्रहरंति स्म सायकान्..
तद्वज्रभूतं मुशलमपश्यंत तदा दृढम् .. 89 ..
16.237.m:
That became a terrible iron club resembling a thunderbolt; / with it Kṛṣṇa also struck down whoever stood before him.
Then the Andhakas, Bhojas, Śinis, and Vṛṣṇis, / driven by destiny, struck down one another with clubs amid loud shrieks.
And whatever blade of grass any man angrily seized, / O goddess, it appeared turned into an adamantine club at that time, O beloved.
Even a tiny blade of grass was seen there turned into a club. / Know that all this was brought about by the curse of the brahmins, O spirited lady.
Hurling repeatedly, O queen of gods, they discharged missiles; / then they saw the solid club turned into an adamantine weapon.

16.237.s:
avadhītpitaraṃ putraḥ pitā putraṃ ca bhāmini ..
mattāste paryaṭaṃti sma yodhamānāḥ parasparam .. 7.1.237.90 ..
16.237.d:
अवधीत्पितरं पुत्रः पिता पुत्रं च भामिनि ..
मत्तास्ते पर्यटंति स्म योधमानाः परस्परम् .. 7.1.237.90 ..
16.237.m: Son killed father, and father killed son, O spirited lady; / intoxicated, they roamed about fighting one another.

16.237.s:
pataṃgā iva cāgnau tu nyapatanyadupuṃgavāḥ ..
nāsītpalāyane buddhirvadhyamānasya kasyacit .. 91 ..
16.237.d:
पतंगा इव चाग्नौ तु न्यपतन्यदुपुंगवाः ..
नासीत्पलायने बुद्धिर्वध्यमानस्य कस्यचित् .. 91 ..
