16.237.m: Like moths into fire, the bull-like Yadus fell; / no one who was being struck had any thought of fleeing.

16.237.s:
taṃ tu paśyanmahābāhurjānankālasyaparyayam ..
muśalaṃ samavaṣṭabhya tasthau sa madhusūdanaḥ .. 92 ..
16.237.d:
तं तु पश्यन्महाबाहुर्जानन्कालस्यपर्ययम् ..
मुशलं समवष्टभ्य तस्थौ स मधुसूदनः .. 92 ..
16.237.m: Looking upon that, however, and knowing the turn of destiny, / the mighty-armed Madhusūdana stood leaning upon his club.

16.237.s:
sāṃbaṃ ca nihataṃ dṛṣṭvā cārudeṣṇaṃ ca mādhavaḥ ..
pradyumnamaniruddhaṃ ca tataścukrodha bhāmini .. 93 ..
16.237.d:
सांबं च निहतं दृष्ट्वा चारुदेष्णं च माधवः ..
प्रद्युम्नमनिरुद्धं च ततश्चुक्रोध भामिनि .. 93 ..
16.237.m: And seeing Sāmba, Cārudeṣṇa, Pradyumna, and Aniruddha / slain, Mādhava then grew furious, O spirited lady.

16.237.s:
yādavānkṣmāśayānāṃśca bhṛśaṃ kopasamanvitaḥ ..
sa niḥśeṣaṃ tadā cakre śārṅgacakragadādharaḥ .. 94 ..
16.237.d:
यादवान्क्ष्माशयानांश्च भृशं कोपसमन्वितः ..
स निःशेषं तदा चक्रे शार्ङ्गचक्रगदाधरः .. 94 ..
16.237.m: Filled with intense anger toward the Yādavas lying on the ground, / the wielder of the bow, discus, and mace then annihilated them without remainder.

16.237.s:
evaṃ tatra mahādevi abhavadyādava sthalam ..
gavyūtimātraṃ taddevi yādavānāṃ citāḥ smṛtāḥ .. 95 ..
16.237.d:
एवं तत्र महादेवि अभवद्यादव स्थलम् ..
गव्यूतिमात्रं तद्देवि यादवानां चिताः स्मृताः .. 95 ..
16.237.m: Thus, O great goddess, the Yādava-sthala came to be there; / that [area] of just one gavyūti, O goddess, is considered the funeral pyre of the Yādavas.

16.237.s:
teṣāṃ kilāsthinicayaiḥ sthalarūpaṃ babhūva tat ..
bhasmapuṃjanibhākāraṃ tenābhūdyādava sthalam .. 96 ..
16.237.d:
तेषां किलास्थिनिचयैः स्थलरूपं बभूव तत् ..
भस्मपुंजनिभाकारं तेनाभूद्यादव स्थलम् .. 96 ..
16.237.m: Indeed, by the heaps of their bones it took the form of a raised ground; / resembling an accumulation of ashes, it became thereby the Yādava-sthala.

16.237.s:
divyaratnasamāyuktaṃ maṇimāṇikyapūritam ..
yādavānāṃ kirīṭaiśca divyagandhaiḥ supūritam.. 97 ..
16.237.d:
दिव्यरत्नसमायुक्तं मणिमाणिक्यपूरितम् ..
यादवानां किरीटैश्च दिव्यगन्धैः सुपूरितम्.. 97 ..
16.237.m: It was filled with divine jewels, packed with gems and rubies, / with the diadems of the Yādavas, and permeated with divine perfumes.

16.237.s:
teṣāṃ rakṣānimittaṃ hi gaṃgā gaṇapatistathā ..
yādavānāṃ tu sarveṣāṃ jīvito vajra eva hi .. 98 ..
16.237.d:
तेषां रक्षानिमित्तं हि गंगा गणपतिस्तथा ..
यादवानां तु सर्वेषां जीवितो वज्र एव हि .. 98 ..
16.237.m: For their protection, indeed, are the Gaṅgā and Gaṇapati; / of all the Yādavas, Vajra alone remained alive.

16.237.s:
vayasoṃte tataḥ so'pi prabhāsaṃ kṣetramāgataḥ ..
niṣicya svasutaṃ rājye nāmnā khyātaṃ mahadbalam .. 99 ..
16.237.d:
वयसोंते ततः सोऽपि प्रभासं क्षेत्रमागतः ..
निषिच्य स्वसुतं राज्ये नाम्ना ख्यातं महद्बलम् .. 99 ..
16.237.m: Then, at the end of his life, having consecrated his own son / renowned by name as Mahadbala on the throne, he too came to Prabhāsa kṣetra.

16.237.s:
tenāpi sthāpitaṃ liṃgaṃ yādavendreṇa dhīmatā ..
vajreśvaramiti khyātaṃ tatsthitaṃ yādavasthale ..7.1.237.100..
16.237.d:
तेनापि स्थापितं लिंगं यादवेन्द्रेण धीमता ..
वज्रेश्वरमिति ख्यातं तत्स्थितं यादवस्थले ..7.1.237.100..
16.237.m: A liṅga was established even by him, the wise lord of the Yādavas, / renowned as Vajreśvara, situated at the Yādava-sthala.

16.237.s:
tatraiva suciraṃ kālaṃ tapastaptaṃ supuṣkalam ..
nāradasyopadeśena prabhāse pāpanāśane .. 101 ..
16.237.d:
तत्रैव सुचिरं कालं तपस्तप्तं सुपुष्कलम् ..
नारदस्योपदेशेन प्रभासे पापनाशने .. 101 ..
16.237.m: Right there, by the instruction of Nārada, he performed copious austerity / for a very long time in Prabhāsa, which destroys sin.

16.237.s:
prāptavānparamāṃ siddhiṃ sa rājā yādavottamaḥ ..
tatraiva yo naraḥ samyaksnātvā jāṃbavatī jale .. 102 ..
16.237.d:
प्राप्तवान्परमां सिद्धिं स राजा यादवोत्तमः ..
तत्रैव यो नरः सम्यक्स्नात्वा जांबवती जले .. 102 ..
16.237.m: That king, the best of the Yādavas, attained supreme perfection. / The person who, having bathed properly right there in the waters of the Jāmbavatī,

16.237.s:
vajreśvaraṃ tu saṃpūjya brāhmaṇāṃstatra bhojayet ..
yādavasthalasāmīpye gosahasraphalaṃ labhet .. 103 ..
16.237.d:
वज्रेश्वरं तु संपूज्य ब्राह्मणांस्तत्र भोजयेत् ..
यादवस्थलसामीप्ये गोसहस्रफलं लभेत् .. 103 ..
16.237.m: and having worshipped Vajreśvara, feeds brahmins there / in the vicinity of the Yādava-sthala, obtains the fruit of [gifting] a thousand cows.

16.237.s:
ṣaṭkoṇaṃ tatra dātavyamaṃgulyā yādavasthale ..
yātrāphalamavāpnoti samyakchraddhāsamanvitaḥ .. 104 ..
16.237.d:
षट्कोणं तत्र दातव्यमंगुल्या यादवस्थले ..
यात्राफलमवाप्नोति सम्यक्छ्रद्धासमन्वितः .. 104 ..
16.237.m: A hexagon should be drawn there with a finger at the Yādava-sthala; / endowed with proper faith, he attains the fruit of pilgrimage.

16.237.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathameprabhāsakṣetramāhātmye yādavasthalotpattau vajreśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptatriṃśaduttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 237 ..
16.237.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमेप्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये यादवस्थलोत्पत्तौ वज्रेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम सप्तत्रिंशदुत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 237 ..
16.237.m: Thus ends the two hundred thirty-seventh chapter, named 'Description of the Glory of Vajreśvara at the Origin of Yādava-sthala', in the first [part], the Prabhāsa-kṣetra-māhātmya, of the seventh section, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

16.238.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi hiraṇyāṃ pāpanāśinīm ..
sarvakāmapradāṃ puṇyāṃ dāridryasyāṃtakāriṇīm .. 1 ..
16.238.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि हिरण्यां पापनाशिनीम् ..
सर्वकामप्रदां पुण्यां दारिद्र्यस्यांतकारिणीम् .. 1 ..
16.238.m: Īśvara said: / Next, O great goddess, one should go to the Hiraṇyā, which destroys sin, / grants all desires, is sacred, and puts an end to poverty.

16.238.s:
tatra snātvā vidhānena kṛtvā piṃḍodaka kriyām ..
prāpnuyādakṣayām̐llokānpitṝnuddhṛtya pāpataḥ ..2..
16.238.d:
तत्र स्नात्वा विधानेन कृत्वा पिंडोदक क्रियाम् ..
प्राप्नुयादक्षयाम्̐ल्लोकान्पितॄनुद्धृत्य पापतः ..2..
16.238.m: Having bathed there according to the rules and performed the rite of rice balls and water, / having delivered the ancestors from sin, one attains imperishable worlds.

16.238.s:
ekaṃ yo bhojayettatra brāhmaṇaṃ śaṃsitavratam ..
tenāyutasahasraṃ hi bhojitaṃ syāddvijanmanām .. .. 3 ..
16.238.d:
एकं यो भोजयेत्तत्र ब्राह्मणं शंसितव्रतम् ..
तेनायुतसहस्रं हि भोजितं स्याद्द्विजन्मनाम् .. .. 3 ..
16.238.m: Whoever feeds a single brahmin of commended vows there, / by him ten thousand twice-born persons would indeed be fed.

16.238.s:
tatra hemarathā deyo brāhmaṇe vedapārage ..
vidhinā śivamuddiśya yātrāyutaphalaṃ labhet .. 4 ..
16.238.d:
तत्र हेमरथा देयो ब्राह्मणे वेदपारगे ..
विधिना शिवमुद्दिश्य यात्रायुतफलं लभेत् .. 4 ..
16.238.m: A golden chariot should be given there to a brahmin who has mastered the Vedas, / dedicated to Śiva in accordance with the rule; one obtains the fruit of ten thousand pilgrimages.

16.238.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyā saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye hiraṇyānadīmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭātriṃśaduttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 238 ..
16.238.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहिताया सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये हिरण्यानदीमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामाष्टात्रिंशदुत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 238 ..
16.238.m: Thus ends the two hundred thirty-eighth chapter, named 'Description of the Glory of the River Hiraṇyā', in the first [part], the Prabhāsa-kṣetra-māhātmya, of the seventh section, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

16.239.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi hiraṇyāpārśvataḥ sthitam ..
pratyuktaṃ nāgarādityaṃ sarvavyādhivināśanam .. 1 ..
16.239.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि हिरण्यापार्श्वतः स्थितम् ..
प्रत्युक्तं नागरादित्यं सर्वव्याधिविनाशनम् .. 1 ..
16.239.m: Īśvara said: / Next, O great goddess, one should go to the one situated near the Hiraṇyā, / called Nāgarāditya, which destroys all diseases.

16.239.s:
purā satrājitā rājñā dvāravatyāṃ gatena tu ..
ārādhito bhāskaro'bhūdyādavena mahātmanā .. 2 ..
16.239.d:
पुरा सत्राजिता राज्ञा द्वारवत्यां गतेन तु ..
आराधितो भास्करोऽभूद्यादवेन महात्मना .. 2 ..
16.239.m: Formerly, by King Satrājit who had gone to Dvāravatī, / the high-souled Yādava, the Sun was worshipped.

16.239.s:
mahāvratamupāsthāya nighnaputreṇa dhīmatā ..
tasya tuṣṭastadā bhānuḥ syamantakamaṇiṃ dadau ..3..
16.239.d:
महाव्रतमुपास्थाय निघ्नपुत्रेण धीमता ..
तस्य तुष्टस्तदा भानुः स्यमन्तकमणिं ददौ ..3..
16.239.m: Having undertaken a great observance, by the wise son of Nighna, / the Sun, being pleased with him, gave him the Syamantaka jewel.

16.239.s:
sa maṇiḥ savate nityaṃ bhārānaṣṭau dinedine .. (savate- sūte)
suvarṇasya suśuddhasya bhaktyā vratatapoyutaḥ .. 4 ..
16.239.d:
स मणिः सवते नित्यं भारानष्टौ दिनेदिने .. (सवते- सूते)
सुवर्णस्य सुशुद्धस्य भक्त्या व्रततपोयुतः .. 4 ..
16.239.m: Endowed with devotion, vows, and austerity, that jewel yields every day / eight bhāras of pure gold constantly.

16.239.s:
bhūyo'pi bhānunā prokto varaṃ brūhi varānane ..
sa cāha devadeveśaṃ bhāskaraṃ vāritaskaram .. 5 ..
16.239.d:
भूयोऽपि भानुना प्रोक्तो वरं ब्रूहि वरानने ..
स चाह देवदेवेशं भास्करं वारितस्करम् .. 5 ..
16.239.m: Again addressed by the Sun, 'Choose a boon, O fair-faced one,' / he spoke to the lord of the gods of gods, the Sun who wards off thieves:

16.239.s:
yadi tuṣṭo'si me deva varadānaṃ karoṣi ca ..
atraiva cāśrame puṇye nityaṃ saṃnihito bhava .. 6 ..
16.239.d:
यदि तुष्टोऽसि मे देव वरदानं करोषि च ..
अत्रैव चाश्रमे पुण्ये नित्यं संनिहितो भव .. 6 ..
16.239.m: 'If you are pleased with me, O god, and grant a boon, / be present perpetually right here in this sacred hermitage.'

16.239.s:
evaṃ bhaviṣyatītyuktvā sūryaḥ satrājitaṃ nṛpam ..
abhinaṃdya varaṃ tasya tatraivādarśanaṃ gataḥ .. 7 ..
16.239.d:
एवं भविष्यतीत्युक्त्वा सूर्यः सत्राजितं नृपम् ..
अभिनंद्य वरं तस्य तत्रैवादर्शनं गतः .. 7 ..
16.239.m: Having said, 'So it shall be,' the Sun, / applauding the boon of King Satrājit, disappeared right there.

16.239.s:
tenāpi nighnaputreṇa devadevasya bhāsvataḥ ..
sthāpitā pratimā śubhrā tatraiva varavarṇini .. 8 ..
16.239.d:
तेनापि निघ्नपुत्रेण देवदेवस्य भास्वतः ..
स्थापिता प्रतिमा शुभ्रा तत्रैव वरवर्णिनि .. 8 ..
16.239.m: A radiant image of the god of gods, the Sun, / was also installed right there by that son of Nighna, O lady of fair complexion.

16.239.s:
śaṃkhaduṃdubhinirghoṣairbrahmaghoṣaiścapuṣkalaiḥ ..
tatastunāgarānsarvānsamāhūya dvijottamān ..
abravītpraṇato bhūtvā dattvā vṛttimanuttamām ..9..
16.239.d:
शंखदुंदुभिनिर्घोषैर्ब्रह्मघोषैश्चपुष्कलैः ..
ततस्तुनागरान्सर्वान्समाहूय द्विजोत्तमान् ..
अब्रवीत्प्रणतो भूत्वा दत्त्वा वृत्तिमनुत्तमाम् ..9..
16.239.m: Amid the sounds of conches and kettledrums and abundant chants of the Veda, / then having summoned all the Nāgara [brahmins], the best among twice-born,

16.239.s:
yuṣmatpādaprasādena sūryasyānugraheṇa vai ..
sādhayitvā tapaścograṃ sthāpitā pratimā mayā ..7.1.239.10..
16.239.d:
युष्मत्पादप्रसादेन सूर्यस्यानुग्रहेण वै ..
साधयित्वा तपश्चोग्रं स्थापिता प्रतिमा मया ..7.1.239.10..
16.239.m: bowing down and having granted an unequalled means of livelihood, he said: / 'By the grace of your feet and indeed by the favor of the Sun,

16.239.s:
iṃdralokādihānītā jitvā śakraṃ surāriṇā..
daśānanasya putreṇa laṃkāyāṃ sthāpitā purā ..11..
16.239.d:
इंद्रलोकादिहानीता जित्वा शक्रं सुरारिणा..
दशाननस्य पुत्रेण लंकायां स्थापिता पुरा ..11..
16.239.m: having accomplished fierce austerity, this image has been installed by me. / Brought from Indra's realm to here, having conquered Śakra, by the enemy of the gods,

16.239.s:
taṃ nihatya tu rāmeṇa lakṣmaṇānugatena vai..
ayodhyāyāṃ samānītā saumitrijayalakṣikā..12..
16.239.d:
तं निहत्य तु रामेण लक्ष्मणानुगतेन वै..
अयोध्यायां समानीता सौमित्रिजयलक्षिका..12..
16.239.m: the son of the Ten-necked [Rāvaṇa], it was installed formerly in Laṅkā. / But having slain him, by Rāma, accompanied by Lakṣmaṇa,

16.239.s:
mitrāvaruṇaputrāya vasiṣṭhāya samarpitā..
tenāpi mama tuṣṭena dvārakāyāṃ niveditā..13..
16.239.d:
मित्रावरुणपुत्राय वसिष्ठाय समर्पिता..
तेनापि मम तुष्टेन द्वारकायां निवेदिता..13..
16.239.m: it was brought to Ayodhyā, embodying the victory of the son of Sumitrā. / It was offered to Vasiṣṭha, the son of Mitra and Varuṇa;

16.239.s:
mayāpi sthāpitā cātra jñātvā kṣetramanuttamam ..
kimatra bahunoktena bhavadbhiḥ sarvathaiva hi ..14..
16.239.d:
मयापि स्थापिता चात्र ज्ञात्वा क्षेत्रमनुत्तमम् ..
किमत्र बहुनोक्तेन भवद्भिः सर्वथैव हि ..14..
16.239.m: and by him, being pleased, it was given to me in Dvārakā. / And it was installed here by me, knowing this to be an unequalled sacred field.

16.239.s:
paripālyā prayatnena yāvaccaṃdrārkatārakam..
tasmādyuṣmākamādiṣṭā pratimeyaṃ mayā śubhā .. 15 ..
16.239.d:
परिपाल्या प्रयत्नेन यावच्चंद्रार्कतारकम्..
तस्माद्युष्माकमादिष्टा प्रतिमेयं मया शुभा .. 15 ..
16.239.m: What is the use of speaking much here? By you it must be protected / with care in every way as long as the moon, sun, and stars endure. / Therefore, this auspicious image has been entrusted to you by me,

16.239.s:
nāgarāṇāṃ tu viprāṇāṃ someśapuravāsinām ..
tasmānnāma mayā dattaṃ nāgarādityameva hi .. 16 ..
16.239.d:
नागराणां तु विप्राणां सोमेशपुरवासिनाम् ..
तस्मान्नाम मया दत्तं नागरादित्यमेव हि .. 16 ..
16.239.m: to the Nāgara brahmins residing in the city of Someśa. / Therefore, the name Nāgarāditya indeed was given by me.'

16.239.s:
.. brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ.. ..
sarvameva kariṣyāmo devasya paripālanam ..
yāvanmahī ca caṃdrārkau yāvattiṣṭhati sāgaraḥ ..
tāvatte hyakṣayā kīrtiḥ sthāne cāsminbhaviṣyati..17..
16.239.d:
.. ब्राह्मणा ऊचुः.. ..
सर्वमेव करिष्यामो देवस्य परिपालनम् ..
यावन्मही च चंद्रार्कौ यावत्तिष्ठति सागरः ..
तावत्ते ह्यक्षया कीर्तिः स्थाने चास्मिन्भविष्यति..17..
16.239.m:
The brahmins said:
"We will completely protect the god. / As long as the earth, moon, and sun endure, as long as the ocean remains, / so long will your fame be imperishable in this place."

16.239.s:
evamuktvā tu te sarve nāgarā dvijapuṃgavāḥ ..
rājāpi tuṣṭaḥ prayayau tadā dvāravatīṃ purīm ..18 ..
16.239.d:
एवमुक्त्वा तु ते सर्वे नागरा द्विजपुंगवाः ..
राजापि तुष्टः प्रययौ तदा द्वारवतीं पुरीम् ..18 ..
16.239.m: Having spoken thus, all those eminent Nāgara brahmins [agreed]; / the king also, pleased, then departed for the city of Dvāravatī.

16.239.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi tasmindṛṣṭe tu yatphalam ..
gośatasya prayāgeṣu samyagdattasya yatphalam ..
tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti nāgarārkasya darśanāt.. 19..
16.239.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
शृणु देवि प्रवक्ष्यामि तस्मिन्दृष्टे तु यत्फलम् ..
गोशतस्य प्रयागेषु सम्यग्दत्तस्य यत्फलम् ..
तत्फलं समवाप्नोति नागरार्कस्य दर्शनात्.. 19..
16.239.m:
Īśvara said:
Hear, O goddess, I shall explain the fruit obtained when it is seen: / The fruit of a hundred cows properly gifted at Prayāga, / that fruit one obtains from the darśana of Nāgarārka.

16.239.s:
dāridryaduḥkhaśokārtteḥ konyosti haraṇakṣamaḥ..
prabhāse pāvane kṣetre muktvā nāgarabhāskaram .. 7.1.239.20 ..
16.239.d:
दारिद्र्यदुःखशोकार्त्तेः कोन्योस्ति हरणक्षमः..
प्रभासे पावने क्षेत्रे मुक्त्वा नागरभास्करम् .. 7.1.239.20 ..
16.239.m: Who else is capable of removing the afflictions of poverty, grief, and sorrow / in the holy sacred field of Prabhāsa, except for Nāgarabhāskara?

16.239.s:
baṃdhakuṣṭhādikaṃ duḥkhaṃ ye bhajaṃtyalpabuddhayaḥ ..
tatra te naiva jānaṃti vaidyaṃ nāgarabhāskaram .. 21 ..
16.239.d:
बंधकुष्ठादिकं दुःखं ये भजंत्यल्पबुद्धयः ..
तत्र ते नैव जानंति वैद्यं नागरभास्करम् .. 21 ..
16.239.m: Those dull-witted people who suffer from afflictions such as captivity and leprosy, / do not know of the physician Nāgarabhāskara there.

16.239.s:
snātvā hiraṇyātoyena yastaṃ pūjayate naraḥ ..
kalpakoṭisahasrāṇi sūryaloke mahīyate ..22..
16.239.d:
स्नात्वा हिरण्यातोयेन यस्तं पूजयते नरः ..
कल्पकोटिसहस्राणि सूर्यलोके महीयते ..22..
16.239.m: The man who, having bathed in the water of Hiraṇyā, worships him, / is glorified in the world of Sūrya for thousands of crores of kalpas.

16.239.s:
śuklapakṣe tu saptamyāṃ yadā saṃkramate raviḥ ..
mahājayā tadā khyātā saptamī bhāskarapriyā .. 23 ..
16.239.d:
शुक्लपक्षे तु सप्तम्यां यदा संक्रमते रविः ..
महाजया तदा ख्याता सप्तमी भास्करप्रिया .. 23 ..
16.239.m: When the sun enters [a zodiacal sign] on the seventh day of the bright fortnight, / that seventh day, beloved of the sun, is renowned as Mahājayā.

16.239.s:
snānaṃ dānaṃ japo homaḥ pitṛdevābhipūjanam ..
sarvaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ proktaṃ bhāskarasyavaco yathā .. 24 ..
16.239.d:
स्नानं दानं जपो होमः पितृदेवाभिपूजनम् ..
सर्वं कोटिगुणं प्रोक्तं भास्करस्यवचो यथा .. 24 ..
16.239.m: Bathing, giving gifts, recitation, fire offering, and worship of ancestors and gods— / all this is declared ten million times magnified, according to the word of the sun.

16.239.s:
ekaṃ yo bhojayettatra brāhmaṇaṃ sūryasaṃnidhau ..
koṭibhojyaṃ kṛtaṃ tena ityāha bhagavānhariḥ .. 25 ..
16.239.d:
एकं यो भोजयेत्तत्र ब्राह्मणं सूर्यसंनिधौ ..
कोटिभोज्यं कृतं तेन इत्याह भगवान्हरिः .. 25 ..
16.239.m: He who feeds a single brahmin there in the presence of Sūrya / has fed ten million, so said the blessed Hari.

16.239.s:
etanmayā te kathitaṃ purā noktaṃ varānane ..
yaḥ śṛṇoti naro bhaktyā sa gacchedbhāskaraṃ padam..26..
16.239.d:
एतन्मया ते कथितं पुरा नोक्तं वरानने ..
यः शृणोति नरो भक्त्या स गच्छेद्भास्करं पदम्..26..
16.239.m: This which has been related to you by me was not spoken before, O fair-faced one. / The man who hears it with devotion goes to the abode of the sun.

16.239.s:
sūryasya devi nāmāni rahasyāni śṛṇuśva me..
alaṃ nāmasahasreṇa paṭhasvainaṃ śubhaṃ stavam..27..
16.239.d:
सूर्यस्य देवि नामानि रहस्यानि शृणुश्व मे..
अलं नामसहस्रेण पठस्वैनं शुभं स्तवम्..27..
16.239.m: Hear from me, O goddess, the secret names of Sūrya. / Enough with a thousand names! Recite this auspicious hymn:

16.239.s:
vikarttano vivasvāṃśca mārttaṃḍo bhāskaro raviḥ ..
lokaprakāśakaḥ śrīmām̐llokacakṣurgraheśvaraḥ .. 28 ..
16.239.d:
विकर्त्तनो विवस्वांश्च मार्त्तंडो भास्करो रविः ..
लोकप्रकाशकः श्रीमाम्̐ल्लोकचक्षुर्ग्रहेश्वरः .. 28 ..
16.239.m: Vikartana, Vivasvat, Mārtaṇḍa, Bhāskara, Ravi, / Illuminator of the World, Illustrious, Eye of the World, Lord of the Planets,

16.239.s:
lokasākṣī trilokeśaḥ karttā harttā tamisrahā ..
tapanastāpanaścaiva śuciḥ saptāśvavāhanaḥ .. 29 ..
16.239.d:
लोकसाक्षी त्रिलोकेशः कर्त्ता हर्त्ता तमिस्रहा ..
तपनस्तापनश्चैव शुचिः सप्ताश्ववाहनः .. 29 ..
16.239.m: Witness of the World, Lord of the Three Worlds, Creator, Destroyer, Dispeller of Darkness, / Burning One, Scorcher, Pure One, Having Seven Horses as His Mount,

16.239.s:
gabhastihasto brahmā ca sarvadevanamaskṛtaḥ ..
ekaviṃśaka ityeṣa nāgarārkastavaḥ smṛtaḥ .. 7.1.239.30 ..
16.239.d:
गभस्तिहस्तो ब्रह्मा च सर्वदेवनमस्कृतः ..
एकविंशक इत्येष नागरार्कस्तवः स्मृतः .. 7.1.239.30 ..
16.239.m: Ray-Handed One, Brahmā, and He Who Is Revered by All Gods— / this is known as the twenty-one-named hymn to Nāgarārka.

16.239.s: stavarāja iti khyātaḥ śarīrārogyavṛddhidaḥ .. 31 ..
16.239.d: स्तवराज इति ख्यातः शरीरारोग्यवृद्धिदः .. 31 ..
16.239.m: Renowned as the king of hymns, it grants an increase in bodily health.

16.239.s:
ya etena mahādevi dve saṃdhye'stamanodaye ..
nāgarārkaṃ tu saṃstauti sa labhedvāṃchitaṃ phalam.. 32 ..
16.239.d:
य एतेन महादेवि द्वे संध्येऽस्तमनोदये ..
नागरार्कं तु संस्तौति स लभेद्वांछितं फलम्.. 32 ..
16.239.m: O great goddess, whoever praises Nāgarārka with this [hymn] / at both twilights, sunset and sunrise, obtains his desired fruit.

16.239.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ sahitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye nāgarārkamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikonacatvāriṃśaduttaradviśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ .. 239 ..
16.239.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां सहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये नागरार्कमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामैकोनचत्वारिंशदुत्तरद्विशततमो ऽध्यायः .. 239 ..
16.239.m: Thus ends the two hundred and thirty-ninth chapter, entitled 'The Description of the Māhātmya of Nāgarārka,' in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh [section], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skandapurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

16.240.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi balabhadraṃ sureśvaram ..
subhadrāṃ ca tathā kṛṣṇaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam .. 1 ..
16.240.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि बलभद्रं सुरेश्वरम् ..
सुभद्रां च तथा कृष्णं सर्वपातकनाशनम् .. 1 ..
16.240.m:
Īśvara said:
Then, O great goddess, one should go to Balabhadra, the lord of the gods, / and to Subhadrā and Kṛṣṇa, the destroyer of all sins.

16.240.s:
pūrva kalpe mahādevi dehamatrātyajaddhariḥ ..
asminkalpepi ca punargātrotsargamiti smṛtam .. 2 ..
16.240.d:
पूर्व कल्पे महादेवि देहमत्रात्यजद्धरिः ..
अस्मिन्कल्पेपि च पुनर्गात्रोत्सर्गमिति स्मृतम् .. 2 ..
16.240.m: In a previous kalpa, O great goddess, Hari abandoned his body here. / In this kalpa also, it is remembered as Gātrotsarga.

16.240.s:
tatra ye pūjayiṣyaṃti nāgarādityasaṃnidhau ..
balabhadraṃ subhadrāṃ ca kṛṣṇaṃ te svargagāminaḥ ..3..
16.240.d:
तत्र ये पूजयिष्यंति नागरादित्यसंनिधौ ..
बलभद्रं सुभद्रां च कृष्णं ते स्वर्गगामिनः ..3..
16.240.m: Those who worship Balabhadra, Subhadrā, and Kṛṣṇa there / near Nāgarāditya, go to heaven.

16.240.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ sahitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye balabhadra subhadrā kṛṣṇa māhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma catvāriṃśaduttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 240 ..
16.240.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां सहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये बलभद्र सुभद्रा कृष्ण माहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम चत्वारिंशदुत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 240 ..
16.240.m: Thus ends the two hundred and fortieth chapter, entitled 'The Description of the Māhātmya of Balabhadra, Subhadrā, and Kṛṣṇa,' in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh [section], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skandapurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

16.241.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tatraiva saṃsthitaṃ paśyedbalabhadrakalevaram ..
śeṣarūpeṇa yatrāsau prātyajatsvakalevaram.. 1 ..
16.241.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
तत्रैव संस्थितं पश्येद्बलभद्रकलेवरम् ..
शेषरूपेण यत्रासौ प्रात्यजत्स्वकलेवरम्.. 1 ..
16.241.m:
Īśvara said:
There itself one should behold the body of Balabhadra, / where, in the form of Śeṣa, he cast off his own body.

16.241.s:
gatastraisaṃgame tīrthe tatra pātālavartmanā ..
asminmitravane devi gavyūtidvayavistṛte .. 2 ..
16.241.d:
गतस्त्रैसंगमे तीर्थे तत्र पातालवर्त्मना ..
अस्मिन्मित्रवने देवि गव्यूतिद्वयविस्तृते .. 2 ..
16.241.m: O goddess, he went to the Traisaṃgama sacred ford there by the path to Pātāla / in this Mitravana extending for two gavyūtis.

16.241.s:
kalevaraṃ sthitaṃ devi liṃgākāraṃ mahāprabham ..
revatyā sahitaṃ tatra śeṣanāmeti viśrutam ..3..
16.241.d:
कलेवरं स्थितं देवि लिंगाकारं महाप्रभम् ..
रेवत्या सहितं तत्र शेषनामेति विश्रुतम् ..3..
16.241.m: There, O goddess, his body stands, shaped like a liṅga, endowed with great splendor, / accompanied by Revatī, well-known under the name of Śeṣa.

16.241.s:
yatra siddhaḥ purā devi jarānāmā tu kaulikaḥ ..
viṣṇuhaṃtā bhallatīrthe so'sminsthāne layaṃ gataḥ .. 4 ..
16.241.d:
यत्र सिद्धः पुरा देवि जरानामा तु कौलिकः ..
विष्णुहंता भल्लतीर्थे सोऽस्मिन्स्थाने लयं गतः .. 4 ..
16.241.m: Where of old, O goddess, the hunter named Jarā achieved perfection— / the slayer of Viṣṇu at Bhallatīrtha—he dissolved into this place.

16.241.s:
tatprabhṛtyeva sakale śeṣa ityabhiviśrutaḥ ..
caitre śuklatrayodaśyāṃ yastaṃ pūjayate naraḥ ..
sa putrapautrapaśumānvarṣaṃ kṣemeṇa gacchati ..5..
16.241.d:
तत्प्रभृत्येव सकले शेष इत्यभिविश्रुतः ..
चैत्रे शुक्लत्रयोदश्यां यस्तं पूजयते नरः ..
स पुत्रपौत्रपशुमान्वर्षं क्षेमेण गच्छति ..5..
16.241.m: Ever since then, he has been celebrated as Śeṣa across the whole [world]. / The person who worships him on the thirteenth lunar day of the bright fortnight of Caitra / spends the year in peace, endowed with sons, grandsons, and cattle.

16.241.s:
masūrikādirogebhyaḥ śiśūnāṃ na bhayaṃ bhavet ..
visphoṭakādirogebhyo na bhayaṃ jāyate kvacit ..6..
16.241.d:
मसूरिकादिरोगेभ्यः शिशूनां न भयं भवेत् ..
विस्फोटकादिरोगेभ्यो न भयं जायते क्वचित् ..6..
16.241.m: For children there will be no danger from diseases such as smallpox; / no danger ever arises from eruptive diseases such as boils.

16.241.s:
asminkṣetre mahāsiddhe siddhayajñastu yaḥ smṛtaḥ ..
varṇānāṃ sāṃtarālānāṃ sarveṣāṃ cātivallabhaḥ ..7..
16.241.d:
अस्मिन्क्षेत्रे महासिद्धे सिद्धयज्ञस्तु यः स्मृतः ..
वर्णानां सांतरालानां सर्वेषां चातिवल्लभः ..7..
16.241.m: The sacrifice that is recalled as the Siddhayajña in this great, perfect sacred field / is exceedingly dear to all the castes and the intermediate classes.

16.241.s:
paśupuṣpopahāraiśca balidānaiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ ..
saṃtuṣṭiṃ śīghramāyāti śeṣo'śeṣāghanāśanaḥ .. .. 8 ..
16.241.d:
पशुपुष्पोपहारैश्च बलिदानैः पृथग्विधैः ..
संतुष्टिं शीघ्रमायाति शेषोऽशेषाघनाशनः .. .. 8 ..
16.241.m: Through animal offerings, floral gifts, and various kinds of oblations, / Śeṣa, the destroyer of all sins, quickly attains satisfaction.

16.241.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye śeṣamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikacatvāriṃśa duttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 241 .. ..
16.241.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये शेषमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामैकचत्वारिंश दुत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 241 .. ..
16.241.m: Thus ends the two hundred and forty-first chapter, entitled 'The Description of the Māhātmya of Śeṣa,' in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh [section], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skandapurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

16.242.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi yatra devīkumārikā ..
tasyaiva pūrvadigbhāge sthitā rakṣārthameva hi .. 1 ..
16.242.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि यत्र देवीकुमारिका ..
तस्यैव पूर्वदिग्भागे स्थिता रक्षार्थमेव हि .. 1 ..
16.242.m:
Īśvara said:
Then, O great goddess, one should go to where Goddess Kumārikā is; / she is stationed precisely in the eastern quarter of it for protection.

16.242.s:
purā rathaṃtare kalpe rururnāma mahāsuraḥ ..
utpannaḥ sa mahākāyaḥ sarvalokabhayāvahaḥ .. 2 ..
16.242.d:
पुरा रथंतरे कल्पे रुरुर्नाम महासुरः ..
उत्पन्नः स महाकायः सर्वलोकभयावहः .. 2 ..
16.242.m: In ancient times, in the Rathaṃtara kalpa, a great asura named Ruru / was born; he had a huge body and brought fear to all the worlds.

16.242.s:
tena devāḥ sagandharvāstrāsitāstridaśā layāt ..
tasya bhītyā tataḥ sarve brahmalokamadhisthitāḥ .. 3 ..
16.242.d:
तेन देवाः सगन्धर्वास्त्रासितास्त्रिदशा लयात् ..
तस्य भीत्या ततः सर्वे ब्रह्मलोकमधिस्थिताः .. 3 ..
16.242.m: By him the gods, together with the gandharvas, were terrified and driven from the realm of the thirty [gods]; / out of fear of him, all then took refuge in the world of Brahmā.

16.242.s:
tathā bhūmitale viprānyajvano'tha tapasvinaḥ ..
nijaghāna sa duṣṭātmā ye cānye dharmacāriṇaḥ .. 4 ..
16.242.d:
तथा भूमितले विप्रान्यज्वनोऽथ तपस्विनः ..
निजघान स दुष्टात्मा ये चान्ये धर्मचारिणः .. 4 ..
16.242.m: Likewise on the earth's surface that evil-minded one killed brahmins, / sacrificers, ascetics, and others who practiced righteousness.

16.242.s:
niḥsvādhyāyavaṣaṭkāraṃ tadā''sīddharaṇītalam..
naṣṭayajñotsavaṃ sarvaṃ rurorbhayanipīḍitam.. 5 ..
16.242.d:
निःस्वाध्यायवषट्कारं तदा'ऽसीद्धरणीतलम्..
नष्टयज्ञोत्सवं सर्वं रुरोर्भयनिपीडितम्.. 5 ..
16.242.m: The surface of the earth was then devoid of Vedic study and the sacrificial exclamation vaṣaṭ, / its sacrifices and festivals entirely ruined, oppressed by the fear of Ruru.

16.242.s:
tataḥ pravyathitā devāstathā sarve maharṣayaḥ ..
sametyāmaṃtrayanmaṃtraṃ vadhārthaṃ tasya durmateḥ .. 6 ..
16.242.d:
ततः प्रव्यथिता देवास्तथा सर्वे महर्षयः ..
समेत्यामंत्रयन्मंत्रं वधार्थं तस्य दुर्मतेः .. 6 ..
16.242.m: Then the deeply distressed gods and all the great seers, / having assembled, held counsel for the destruction of that evil-minded one.

16.242.s:
tataḥ kāyodbhavaḥ svedaḥ sarveṣāṃ samajāyata ..
teṣāṃ ciṃtayatāṃ devi nirodhājjagṛhuśca tam .. ..7..
16.242.d:
ततः कायोद्भवः स्वेदः सर्वेषां समजायत ..
तेषां चिंतयतां देवि निरोधाज्जगृहुश्च तम् .. ..7..
16.242.m: Then, O goddess, sweat was produced from the bodies of them all; / as they deliberated, they held it by restraint.

16.242.s:
tatra kanyā samutpannā divyā kamalalocanā ..
vyāpayaṃtī diśaḥ sarvāḥ sarveṣāṃ purataḥ sthitā ..8..
16.242.d:
तत्र कन्या समुत्पन्ना दिव्या कमललोचना ..
व्यापयंती दिशः सर्वाः सर्वेषां पुरतः स्थिता ..8..
16.242.m: A divine, lotus-eyed maiden was born there, / pervading all quarters, and stood before them all.

16.242.s:
sarvāndevāṃstataḥ prāha kimarthaṃ nirmitāsmya ham ..
tadvaḥ kāryaṃ kariṣyāmi śrutvā tasyāstadā giram.. 9 ..
16.242.d:
सर्वान्देवांस्ततः प्राह किमर्थं निर्मितास्म्य हम् ..
तद्वः कार्यं करिष्यामि श्रुत्वा तस्यास्तदा गिरम्.. 9 ..
16.242.m: She then said to all the gods: "For what purpose have I been created? / I shall perform that work for you." Hearing her words then,

16.242.s:
ācakhyuḥ saṃkaṭaṃ tasyāste devā ruruceṣṭitam ..
śrutvā jahāsa sā devī devānāṃ kārya siddhaye .. 7.1.242.10 ..
16.242.d:
आचख्युः संकटं तस्यास्ते देवा रुरुचेष्टितम् ..
श्रुत्वा जहास सा देवी देवानां कार्य सिद्धये .. 7.1.242.10 ..
16.242.m: those gods reported their distress and the conduct of Ruru to her. / Hearing it, that goddess laughed, for the sake of accomplishing the task of the gods.

16.242.s:
tasyā hasaṃtyā niścerurvarāṃgāḥ kanyakāḥ punaḥ ..
pāśāṃkuśadharāḥ sarvāḥ pīnaśroṇipayodharāḥ .. 11 ..
16.242.d:
तस्या हसंत्या निश्चेरुर्वरांगाः कन्यकाः पुनः ..
पाशांकुशधराः सर्वाः पीनश्रोणिपयोधराः .. 11 ..
16.242.m: As she laughed, there emerged from her fair-limbed maiden-warriors, / all holding nooses and goads, with plump hips and breasts,

16.242.s:
phetkārārāvamātreṇa trāsa yaṃtyaścarācaram ..
anvagātsā rururyatra tābhiḥ sārddhaṃ yaśasvinī .. 12 ..
16.242.d:
फेत्कारारावमात्रेण त्रास यंत्यश्चराचरम् ..
अन्वगात्सा रुरुर्यत्र ताभिः सार्द्धं यशस्विनी .. 12 ..
16.242.m: terrifying the moving and unmoving creation with merely the sound of their roars. / Accompanied by them, that glorious goddess pursued Ruru to where he was.

16.242.s:
athābhūttumulaṃ tāsāṃ yuddhaṃ ghoraṃ tu taiḥ saha ..
śastrāstrairvividhairghoraiḥ śatrupakṣa kṣayaṃkaraiḥ .. 13 ..
16.242.d:
अथाभूत्तुमुलं तासां युद्धं घोरं तु तैः सह ..
शस्त्रास्त्रैर्विविधैर्घोरैः शत्रुपक्ष क्षयंकरैः .. 13 ..
16.242.m: Then a tumultuous and fierce battle broke out between them and his host, / with varied, terrible missiles and weapons that brought destruction to the enemy's side.

16.242.s:
tābhistadanugāḥ sarve prahārairjarjarīkṛtāḥ..
parāṅmukhāḥ kṣaṇenaiva jātāḥ kecinnipātitāḥ .. 14 ..
16.242.d:
ताभिस्तदनुगाः सर्वे प्रहारैर्जर्जरीकृताः..
पराङ्मुखाः क्षणेनैव जाताः केचिन्निपातिताः .. 14 ..
16.242.m: Battered by their blows, all of his followers / turned their backs in an instant, and some were struck down.

16.242.s:
tato hataṃ balaṃ dṛṣṭvā rururmāyāmathā'sṛjat ..
tāmasīṃnāma deveśi tayāmuhyata naiva sā .. 15 ..
16.242.d:
ततो हतं बलं दृष्ट्वा रुरुर्मायामथाऽसृजत् ..
तामसींनाम देवेशि तयामुह्यत नैव सा .. 15 ..
16.242.m: Then, seeing his army slain, Ruru created an illusion / named Tāmasī ('Darkness'), O ruler of gods, but she was not bewildered by it at all.

16.242.s:
tamobhūte tatastatra devī daityaṃ tadā rurum ..
śaktyā bibheda hṛdaye tato mūrchāṃ jagāma ha .. 16 ..
16.242.d:
तमोभूते ततस्तत्र देवी दैत्यं तदा रुरुम् ..
शक्त्या बिभेद हृदये ततो मूर्छां जगाम ह .. 16 ..
16.242.m: When it had become dark, the goddess then / pierced the Daitya Ruru in the chest with a spear, and he fell into a swoon.

16.242.s:
muhūrttāllabdhasaṃjño'tha jñātvā tasyāḥ parākramam ..
palāyanakṛtotsāhaḥ samudrābhimukho yayau .. 17 ..
16.242.d:
मुहूर्त्ताल्लब्धसंज्ञोऽथ ज्ञात्वा तस्याः पराक्रमम् ..
पलायनकृतोत्साहः समुद्राभिमुखो ययौ .. 17 ..
16.242.m: Regaining consciousness after a moment and realizing her prowess, / he resolved to flee and ran toward the ocean.

16.242.s:
sā'pi devī jagāmātha pṛṣṭhato'sya durātmanaḥ ..
stūyamānā suragaṇaiḥ kiṃnaraiḥ samahoragaiḥ .. 18 ..
16.242.d:
साऽपि देवी जगामाथ पृष्ठतोऽस्य दुरात्मनः ..
स्तूयमाना सुरगणैः किंनरैः समहोरगैः .. 18 ..
16.242.m: The goddess also went after that evil-minded one, / being praised by the hosts of gods, kiṃnaras, and great serpents.

16.242.s:
tataḥ praviśya jaladhiṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā dānavaṃ ruṣā ..
khaṅgāgreṇa śiraśchittvā carmamuṇḍadharā tataḥ .. 19 ..
16.242.d:
ततः प्रविश्य जलधिं तं दृष्ट्वा दानवं रुषा ..
खङ्गाग्रेण शिरश्छित्त्वा चर्ममुण्डधरा ततः .. 19 ..
16.242.m: Then, entering the ocean and seeing that Dānava, in fury / she cut off his head with the tip of her sword, and bearing his skin and head, she then

16.242.s:
niścakrāma punastasmātprabhāsaṃ kṣetramāgatā ..
kanyā sainyena saṃyuktā bahurūpeṇa bhāsvatā .. 7.1.242.20 ..
16.242.d:
निश्चक्राम पुनस्तस्मात्प्रभासं क्षेत्रमागता ..
कन्या सैन्येन संयुक्ता बहुरूपेण भास्वता .. 7.1.242.20 ..
16.242.m: came forth again from there and returned to the sacred field of Prabhāsa, / accompanied by the radiant, multiform army of maidens.

16.242.s:
devaiḥ suvismitairdṛṣṭā carmamuṇḍadharā varā ..
tato devāḥ stutiṃ cakruḥ kṛtāṃjalipuṭāḥ sthitāḥ .. 21 ..
16.242.d:
देवैः सुविस्मितैर्दृष्टा चर्ममुण्डधरा वरा ..
ततो देवाः स्तुतिं चक्रुः कृतांजलिपुटाः स्थिताः .. 21 ..
16.242.m: Beholding the supreme goddess holding the skin and severed head, the gods were filled with wonder; / standing with joined palms, the gods then offered praise:

16.242.s:
.. devā ūcuḥ .. ..
jaya tvaṃ devi cāmuṃḍe jaya bhūtāpahāriṇi ..
jaya sarvagate devi kālarātri namo'stu te .. 22 ..
16.242.d:
.. देवा ऊचुः .. ..
जय त्वं देवि चामुंडे जय भूतापहारिणि ..
जय सर्वगते देवि कालरात्रि नमोऽस्तु ते .. 22 ..
16.242.m:
The gods said:
“Victory to you, O goddess Cāmuṇḍā! Victory to you who destroy evil spirits! / Victory to you who pervade all things, O goddess Kālarātri! Salutations to you!

16.242.s:
bhīmarūpe śive vidye mahāmāye mahodaye ..
mahābhāge jaye jṛmbhe bhīmākṣi bhīmadarśane .. 23 ..
16.242.d:
भीमरूपे शिवे विद्ये महामाये महोदये ..
महाभागे जये जृम्भे भीमाक्षि भीमदर्शने .. 23 ..
16.242.m: O you of terrible form, auspicious one, sacred lore, great illusion, supreme prosperity! / O highly fortunate one, victorious one, gaping-mouthed one, terrible-eyed one, dreadful to behold!

16.242.s:
mahāmāye vicitrāṃgi geyanṛtyapriye śubhe ..
vikarāli mahākāli kālike kālarūpiṇi .. 24 ..
16.242.d:
महामाये विचित्रांगि गेयनृत्यप्रिये शुभे ..
विकरालि महाकालि कालिके कालरूपिणि .. 24 ..
16.242.m: O great illusion, variegated-limbed one, lover of song and dance, auspicious one! / O dreadfully fierce one, Mahākālī, Kālikā, embodiment of time and death!

16.242.s:
prāsahaste daṇḍahaste bhīmahaste bhayānane ..
cāmuṇḍe jvalamānāsye tīkṣṇadaṃṣṭre mahābale ..
śavayānasthite devi pretasaṃghaniṣevite .. 25 ..
16.242.d:
प्रासहस्ते दण्डहस्ते भीमहस्ते भयानने ..
चामुण्डे ज्वलमानास्ये तीक्ष्णदंष्ट्रे महाबले ..
शवयानस्थिते देवि प्रेतसंघनिषेविते .. 25 ..
16.242.m: O you with a dart in hand, a staff in hand, formidable-handed one, terrifying-faced one! / O Cāmuṇḍā, with a flaming mouth, sharp fangs, and great strength! / O goddess mounted upon a corpse, served by hosts of spirits!

16.242.s:
evaṃ stutā tadā devī sarvaiḥ śakrapurogamaiḥ ..
prahṛṣṭavadanā bhūtvā vākyametaduvāca ha .. 26 ..
16.242.d:
एवं स्तुता तदा देवी सर्वैः शक्रपुरोगमैः ..
प्रहृष्टवदना भूत्वा वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह .. 26 ..
16.242.m: Thus praised then by all [the gods] led by Indra, / the goddess, with a joyful face, spoke these words:

16.242.s:
varaṃ vṛṇudhvaṃ bhadraṃ vo nityaṃ yanmanasi sthitam ..
ahaṃ dāsyāmi tatsarvaṃ yadyapi syātsudurllabham .. 27 ..
16.242.d:
वरं वृणुध्वं भद्रं वो नित्यं यन्मनसि स्थितम् ..
अहं दास्यामि तत्सर्वं यद्यपि स्यात्सुदुर्ल्लभम् .. 27 ..
16.242.m: “Choose a boon, may good befall you, whatever is always in your mind. / I shall grant it all, even if it be extremely difficult to attain.”

16.242.s:
.. devā ūcuḥ .. ..
kṛtakṛtyāstvayā bhadre dānavasya niṣūdanāt .. 28 ..
16.242.d:
.. देवा ऊचुः .. ..
कृतकृत्यास्त्वया भद्रे दानवस्य निषूदनात् .. 28 ..
16.242.m:
The gods said:
“We have accomplished our purpose through you, O auspicious one, because of the slaying of the Dānava.

16.242.s:
stotreṇānena yo devi tvāṃ vai stauti varānane ..
tasya tvaṃ varadā devi bhava sarvagatā satī .. 29 ..
16.242.d:
स्तोत्रेणानेन यो देवि त्वां वै स्तौति वरानने ..
तस्य त्वं वरदा देवि भव सर्वगता सती .. 29 ..
16.242.m: Whoever praises you with this hymn of praise, O fair-faced goddess, / be a bestower of boons to him, O omnipresent, virtuous goddess!

16.242.s:
yaścedaṃ śṛṇuyādbhaktyā tava devi samudbhavam ..
sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ sa prāpnotu parāṃ gatim .. 7.1.242.30 ..
16.242.d:
यश्चेदं शृणुयाद्भक्त्या तव देवि समुद्भवम् ..
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तः स प्राप्नोतु परां गतिम् .. 7.1.242.30 ..
16.242.m: And whoever hears of your manifestation with devotion, O goddess, / freed from all sins, may he attain the supreme goal.

16.242.s: asminkṣetre tvayā devi sthitiḥ kāryā sadā śubhe .. 31 ..
16.242.d: अस्मिन्क्षेत्रे त्वया देवि स्थितिः कार्या सदा शुभे .. 31 ..
16.242.m: You should always reside in this sacred field, O auspicious goddess.

16.242.s:
atra tvāṃ pūjayedyastu śuklapakṣe samāhitaḥ ..
navamyāmāśvine māsi tasya kāryaṃ sadā śubham.. 32 .. ..
16.242.d:
अत्र त्वां पूजयेद्यस्तु शुक्लपक्षे समाहितः ..
नवम्यामाश्विने मासि तस्य कार्यं सदा शुभम्.. 32 .. ..
16.242.m: Whoever worships you here with collected mind on the ninth day of the bright fortnight / in the month of Āśvina—may his undertaking always be auspicious!”

16.242.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
evamuktā mahādevī tatraiva niratā'bhavat ..
devāstriviṣṭapaṃ jagmuḥ prahṛṣṭā hataśatravaḥ ..33..
16.242.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
एवमुक्ता महादेवी तत्रैव निरताऽभवत् ..
देवास्त्रिविष्टपं जग्मुः प्रहृष्टा हतशत्रवः ..33..
16.242.m:
Īśvara said:
Thus addressed, the great goddess remained devotedly right there. / The gods went to heaven, rejoiced, with their enemies destroyed.

16.242.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ sahitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye kumārīmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvicatvāriṃśaduttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..242.. ..
16.242.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीति साहस्र्यां सहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये कुमारीमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम द्विचत्वारिंशदुत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः ..242.. ..
16.242.m: Thus ends the two hundred and forty-second chapter, titled ‘Description of the Māhātmya of Kumārī,’ in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh section, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.243.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi kṣetrapālaṃ mahāprabham ..
īśāne saṃsthitaṃ devaṃ maṃtramālāvibhūṣitam .. 1 ..
16.243.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि क्षेत्रपालं महाप्रभम् ..
ईशाने संस्थितं देवं मंत्रमालाविभूषितम् .. 1 ..
16.243.m:
Īśvara said:
Then one should go, O great goddess, to the glorious Kṣetrapāla, / the god residing in the northeast, adorned with a garland of mantras,

16.243.s:
hiraṇyātaṭamāśritya rakṣārthaṃ samupasthitam ..
tatraiva hīrakaṃ kṣetraṃ tasminrakṣāṃ karoti saḥ .. 2 ..
16.243.d:
हिरण्यातटमाश्रित्य रक्षार्थं समुपस्थितम् ..
तत्रैव हीरकं क्षेत्रं तस्मिन्रक्षां करोति सः .. 2 ..
16.243.m: who is situated on the bank of the Hiraṇyā for the sake of protection. / Right there is the Hīraka sacred field; in it he provides protection.

16.243.s:
kṛṣṇapakṣe trayodaśyāṃ tatra taṃ pūjayennaraḥ ..
gaṃdhapuṣpopahāraiśca tathā bali nivedanaiḥ .. 3 ..
16.243.d:
कृष्णपक्षे त्रयोदश्यां तत्र तं पूजयेन्नरः ..
गंधपुष्पोपहारैश्च तथा बलि निवेदनैः .. 3 ..
16.243.m: On the thirteenth day of the dark fortnight, a person should worship him there / with perfumes, flowers, offerings, and also presentations of food offerings.
Worshiped in this way, the god bestows all desires.

16.243.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye maṃtrāvalikṣetrapālamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma tricatvāriṃśaduttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 243 ..
16.243.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये मंत्रावलिक्षेत्रपालमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम त्रिचत्वारिंशदुत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 243 ..
16.243.m: Thus ends the two hundred and forty-third chapter, titled ‘Description of the Māhātmya of the Mantrāvalī-Kṣetrapāla,’ in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh section, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.244.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi vicitreśvaramuttamam ..
hiraṇyātīranilayaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam .. 1 ..
16.244.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि विचित्रेश्वरमुत्तमम् ..
हिरण्यातीरनिलयं महापातकनाशनम् .. 1 ..
16.244.m:
Īśvara said:
Then one should go, O great goddess, to the excellent Vicitreśvara, / residing on the bank of the Hiraṇyā, the destroyer of great sins.

16.244.s:
vicitreṇa mahādevi lekhakena yamasya ca ..
tapaḥ kṛtvā mahāraudraṃ liṃgaṃ tatra pratiṣṭhitam.. 2 ..
16.244.d:
विचित्रेण महादेवि लेखकेन यमस्य च ..
तपः कृत्वा महारौद्रं लिंगं तत्र प्रतिष्ठितम्.. 2 ..
16.244.m: After performing fierce austerity, O great goddess, / the liṅga was installed there by Vicitra, the scribe of Yama.

16.244.s: taṃ dṛṣṭvā mānavo devi yamalokaṃ na paśyati .. 3 ..
16.244.d: तं दृष्ट्वा मानवो देवि यमलोकं न पश्यति .. 3 ..
16.244.m: Having seen it, O goddess, a human being does not see the realm of Yama.

16.244.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye vicitreśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma catuścatvāriṃśaduttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 244 ..
16.244.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये विचित्रेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम चतुश्चत्वारिंशदुत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 244 ..
16.244.m: Thus ends the two hundred and forty-fourth chapter, titled ‘Description of the Māhātmya of Vicitreśvara,’ in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh section, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.245.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi tatraivoparisaṃsthitam ..
sarasvatyāstaṭe devi parṇādityasya paścime .. 1 ..
16.245.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि तत्रैवोपरिसंस्थितम् ..
सरस्वत्यास्तटे देवि पर्णादित्यस्य पश्चिमे .. 1 ..
16.245.m:
Īśvara said:
Then one should go, O great goddess, situated right there above, / on the bank of the Sarasvatī, O goddess, to the west of Parṇāditya.

16.245.s:
tatrāste sumahalliṃgaṃ sthāpitaṃ brahmaṇā purā ..
brahmeśvareti vikhyātaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam .. 2 ..
16.245.d:
तत्रास्ते सुमहल्लिंगं स्थापितं ब्रह्मणा पुरा ..
ब्रह्मेश्वरेति विख्यातं सर्वपातकनाशनम् .. 2 ..
16.245.m: There is a very great liṅga installed anciently by Brahmā, / renowned as Brahmeśvara, the destroyer of all sins.

16.245.s:
tatra snātvā dvitīyāyāṃ sopavāso jiteṃdriyaḥ ..
arcayeddevadeveśaṃ nāmnā brahmeśvaraṃ śubham..
tarpayecca pitṝñchrāddhe yadīcchecchāśvataṃ padam .. 3 ..
16.245.d:
तत्र स्नात्वा द्वितीयायां सोपवासो जितेंद्रियः ..
अर्चयेद्देवदेवेशं नाम्ना ब्रह्मेश्वरं शुभम्..
तर्पयेच्च पितॄञ्छ्राद्धे यदीच्छेच्छाश्वतं पदम् .. 3 ..
16.245.m: Bathing there on the second day [of the lunar fortnight], fasting, with senses subdued, / one should worship the auspicious god of gods named Brahmeśvara, / and propitiate the ancestors in a funeral rite if one desires the eternal abode.

16.245.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame pramāsa khaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye brahmeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma pañcacatvāriṃśaduttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 245 ..
16.245.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रमास खण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये ब्रह्मेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम पञ्चचत्वारिंशदुत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 245 ..
16.245.m: Thus ends the two hundred and forty-fifth chapter, titled ‘Description of the Māhātmya of Brahmeśvara,’ in the first [part], the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, of the seventh section, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.246.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ...
tato gacchenmahādevi piṃgalīṃ pāpanāśinīm ..
ṛṣitīrthātpaścimato nadīṃ sāgaragāminīm .. 1 ..
16.246.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ...
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि पिंगलीं पापनाशिनीम् ..
ऋषितीर्थात्पश्चिमतो नदीं सागरगामिनीम् .. 1 ..
16.246.m:
Īśvara said:
Then one should go, O great goddess, to Piṅgalā, the destroyer of sins, / the river flowing to the ocean to the west of Ṛṣitīrtha.

16.246.s:
tasyāḥ saṃdarśanāddevi rūpavāñjāyate naraḥ ..
purā maharṣayaḥ prāptāḥ someśvaradidṛkṣayā .. 2 ..
16.246.d:
तस्याः संदर्शनाद्देवि रूपवाञ्जायते नरः ..
पुरा महर्षयः प्राप्ताः सोमेश्वरदिदृक्षया .. 2 ..
16.246.m: From the sight of it, O goddess, a man becomes handsome. / Formerly, great seers arrived with the desire to behold Someśvara.

16.246.s:
prabhāsaṃ kṣetramāsādya nadītīre vyavasthitāḥ ..
dākṣiṇātyā mahādevi kṛṣṇavarṇā virūpakāḥ ..3..
16.246.d:
प्रभासं क्षेत्रमासाद्य नदीतीरे व्यवस्थिताः ..
दाक्षिणात्या महादेवि कृष्णवर्णा विरूपकाः ..3..
16.246.m: Reaching the sacred field of Prabhāsa, they settled on the riverbank— / southerners, O great goddess, dark-complexioned and misshapen.

16.246.s:
tatrāśramavare snātvā paśyanto rūpamātmanaḥ ..
kāmena sadṛśaṃ sarve vismayaṃ paramaṃ gatāḥ .. 4 ..
16.246.d:
तत्राश्रमवरे स्नात्वा पश्यन्तो रूपमात्मनः ..
कामेन सदृशं सर्वे विस्मयं परमं गताः .. 4 ..
16.246.m: Having bathed there in that excellent hermitage, they saw their own forms / resembling Kāma, and they all fell into supreme amazement.

16.246.s:
tataste sahitāḥ sarve vismayotphullalocanāḥ ..
atra snātā vayaṃ sarve yataḥ piṃgatvamāgatāḥ ..
ataḥ prabhṛti nāmāsyāstataḥ piṃgā bhaviṣyati .. 5 ..
16.246.d:
ततस्ते सहिताः सर्वे विस्मयोत्फुल्ललोचनाः ..
अत्र स्नाता वयं सर्वे यतः पिंगत्वमागताः ..
अतः प्रभृति नामास्यास्ततः पिंगा भविष्यति .. 5 ..
16.246.m: Then, all of them together, with eyes wide open in wonder, [said]: / 'Since having bathed here we all attained a golden-brown complexion, / henceforth its name will consequently be Piṅgā.

16.246.s:
yetra snānaṃ kariṣyanti bhaktyā paramayā yutāḥ ..
na teṣāmanvaye kaścidbhaviṣyati kurūpavān .. 6 ..
16.246.d:
येत्र स्नानं करिष्यन्ति भक्त्या परमया युताः ..
न तेषामन्वये कश्चिद्भविष्यति कुरूपवान् .. 6 ..
16.246.m: Those who will bathe here endowed with supreme devotion— / no one in their lineage will ever become deformed.

16.246.s:
darśanātpitṛmedhasya lapsyate mānavaḥ phalam ..
snānena dviguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ tarpaṇena caturguṇam .. 7 ..
16.246.d:
दर्शनात्पितृमेधस्य लप्स्यते मानवः फलम् ..
स्नानेन द्विगुणं पुण्यं तर्पणेन चतुर्गुणम् .. 7 ..
16.246.m: From the sight of it a man shall obtain the fruit of a Pitṛmedha sacrifice; / by bathing [he gains] double the merit, and fourfold by offering libations;

16.246.s:
asaṃkhyātaṃ phalaṃ tasya yo'tra śrāddhaṃ kariṣyati ..
evamuktvā tataḥ sarva ṛṣayo varavarṇini .. 8 ..
16.246.d:
असंख्यातं फलं तस्य योऽत्र श्राद्धं करिष्यति ..
एवमुक्त्वा ततः सर्व ऋषयो वरवर्णिनि .. 8 ..
16.246.m: innumerable is the fruit of him who performs a śrāddha here.' / Having spoken thus, O lady of excellent complexion, all those seers,

16.246.s:
vyabhajaṃstannadītīraṃ sarve te munisattamāḥ ..
yajñopavītamātrāṇi cakrustīrthāni sarvataḥ .. 9 ..
16.246.d:
व्यभजंस्तन्नदीतीरं सर्वे ते मुनिसत्तमाः ..
यज्ञोपवीतमात्राणि चक्रुस्तीर्थानि सर्वतः .. 9 ..
16.246.m: all those best of sages, divided among themselves that riverbank, / and made sacred fords all around, each the size of a sacred thread.

16.246.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye piṃgā nadīmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṭcatvāriṃśaduttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 246 ..
16.246.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये पिंगा नदीमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम षट्चत्वारिंशदुत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 246 ..
16.246.m: Thus ends the two hundred and forty-sixth chapter, named 'Description of the Glory of the Piṅgā River,' in the first [part], 'Glory of the Prabhāsa Field,' of the seventh [book], Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.247.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tatraiva saṃsthitaṃ paśyetsūryaṃ pāpapraṇāśanam ..
tathā ca piṃgalāṃ devīṃ pārvatīrūpadhāriṇīm .. 1 ..
16.247.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
तत्रैव संस्थितं पश्येत्सूर्यं पापप्रणाशनम् ..
तथा च पिंगलां देवीं पार्वतीरूपधारिणीम् .. 1 ..
16.247.m: Īśvara said: / Right there one should look upon the sun that destroys sin, / and also the goddess Piṅgalā bearing the form of Pārvatī.

16.247.s:
tṛtīyāyāṃ viśeṣeṇa hyupavāsaṃ karoti yaḥ ..
sarvānkāmānavāpnoti dhanavānputravānbhavet .. 2 ..
16.247.d:
तृतीयायां विशेषेण ह्युपवासं करोति यः ..
सर्वान्कामानवाप्नोति धनवान्पुत्रवान्भवेत् .. 2 ..
16.247.m: He who observes a fast especially on the third [lunar day] / attains all desires and becomes wealthy and blessed with sons.

16.247.s:
tatraiva saṃsthitaṃ paśyecchukreśvaramiti śrutam ..
taṃ dṛṣṭvā mānavo devi muktaḥ syātsarvapātakaiḥ .. 3 ..
16.247.d:
तत्रैव संस्थितं पश्येच्छुक्रेश्वरमिति श्रुतम् ..
तं दृष्ट्वा मानवो देवि मुक्तः स्यात्सर्वपातकैः .. 3 ..
16.247.m: Right there one should behold [the liṅga] known by tradition as Śukreśvara; / having seen it, O goddess, a man is freed from all sins.

16.247.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye piṃgalādityapiṃgādevīśukreśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptacatvāriṃśa duttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 247 ..
16.247.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये पिंगलादित्यपिंगादेवीशुक्रेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम सप्तचत्वारिंश दुत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 247 ..
16.247.m: Thus ends the two hundred and forty-seventh chapter, named 'Description of the Glory of Piṅgalāditya, Goddess Piṅgā, and Śukreśvara,' in the first [part], 'Glory of the Prabhāsa Field,' of the seventh [book], Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.248.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi pūrvoktaṃ brahmapūjitam ..
sarasvatyāstaṭe saṃsthaṃ parṇādityasya paścime .. 1 ..
16.248.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि पूर्वोक्तं ब्रह्मपूजितम् ..
सरस्वत्यास्तटे संस्थं पर्णादित्यस्य पश्चिमे .. 1 ..
16.248.m: Īśvara said: / Then, O great goddess, one should go to the aforementioned [liṅga] worshipped by Brahmā, / situated on the bank of the Sarasvatī to the west of Parṇāditya.

16.248.s:
tasyotpattiṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣvaikamanāḥ priye ..
sṛjato brahmaṇaḥ pūrvaṃ bhūtagrāmaṃ caturvidham .. 2 ..
16.248.d:
तस्योत्पत्तिं प्रवक्ष्यामि शृणुष्वैकमनाः प्रिये ..
सृजतो ब्रह्मणः पूर्वं भूतग्रामं चतुर्विधम् .. 2 ..
16.248.m: I shall relate its origin; listen with single-minded attention, O dear one. / Formerly, as Brahmā was creating the fourfold collection of beings,

16.248.s:
utpannādbhutarūpāḍhyā nārī kamalalocanā ..
kaṃbugrīvā sukeśāṃtā biṃboṣṭhī tanumadhyamā .. 3 ..
16.248.d:
उत्पन्नाद्भुतरूपाढ्या नारी कमललोचना ..
कंबुग्रीवा सुकेशांता बिंबोष्ठी तनुमध्यमा .. 3 ..
16.248.m: there arose a woman endowed with wondrous beauty, lotus-eyed, / with a conch-like neck, beautiful hair, bimba-fruit lips, slender-waisted,

16.248.s:
gaṃbhīranābhiḥ suśroṇī pīnaśroṇipayodharā ..
pūrṇacandramukhī sā tu gūḍhagulphā sitānanā .. 4 ..
16.248.d:
गंभीरनाभिः सुश्रोणी पीनश्रोणिपयोधरा ..
पूर्णचन्द्रमुखी सा तु गूढगुल्फा सितानना .. 4 ..
16.248.m: deep-navelled, with lovely hips, full buttocks and breasts, / moon-faced, with hidden ankles and a radiant face.

16.248.s:
na devī na ca gandharvī nāsurī na ca pannagī ..
yādṛgrūpā varārohā tādṛśī sā vyajāyata .. 5 ..
16.248.d:
न देवी न च गन्धर्वी नासुरी न च पन्नगी ..
यादृग्रूपा वरारोहा तादृशी सा व्यजायत .. 5 ..
16.248.m: Neither a goddess, nor a gandharvī, nor an asurī, nor a pannagī / had such a form as that fair-hipped woman was born with.

16.248.s:
tāṃ dṛṣṭvā rūpasaṃpannāṃ brahmā kāmavaśo'bhavat ..
atha tāṃ prārthayāmāsa ratyarthaṃ varavarṇini .. 6 ..
16.248.d:
तां दृष्ट्वा रूपसंपन्नां ब्रह्मा कामवशोऽभवत् ..
अथ तां प्रार्थयामास रत्यर्थं वरवर्णिनि .. 6 ..
16.248.m: Seeing her endowed with beauty, Brahmā came under the sway of desire; / then he begged her for sexual pleasure, O lady of excellent complexion.

16.248.s:
atha prārthayatastasya nyapatatpaṃcamaṃ śiraḥ ..
khararūpaṃ mahādevi tena pāpena tatkṣaṇāt.. 7 ..
16.248.d:
अथ प्रार्थयतस्तस्य न्यपतत्पंचमं शिरः ..
खररूपं महादेवि तेन पापेन तत्क्षणात्.. 7 ..
16.248.m: As he thus solicited her, his fifth head, / having the form of a donkey, O great goddess, fell off in an instant due to that sin.

16.248.s:
tato jñātvā mahatpāpaṃ duhituḥ kāmasaṃbhavam ..
ghṛṇayā parayā yuktaḥ prabhāsaṃ kṣetramāgataḥ .. 8 ..
16.248.d:
ततो ज्ञात्वा महत्पापं दुहितुः कामसंभवम् ..
घृणया परया युक्तः प्रभासं क्षेत्रमागतः .. 8 ..
16.248.m: Then, realising the great sin arising from his lust for his daughter, / filled with supreme self-reproach, he came to the sacred field of Prabhāsa.

16.248.s:
na kāyasya yataḥ śuddhirvinā tīrthāvagāhanāt ..
sa snātaḥ salile puṇye sarasvatyā varānane .. 9 ..
16.248.d:
न कायस्य यतः शुद्धिर्विना तीर्थावगाहनात् ..
स स्नातः सलिले पुण्ये सरस्वत्या वरानने .. 9 ..
16.248.m: Because there is no purification of the body without bathing in a sacred ford, / he bathed in the holy waters of the Sarasvatī, O lovely-faced one,

16.248.s:
liṃgaṃ saṃsthāpayāmāsa devadevasya śūlinaḥ ..
tato vikalmaṣo bhūtvā jagāma svagṛhaṃ punaḥ .. 7.1.248.10 ..
16.248.d:
लिंगं संस्थापयामास देवदेवस्य शूलिनः ..
ततो विकल्मषो भूत्वा जगाम स्वगृहं पुनः .. 7.1.248.10 ..
16.248.m: and installed a liṅga of the god of gods who wields the trident. / Then, freed from blemish, he returned to his own abode.

16.248.s:
snātvā sārasvate toye yastalliṃgaṃ prapaśyati ..
sarvapāpavinirmukto brahmaloke mahīyate .. 11 ..
16.248.d:
स्नात्वा सारस्वते तोये यस्तल्लिंगं प्रपश्यति ..
सर्वपापविनिर्मुक्तो ब्रह्मलोके महीयते .. 11 ..
16.248.m: Having bathed in the water of Sarasvatī, he who beholds that liṅga / is completely freed from all sins and glorified in the world of Brahmā.

16.248.s:
caitre śuklacaturdaśyāṃ yastaṃ paśyati mānavaḥ ..
sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatra devo maheśvaraḥ .. 12 ..
16.248.d:
चैत्रे शुक्लचतुर्दश्यां यस्तं पश्यति मानवः ..
स याति परमं स्थानं यत्र देवो महेश्वरः .. 12 ..
16.248.m: The man who beholds it on the fourteenth day of the bright fortnight of Caitra / goes to the supreme abode where the god Maheśvara resides.

16.248.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye brahmeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭacatvāriṃśaduttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 248 ..
16.248.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये ब्रह्मेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामाष्टचत्वारिंशदुत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 248 ..
16.248.m: Thus ends the two hundred and forty-eighth chapter, named 'Description of the Glory of Brahmeśvara,' in the first [part], 'Glory of the Prabhāsa Field,' of the seventh [book], Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.249.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi devaṃ vai saṃgameśvaram ..
golakṣamiti vikhyātaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam . 1 ..
16.249.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि देवं वै संगमेश्वरम् ..
गोलक्षमिति विख्यातं सर्वपातकनाशनम् . 1 ..
16.249.m: Īśvara said: / Then, O great goddess, one should go to the god Saṃgameśvara, / renowned as Golakṣa, the destroyer of all sins,

16.249.s:
tasyaiva paścime bhāge sarvakāmaphalapradam ..
ṛṣiruddālakonāma purā hyāsīnmahātapāḥ .. 2 ..
16.249.d:
तस्यैव पश्चिमे भागे सर्वकामफलप्रदम् ..
ऋषिरुद्दालकोनाम पुरा ह्यासीन्महातपाः .. 2 ..
16.249.m: in its western part, bestowing the fruit of all desires. / In ancient times there was a seer named Uddālaka of great austerity.

16.249.s:
sa purā saṃgamaṃ prāpya sarvapāpapraṇāśanam ..
sarasvatyāśca piṃgāyāstapastepe sureśvari .. 3 ..
16.249.d:
स पुरा संगमं प्राप्य सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् ..
सरस्वत्याश्च पिंगायास्तपस्तेपे सुरेश्वरि .. 3 ..
16.249.m: Formerly, having reached the confluence of Sarasvatī and Piṅgā / that destroys all sins, he performed austerity, O queen of gods.

16.249.s:
tatastapasyatastasya tapo raudraṃ mahātmanaḥ ..
purato hyutthitaṃ liṃgaṃ bhaktyā yuktasya sundari .. 4 ..
16.249.d:
ततस्तपस्यतस्तस्य तपो रौद्रं महात्मनः ..
पुरतो ह्युत्थितं लिंगं भक्त्या युक्तस्य सुन्दरि .. 4 ..
16.249.m: Then, as that great-souled one endowed with devotion was performing severe austerity, / a liṅga indeed rose up before him, O beautiful one.

16.249.s:
etasminneva kāle tu vāguvācāśarīriṇī ..
uddālaka mahābāho śṛṇuṣvaitadvaco mama .. 5 ..
16.249.d:
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु वागुवाचाशरीरिणी ..
उद्दालक महाबाहो शृणुष्वैतद्वचो मम .. 5 ..
16.249.m: At that very moment, a bodiless voice spoke: / 'O mighty-armed Uddālaka, listen to this word of mine!

16.249.s:
adyaprabhṛti vāso'tra mama nityaṃ bhaviṣyati ..
yasmādatra samutpannaṃ saṃgame liṃgamuttamam ..
saṃgameśvaramityeva nāma cāsya bhavi ṣyati .. 6 ..
16.249.d:
अद्यप्रभृति वासोऽत्र मम नित्यं भविष्यति ..
यस्मादत्र समुत्पन्नं संगमे लिंगमुत्तमम् ..
संगमेश्वरमित्येव नाम चास्य भवि ष्यति .. 6 ..
16.249.m: From this day forth my dwelling here will be perpetual. / Since this supreme liṅga arose here at the confluence, / its name shall indeed be Saṃgameśvara.

16.249.s:
yetra snānaṃ narāḥ kṛtvā saṃgame lokaviśrute ..
saṃgameśvaramīkṣante te yāṃti paramāṃ gatim .. 7 ..
16.249.d:
येत्र स्नानं नराः कृत्वा संगमे लोकविश्रुते ..
संगमेश्वरमीक्षन्ते ते यांति परमां गतिम् .. 7 ..
16.249.m: Those men who, having bathed here at the world-renowned confluence, / behold Saṃgameśvara, go to the supreme state.'

16.249.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tatastaṃ pūjayāmāsa divārātramataṃdritaḥ ..
tato dehāvasāne'sau gato yatra maheśvaraḥ .. 8 ..
16.249.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततस्तं पूजयामास दिवारात्रमतंद्रितः ..
ततो देहावसानेऽसौ गतो यत्र महेश्वरः .. 8 ..
16.249.m: Īśvara said: / Then he worshipped it day and night without wearying; / then, at the end of his body, he went to where Maheśvara is.

16.249.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame ,prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye saṃgameśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikonapañcāśaduttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 249 ..
16.249.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे ,प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये संगमेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामैकोनपञ्चाशदुत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 249 ..
16.249.m: Thus ends the two hundred and forty-ninth chapter, named 'Description of the Glory of Saṃgameśvara,' in the first [part], 'Glory of the Prabhāsa Field,' of the seventh [book], Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.250.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi liṃgaṃ trailokyaviśrutam ..
gaṃgeśvareti vikhyātaṃ saṃgameśvarapaścime .. 1 ..
16.250.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि लिंगं त्रैलोक्यविश्रुतम् ..
गंगेश्वरेति विख्यातं संगमेश्वरपश्चिमे .. 1 ..
16.250.m: Īśvara said: / Then, O great goddess, one should go to the liṅga renowned in the three worlds, / celebrated as Gaṅgeśvara, to the west of Saṃgameśvara.

16.250.s:
yadā gaṃgā samāhūtā viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā ..
antakāle'bhiṣekārthaṃ svakāyasya varānane .. 2 ..
16.250.d:
यदा गंगा समाहूता विष्णुना प्रभविष्णुना ..
अन्तकालेऽभिषेकार्थं स्वकायस्य वरानने .. 2 ..
16.250.m: When Gaṅgā was summoned by the all-powerful Viṣṇu / at his final hour to sprinkle his own body, O fair-faced one,

16.250.s:
tato dṛṣṭvā tu tatkṣetraṃ puṇyaṃ hyṛṣiniṣevitam ..
sarvatra vyāpitaṃ liṃgairāśramaiśca tapasvinām .. 3 ..
16.250.d:
ततो दृष्ट्वा तु तत्क्षेत्रं पुण्यं ह्यृषिनिषेवितम् ..
सर्वत्र व्यापितं लिंगैराश्रमैश्च तपस्विनाम् .. 3 ..
16.250.m: she then saw that holy field frequented by seers, / everywhere pervaded with liṅgas and hermitages of ascetics.

16.250.s:
tato gaṃgāsaricchreṣṭhā pūrvasāgaragāminī ..
sthāpayāmāsa talliṃgaṃ śivabhaktiparāyaṇā .. 4 ..
16.250.d:
ततो गंगासरिच्छ्रेष्ठा पूर्वसागरगामिनी ..
स्थापयामास तल्लिंगं शिवभक्तिपरायणा .. 4 ..
16.250.m: Then Gaṅgā, the best of rivers flowing to the eastern ocean, / devoted to Śiva, installed that liṅga.

16.250.s:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā tu varārohe gaṃgāsnānaphalaṃ labhet ..
aśvamedhasahasrasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ .. 5 ..
16.250.d:
तं दृष्ट्वा तु वरारोहे गंगास्नानफलं लभेत् ..
अश्वमेधसहस्रस्य फलं प्राप्नोति मानवः .. 5 ..
16.250.m: Beholding it, O fair-hipped one, one obtains the fruit of bathing in the Gaṅgā; / a man attains the fruit of a thousand horse-sacrifices.

16.250.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye gaṃgeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma pañcāśaduttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 250 ..
16.250.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये गंगेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम पञ्चाशदुत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 250 ..
16.250.m: Thus ends the two hundred fiftieth chapter, entitled 'Description of the Glory of Gaṅgeśvara,' in the first section, the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, in the seventh section, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.251.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi śaṃkarādityamuttamam ..
gaṃgeśvarasya pūrveṇa śaṃkareṇa pratiṣṭhitam .. 1 ..
16.251.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि शंकरादित्यमुत्तमम् ..
गंगेश्वरस्य पूर्वेण शंकरेण प्रतिष्ठितम् .. 1 ..
16.251.m: Īśvara said: / Next, O great goddess, one should go to the excellent Śaṃkarāditya, / installed by Śaṃkara to the east of Gaṅgeśvara.

16.251.s:
ṣaṣṭhyāṃ caiva tu śuklāyāmenaṃ yaḥ pūjayiṣyati ..
gamiṣyati paraṃ sthānaṃ yatra devo divākaraḥ .. 2 ..
16.251.d:
षष्ठ्यां चैव तु शुक्लायामेनं यः पूजयिष्यति ..
गमिष्यति परं स्थानं यत्र देवो दिवाकरः .. 2 ..
16.251.m: And whoever worships this [deity] on the sixth lunar day of the bright fortnight / will go to the supreme abode where the divine Sun resides.

16.251.s:
raktacaṃdanamiśraiśca raktapuṣpaiḥ samāhitaḥ ..
tāmrapātre samādhāya yo'rghyaṃ dāsyati mānavaḥ ..
sa yāsyati parāṃ siddhiṃ na ca yāti daridratām.. 3 ..
16.251.d:
रक्तचंदनमिश्रैश्च रक्तपुष्पैः समाहितः ..
ताम्रपात्रे समाधाय योऽर्घ्यं दास्यति मानवः ..
स यास्यति परां सिद्धिं न च याति दरिद्रताम्.. 3 ..
16.251.m: Having collected [them] in a copper vessel, with red sandalwood mixed with red flowers, / the attentive person who offers the guest water / will attain supreme perfection and never suffer poverty.
Therefore, O fair-faced goddess, with every effort in that sacred field / one should worship Śaṃkarāditya, who grants the fruits of all desires.

16.251.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye śaṃkarādityamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikapañcāśaduttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 251 ..
16.251.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये शंकरादित्यमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामैकपञ्चाशदुत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 251 ..
16.251.m: Thus ends the two hundred fifty-first chapter, entitled 'Description of the Glory of Śaṃkarāditya,' in the first section, the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, in the seventh section, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.252.s:
.. īśvara uvāca... ..
tato gacchenmahādevi liṃgaṃ trailokyaviśrutam ..
tatra śaṃkaranātheti prasiddhaṃ pāpanāśanam .. .. 1 ..
16.252.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच... ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि लिंगं त्रैलोक्यविश्रुतम् ..
तत्र शंकरनाथेति प्रसिद्धं पापनाशनम् .. .. 1 ..
16.252.m: Īśvara said: / Next, O great goddess, one should go to the liṅga renowned across the three worlds, / celebrated there as Śaṃkaranātha, the destroyer of sin.

16.252.s:
sthāpitaṃ bhānunā devi kṛtvā tatra mahattapaḥ ..
tamarcayitvā deveśaṃ sopavāso maheśvaram.. 2 ..
16.252.d:
स्थापितं भानुना देवि कृत्वा तत्र महत्तपः ..
तमर्चयित्वा देवेशं सोपवासो महेश्वरम्.. 2 ..
16.252.m: It was installed by the Sun, O goddess, having performed great austerity there. / Having worshipped that supreme Lord, the ruler of the gods, while fasting,

16.252.s:
brāhmaṇānbhojayettatra śrāddhaṃ kuryājjitendriyaḥ ..
śaktyā hiraṇyaṃ vāsāṃsi vipre dadyātsamāhitaḥ ..
sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā .. 3 ..
16.252.d:
ब्राह्मणान्भोजयेत्तत्र श्राद्धं कुर्याज्जितेन्द्रियः ..
शक्त्या हिरण्यं वासांसि विप्रे दद्यात्समाहितः ..
स याति परमं स्थानं नात्र कार्या विचारणा .. 3 ..
16.252.m: one should feed brahmins there and, with senses subdued, perform an ancestral rite. / Attentive, one should give gold and clothes to the priest according to one's capacity; / he goes to the supreme abode—there should be no doubt about this.

16.252.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye śaṅkaranāthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvipañcāśaduttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 252 ..
16.252.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये शङ्करनाथमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम द्विपञ्चाशदुत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 252 ..
16.252.m: Thus ends the two hundred fifty-second chapter, entitled 'Description of the Glory of Śaṅkaranātha,' in the first section, the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, in the seventh section, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.253.s:
.. īśvara uvāca ..
tato gacchenmahādevi gupheśvaramanuttamam..
hiraṇyā uttare bhāge sarvapātakanāśanam ..
taṃ dṛṣṭvā mānavo devi koṭihatyāṃ vyapohati.. 1 ..
16.253.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि गुफेश्वरमनुत्तमम्..
हिरण्या उत्तरे भागे सर्वपातकनाशनम् ..
तं दृष्ट्वा मानवो देवि कोटिहत्यां व्यपोहति.. 1 ..
16.253.m: Īśvara said: / Next, O great goddess, one should go to the unsurpassed Gupheśvara / to the north of the Hiraṇyā, the destroyer of all sins. / Having seen him, O goddess, a mortal dispels ten million murders.

16.253.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye gupheśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma tripañcāśaduttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ..253..
16.253.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये गुफेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम त्रिपञ्चाशदुत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः ..253..
16.253.m: Thus ends the two hundred fifty-third chapter, entitled 'Description of the Glory of Gupheśvara,' in the first section, the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, in the seventh section, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.254.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tatraiva saṃsthitaṃ paśyetsarvapātakanāśanam ..
ghaṇṭeśvaramiti khyātaṃ devadānavavanditam ..
pūjitaṃ hyṛṣibhiḥ siddhairvāṃchitārthaphalapradam .. 1 ..
16.254.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
तत्रैव संस्थितं पश्येत्सर्वपातकनाशनम् ..
घण्टेश्वरमिति ख्यातं देवदानववन्दितम् ..
पूजितं ह्यृषिभिः सिद्धैर्वांछितार्थफलप्रदम् .. 1 ..
16.254.m: Īśvara said: / Standing right there, one should look upon the destroyer of all sins, / known as Ghaṇṭeśvara, praised by gods and demons, / worshipped by seers and perfected ones, granting the fruit of desired objectives.

16.254.s:
vāre somasya cāṣṭamyāṃ yastaṃ pūjayate naraḥ ..
sa labhedvāṃchitānkāmānmuktaḥ syātpātakena hi ..2 ..
16.254.d:
वारे सोमस्य चाष्टम्यां यस्तं पूजयते नरः ..
स लभेद्वांछितान्कामान्मुक्तः स्यात्पातकेन हि ..2 ..
16.254.m: The man who worships him on a Monday and on the eighth lunar day / shall obtain his desired wishes and indeed be freed from sin.

16.254.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye ghaṃṭeśvaramāhāratmyavarṇanaṃnāma catuṣpañcāśaduttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 254 ..
16.254.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे प्रथमे प्रभासक्षेत्रमाहात्म्ये घंटेश्वरमाहारत्म्यवर्णनंनाम चतुष्पञ्चाशदुत्तरद्विशततमोऽध्यायः .. 254 ..
16.254.m: Thus ends the two hundred fifty-fourth chapter, entitled 'Description of the Glory of Ghaṇṭeśvara,' in the first section, the Prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya, in the seventh section, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

16.255.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
tato gacchenmahādevi tīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam ..
tasyaiva paścime bhāge ṛṣīṇāṃ puṇyakarmaṇām .. 1 ..
16.255.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्महादेवि तीर्थं त्रैलोक्यविश्रुतम् ..
तस्यैव पश्चिमे भागे ऋषीणां पुण्यकर्मणाम् .. 1 ..
16.255.m: Īśvara said: / Next, O great goddess, one should go to the sacred ford renowned across the three worlds, / on the western side of that very place, belonging to the seers of meritorious deeds.

16.255.s:
tasmiṃstrinetrā matsyāśca dṛśyaṃte'dyāpi bhāmini ..
aṃgirā gautamo'gastyaḥ sumatiḥ susakhistathā .. 2 ..
16.255.d:
तस्मिंस्त्रिनेत्रा मत्स्याश्च दृश्यंतेऽद्यापि भामिनि ..
अंगिरा गौतमोऽगस्त्यः सुमतिः सुसखिस्तथा .. 2 ..
16.255.m: In that place, three-eyed fish are seen even today, O passionate lady: / Aṅgiras, Gautama, Agastya, Sumati, and Susakhi,

16.255.s:
viśvāmitraḥ sthūlaśirāḥ saṃvarttaḥ pratimarddanaḥ ..
raibhyo bṛhaspatiścaiva cyavanaḥ kaśyapo bhṛguḥ .. 3 ..
16.255.d:
विश्वामित्रः स्थूलशिराः संवर्त्तः प्रतिमर्द्दनः ..
रैभ्यो बृहस्पतिश्चैव च्यवनः कश्यपो भृगुः .. 3 ..
16.255.m: Viśvāmitra, Sthūlaśiras, Saṃvarta, Pratimardana, / Raibhya, Bṛhaspati, Cyavana, Kaśyapa, Bhṛgu,

16.255.s:
durvāsā jāmadagnyaśca mārkaṃḍeyo'tha gālavaḥ ..
uśanā'tha bharadvājo yavakrītastritastathā .. 4 ..
16.255.d:
दुर्वासा जामदग्न्यश्च मार्कंडेयोऽथ गालवः ..
उशनाऽथ भरद्वाजो यवक्रीतस्त्रितस्तथा .. 4 ..
16.255.m: Durvāsas, Jāmadagnya, then Mārkaṇḍeya, Gālava, / Uśanas, then Bharadvāja, Yavakrīta, and Trita,

16.255.s: nāradaḥ parvataścaiva vasiṣṭho'ruṃdhatī tathā .. 5 ..
16.255.d: नारदः पर्वतश्चैव वसिष्ठोऽरुंधती तथा .. 5 ..
16.255.m: Nārada, Parvata, Vasiṣṭha, and Arundhatī,

16.255.s:
kāṇvo'tha gautamo dhaumyaḥ śatānando'kṛtavraṇaḥ ..
jamadagnistathā rāmo bakaścetyevamādayaḥ ..
kṛṣṇadvaipāyanaścaiva putraśiṣyaiḥ samanvitaḥ .. 6 ..
16.255.d:
काण्वोऽथ गौतमो धौम्यः शतानन्दोऽकृतव्रणः ..
जमदग्निस्तथा रामो बकश्चेत्येवमादयः ..
कृष्णद्वैपायनश्चैव पुत्रशिष्यैः समन्वितः .. 6 ..
16.255.m: Kāṇva, then Gautama, Dhaumya, Śatānanda, Akṛtavraṇa, / Jamadagni, Rāma, Baka, and so forth, / and Kṛṣṇadvaipāyana together with his sons and disciples.

16.255.s:
etatkṣetraṃ samā sādya prabhāsaṃ munisattamāḥ ..
tapastepurmahātmāno vividhaṃ paramādbhutam .. 7 ..
16.255.d:
एतत्क्षेत्रं समा साद्य प्रभासं मुनिसत्तमाः ..
तपस्तेपुर्महात्मानो विविधं परमाद्भुतम् .. 7 ..
16.255.m: Having arrived at this sacred field, Prabhāsa, the excellent sages, / the great-souled ones, performed various, exceedingly marvelous austerities.

16.255.s:
evaṃ te niyatātmāno damayuktāstapasvinaḥ ..
samādhinā jigīṣante brahmalokaṃ sanātanam.. 8 ..
16.255.d:
एवं ते नियतात्मानो दमयुक्तास्तपस्विनः ..
समाधिना जिगीषन्ते ब्रह्मलोकं सनातनम्.. 8 ..
16.255.m: Thus these ascetic practitioners, restrained in mind and endowed with self-control, / sought to conquer the eternal world of Brahmā through absorption.

16.255.s:
athābhavadanāvṛṣṭiḥ kadācinmahatī priye ..
kṛcchraṃ prāpto hyabhūttatra sarvalokaḥ kṣudhārditaḥ .. 9 ..
16.255.d:
अथाभवदनावृष्टिः कदाचिन्महती प्रिये ..
कृच्छ्रं प्राप्तो ह्यभूत्तत्र सर्वलोकः क्षुधार्दितः .. 9 ..
16.255.m: Then once, O dear lady, a great drought occurred; / having fallen into distress, everyone there was afflicted with hunger.

16.255.s:
tato niranne loke'sminnātmānaṃ te parīpsavaḥ ..
mṛtaṃ kumāramādāya kṛcchraṃ prāptāstadā'pacan .. 7.1.255.10 ..
16.255.d:
ततो निरन्ने लोकेऽस्मिन्नात्मानं ते परीप्सवः ..
मृतं कुमारमादाय कृच्छ्रं प्राप्तास्तदाऽपचन् .. 7.1.255.10 ..
16.255.m: Then, when this world was devoid of food, wishing to preserve themselves, / having fallen into distress, they took a dead child and cooked it.

16.255.s:
athoparicarastatra kliśyamānānhi tānṛṣīn..
dṛṣṭvā rājā vṛṣādarbhiḥ provācedaṃ vacastadā.. 11..
16.255.d:
अथोपरिचरस्तत्र क्लिश्यमानान्हि तानृषीन्..
दृष्ट्वा राजा वृषादर्भिः प्रोवाचेदं वचस्तदा.. 11..
16.255.m: Then King Vṛṣādarbhi, who moved about, / seeing those seers suffering there, spoke these words at that time:

16.255.s:
rājovāca ..
pratigraho brāhmaṇānāṃ dṛṣṭā vṛttiraniṃditā..
tasmātpratigrahaṃ matta gṛhṇīdhvaṃ munipuṃgavāḥ .. 12..
16.255.d:
राजोवाच ..
प्रतिग्रहो ब्राह्मणानां दृष्टा वृत्तिरनिंदिता..
तस्मात्प्रतिग्रहं मत्त गृह्णीध्वं मुनिपुंगवाः .. 12..
16.255.m: The king said: / Acceptance of gifts is seen as a blameless livelihood for brahmins; / therefore, accept a gift from me, O foremost sages!

16.255.s:
mudgānmāṣāṃśca vrīhīṃśca tathā ratnāni kāṃcanam ..
yuṣmākaṃ saṃpradāsyāmi yaccānyadapi durllabham ..
nivarttadhvamataḥ sarve hyetasmātpātakātparam.... 13 ..
16.255.d:
मुद्गान्माषांश्च व्रीहींश्च तथा रत्नानि कांचनम् ..
युष्माकं संप्रदास्यामि यच्चान्यदपि दुर्ल्लभम् ..
निवर्त्तध्वमतः सर्वे ह्येतस्मात्पातकात्परम्.... 13 ..
16.255.m: Mung beans, black gram, grains of rice, as well as jewels and gold— / I shall grant you whatever else is difficult to obtain. / Desist, all of you, from this sin hereafter!

16.255.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
tajjānaṃtaḥ kathaṃ rājangṛhṇīmaste pratigraham .. 14 ..
16.255.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
तज्जानंतः कथं राजन्गृह्णीमस्ते प्रतिग्रहम् .. 14 ..
16.255.m: The seers said: / Knowing that, O king, how can we accept a gift from you?

16.255.s:
daśasūnāsamaścakrī daśacakrisamo dhvajī ..
daśadhvaji samā veśyā daśaveśyāsamo nṛpaḥ .. 15 ..
16.255.d:
दशसूनासमश्चक्री दशचक्रिसमो ध्वजी ..
दशध्वजि समा वेश्या दशवेश्यासमो नृपः .. 15 ..
16.255.m: An oilman is equal to ten slaughterhouses; a tavern-keeper is equal to ten oilmen; / a courtesan is equal to ten tavern-keepers; a king is equal to ten courtesans.

16.255.s:
yo rājñāṃ pratigṛhṇāti brāhmaṇo lobhamohitaḥ ..
tāmisrādiṣu ghoreṣu narakeṣu sa pacyate .. 16 ..
16.255.d:
यो राज्ञां प्रतिगृह्णाति ब्राह्मणो लोभमोहितः ..
तामिस्रादिषु घोरेषु नरकेषु स पच्यते .. 16 ..
16.255.m: A brahmin who accepts a gift from kings, deluded by greed, / is cooked in Tāmisra and other terrifying hells.

16.255.s:
tadgaccha kuśalaṃ te'stu saha dānena pārthiva ..
anyeṣāṃ dīyatāmetadityuktvā te vanaṃ yayuḥ .. 17 ..
16.255.d:
तद्गच्छ कुशलं तेऽस्तु सह दानेन पार्थिव ..
अन्येषां दीयतामेतदित्युक्त्वा ते वनं ययुः .. 17 ..
16.255.m: Therefore go, may welfare be yours along with your gift, O ruler of the earth! / Let this be given to others!—having spoken thus, they went to the forest.

16.255.s:
atha rājñaḥ samādeśāttatra gatvā ca maṃtriṇaḥ ..
ūdumbarāṇi vyakiranhemagarbhāṇi bhūtale ..18..
16.255.d:
अथ राज्ञः समादेशात्तत्र गत्वा च मंत्रिणः ..
ऊदुम्बराणि व्यकिरन्हेमगर्भाणि भूतले ..18..
16.255.m: Then, by order of the king, the ministers went there / and scattered cluster-figs containing gold upon the ground.

16.255.s:
atha tāni vyacinvaṃśca ṛṣayo varavarṇini ..
gurūṇīti viditvā tu na grāhyāṇyaṃgirā'bravīt .. 19 ..
16.255.d:
अथ तानि व्यचिन्वंश्च ऋषयो वरवर्णिनि ..
गुरूणीति विदित्वा तु न ग्राह्याण्यंगिराऽब्रवीत् .. 19 ..
16.255.m: Then, as the seers were gathering them, O fair-complexioned lady, / perceiving that they were heavy, Aṅgiras said they should not be taken.

16.255.s:
.. atriruvāca .. ..
nāsmahenāsmahe mūḍha vayamajñānabuddhayaḥ ..
haimānīmāni jānīmaḥ pratibuddhāḥ sma jāḍyataḥ ..7.1.255.20..
16.255.d:
.. अत्रिरुवाच .. ..
नास्महेनास्महे मूढ वयमज्ञानबुद्धयः ..
हैमानीमानि जानीमः प्रतिबुद्धाः स्म जाड्यतः ..7.1.255.20..
16.255.m: Atri said: / We are not, we are not fools, O dullard, with minds devoid of knowledge! / We know these are made of gold; we have awakened from stupor.

16.255.s:
.. vasiṣṭha uvāca .. ..
dharmārthaṃ saṃcayo yasya dravyāṇāṃ sa na śasyate ..
tapaḥsaṃcayanaṃ manye vasiṣṭho dhanasaṃcayam .. 21 ..
16.255.d:
.. वसिष्ठ उवाच .. ..
धर्मार्थं संचयो यस्य द्रव्याणां स न शस्यते ..
तपःसंचयनं मन्ये वसिष्ठो धनसंचयम् .. 21 ..
16.255.m: Vasiṣṭha said: / An accumulation of material goods for the sake of virtue is not praised; / I, Vasiṣṭha, consider the accumulation of austerity to be the true accumulation of wealth.

16.255.s:
tyajadhvaṃ saṃcayānsarvāñjātīnāṃ samupadravān ..
na hi saṃcayavānkaściddṛśyate nirupadravaḥ .. 22 ..
16.255.d:
त्यजध्वं संचयान्सर्वाञ्जातीनां समुपद्रवान् ..
न हि संचयवान्कश्चिद्दृश्यते निरुपद्रवः .. 22 ..
16.255.m: Abandon all hoards, which bring calamities upon one's kin; / for no one who possesses hoards is seen to be free of calamity. 22.

16.255.s:
yathāyathā na gṛhṇāti brāhmaṇo'satpratigraham ..
tathātathā'niśaṃ cāsya brahmatejastu vardhate .. 23 ..
16.255.d:
यथायथा न गृह्णाति ब्राह्मणोऽसत्प्रतिग्रहम् ..
तथातथाऽनिशं चास्य ब्रह्मतेजस्तु वर्धते .. 23 ..
16.255.m: The more a brahmin refuses improper gifts, / the more his brahminical splendor increases day and night. 23.

16.255.s:
akiṃcanatvaṃ rājyaṃ ca tulayā samatolayam..
akiṃcanatvamadhikaṃ rājyādapi na saṃśayaḥ .. 24 ..
16.255.d:
अकिंचनत्वं राज्यं च तुलया समतोलयम्..
अकिंचनत्वमधिकं राज्यादपि न संशयः .. 24 ..
16.255.m: I weighed poverty and kingship equally upon a balance; / poverty is superior even to kingship, without a doubt. 24.

16.255.s:
..kaśyapa uvāca .. ..
anartho brāhmaṇasyaiṣa yadarthanicayo mahān ..
arthaiśvaryavimūḍho'pi śreyaso bhraśyate dvijaḥ .. 25 ..
16.255.d:
..कश्यप उवाच .. ..
अनर्थो ब्राह्मणस्यैष यदर्थनिचयो महान् ..
अर्थैश्वर्यविमूढोऽपि श्रेयसो भ्रश्यते द्विजः .. 25 ..
16.255.m: Kaśyapa said: / This is a misfortune for a brahmin: that [he has] a great hoard of wealth; / deluded by the sovereignty of wealth, the twice-born falls away from the highest good. 25.

16.255.s:
arthasaṃpadvimohāya bahuśokāya caiva hi ..
tasmādarthamanarthākhyaṃ śreyo'rthī dūratastyajet .. 26 ..
16.255.d:
अर्थसंपद्विमोहाय बहुशोकाय चैव हि ..
तस्मादर्थमनर्थाख्यं श्रेयोऽर्थी दूरतस्त्यजेत् .. 26 ..
16.255.m: An abundance of wealth leads indeed to delusion and to abundant sorrow; / therefore, one who desires the highest good should abandon from afar wealth, which is [really] called misfortune. 26.

16.255.s:
yasya dharmārthamapyarthāstasyāpi na hi dṛśyate ..
prakṣālanāddhi paṃkasya dūrādasparśanaṃ varam ..27..
16.255.d:
यस्य धर्मार्थमप्यर्थास्तस्यापि न हि दृश्यते ..
प्रक्षालनाद्धि पंकस्य दूरादस्पर्शनं वरम् ..27..
16.255.m: Even for one whose wealth is meant for righteousness, it is not seen [to bring peace]; / for rather than washing off mud, not touching it from afar is better. 27.

16.255.s:
.. bharadvāja uvāca.. ..
jīryaṃti jīryataḥ keśā daṃtā jīryaṃti jīryataḥ..
cakṣuḥ śrotre ca jīryete tṛṣṇaikā na tu jīryate .. 28 ..
16.255.d:
.. भरद्वाज उवाच.. ..
जीर्यंति जीर्यतः केशा दंता जीर्यंति जीर्यतः..
चक्षुः श्रोत्रे च जीर्येते तृष्णैका न तु जीर्यते .. 28 ..
16.255.m: Bharadvāja said: / As one grows old, the hair grows old; as one grows old, the teeth grow old; / the eyes and ears also grow old, but craving alone does not grow old. 28.

16.255.s:
sūcī sūtra tathā vastre samānayati sūcikā ..
tadvatsaṃsārasūtrasya tṛṣṇā sūcī vidhīyate .. 29 ..
16.255.d:
सूची सूत्र तथा वस्त्रे समानयति सूचिका ..
तद्वत्संसारसूत्रस्य तृष्णा सूची विधीयते .. 29 ..
16.255.m: Just as a needle brings the thread together through the cloth, / even so is craving ordained as the needle of the thread of saṃsāra. 29.

16.255.s:
yathā śṛṃgaṃ ruroḥ kāye varddhamāne hi varddhate ..
anaṃtapārā durvārā tṛṣṇā duḥkhapradā sadā ..
adharmabahulā caiva tasmāttāṃ parivarjayet.. ... 7.1.255.30 ..
16.255.d:
यथा शृंगं रुरोः काये वर्द्धमाने हि वर्द्धते ..
अनंतपारा दुर्वारा तृष्णा दुःखप्रदा सदा ..
अधर्मबहुला चैव तस्मात्तां परिवर्जयेत्.. ... 7.1.255.30 ..
16.255.m: Just as a horn on a deer's body grows as it grows, / [so] craving is boundless, irresistible, ever bringing sorrow, / and full of unrighteousness; therefore, one should shun it. 30.

16.255.s:
.. gautama uvāca .. ..
saṃtuṣṭaḥ ko na śaknoti phalaiścāpi hi varttitum..
sarvo'pīṃdriyalobhena saṃkaṭānyabhigāhate ..31..
16.255.d:
.. गौतम उवाच .. ..
संतुष्टः को न शक्नोति फलैश्चापि हि वर्त्तितुम्..
सर्वोऽपींद्रियलोभेन संकटान्यभिगाहते ..31..
16.255.m: Gautama said: / Being content, who cannot live even on fruits? / Everyone plunges into difficulties solely through greed for the sense objects. 31.

16.255.s:
sarvatra saṃpadastasya saṃtuṣṭaṃ yasya mānasam ..
upānadgūḍhapādasya nanu carmāvṛteva bhūḥ .. 32 ..
16.255.d:
